`crates/orress-views/src/code_editor.rs`:

```rs
//! A custom multi-cursor code-editor widget.
//!
//! egui's built-in `TextEdit` has a single cursor baked in, which rules out IDE-style
//! multi-cursor editing. This widget owns its carets, painting and input instead: it lays
//! out the text with the caller's syntax-highlighting `LayoutJob`, paints every selection
//! and caret itself, and applies each keystroke to *all* carets at once.
//!
//! Features: Alt+click to add a caret, Ctrl+D to add the next occurrence of the selection,
//! Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down to add a caret above/below, simultaneous typing/deletion at every caret,
//! Esc to collapse to one, word/line selection, undo/redo, and the standard clipboard events
//! (so the Edit menu and Ctrl+C/X/V keep working). Selections are dimmed when unfocused.
//!
//! The buffer stays a plain `String` (the eventual scalability upgrade is a rope behind this
//! same widget boundary); carets are character indices so the galley's cursor navigation can
//! be reused directly.

use std::sync::Arc;

use egui::text::{CCursor, Galley, LayoutJob};
use egui::{
    Color32, Event, EventFilter, Key, Modifiers, Pos2, Rect, Response, Sense, Stroke, Ui, Vec2,
};
use ropey::Rope;

/// One caret and its selection, as character indices into the buffer.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
struct Caret {
    /// The moving end (where new text is inserted).
    head: usize,
    /// The fixed end of the selection (`== head` when there is no selection).
    anchor: usize,
}

impl Caret {
    fn at(pos: usize) -> Self {
        Self {
            head: pos,
            anchor: pos,
        }
    }
    /// The selection as an ordered `(min, max)` character range.
    fn range(&self) -> (usize, usize) {
        (self.head.min(self.anchor), self.head.max(self.anchor))
    }
    fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.head == self.anchor
    }
}

/// How the last edit was classified, for coalescing consecutive edits into one undo step.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum EditKind {
    Insert,
    Delete,
    Boundary,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Snapshot {
    /// A rope clone is cheap (structural sharing), so snapshots are light.
    text: Rope,
    carets: Vec<Caret>,
}

/// The persistent multi-cursor state for one editor tab.
pub struct MultiCursor {
    carets: Vec<Caret>,
    /// Preferred x (screen-relative to the galley) for vertical movement, per caret.
    pref_x: Vec<Option<f32>>,
    undo: Vec<Snapshot>,
    redo: Vec<Snapshot>,
    last_kind: Option<EditKind>,
    dragging: bool,
    /// Set when a caret moved by keyboard, so the view scrolls to the primary caret.
    scroll_to_caret: bool,
}

impl Default for MultiCursor {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            carets: vec![Caret::at(0)],
            pref_x: vec![None],
            undo: Vec::new(),
            redo: Vec::new(),
            last_kind: None,
            dragging: false,
            scroll_to_caret: false,
        }
    }
}

impl MultiCursor {
    /// The primary caret (the most recently placed), as a character index.
    pub fn primary_char(&self) -> usize {
        self.carets.last().map(|c| c.head).unwrap_or(0)
    }

    /// Collapses to a single caret at `char_idx` (used by go-to-definition and completion).
    pub fn set_single(&mut self, char_idx: usize) {
        self.carets = vec![Caret::at(char_idx)];
        self.pref_x = vec![None];
        self.last_kind = Some(EditKind::Boundary);
        self.scroll_to_caret = true;
    }

    fn clamp(&mut self, nchars: usize) {
        for c in &mut self.carets {
            c.head = c.head.min(nchars);
            c.anchor = c.anchor.min(nchars);
        }
        self.pref_x.resize(self.carets.len(), None);
    }

    /// Sorts carets and merges any that overlap, keeping the set tidy.
    fn normalize(&mut self) {
        if self.carets.len() > 1 {
            // Sort carets and their preferred-x together.
            let mut idx: Vec<usize> = (0..self.carets.len()).collect();
            idx.sort_by_key(|&i| self.carets[i].range().0);
            let carets: Vec<Caret> = idx.iter().map(|&i| self.carets[i]).collect();
            let pref: Vec<Option<f32>> = idx.iter().map(|&i| self.pref_x[i]).collect();

            let mut out: Vec<Caret> = Vec::new();
            let mut out_pref: Vec<Option<f32>> = Vec::new();
            for (c, px) in carets.into_iter().zip(pref) {
                if let Some(last) = out.last_mut() {
                    let (ls, le) = last.range();
                    let (cs, ce) = c.range();
                    if cs <= le {
                        *last = Caret {
                            anchor: ls.min(cs),
                            head: le.max(ce),
                        };
                        *out_pref.last_mut().unwrap() = None;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                out.push(c);
                out_pref.push(px);
            }
            self.carets = out;
            self.pref_x = out_pref;
        }
        if self.carets.is_empty() {
            self.carets.push(Caret::at(0));
            self.pref_x.push(None);
        }
    }

    fn push_undo(&mut self, text: &Rope, kind: EditKind) {
        let coalesce =
            self.last_kind == Some(kind) && kind != EditKind::Boundary && !self.undo.is_empty();
        if !coalesce {
            self.undo.push(Snapshot {
                text: text.clone(),
                carets: self.carets.clone(),
            });
            if self.undo.len() > 300 {
                self.undo.remove(0);
            }
        }
        self.redo.clear();
        self.last_kind = Some(kind);
    }

    fn undo(&mut self, text: &mut Rope) {
        if let Some(prev) = self.undo.pop() {
            self.redo.push(Snapshot {
                text: text.clone(),
                carets: self.carets.clone(),
            });
            *text = prev.text;
            self.carets = prev.carets;
            self.pref_x = vec![None; self.carets.len()];
            self.last_kind = None;
            self.scroll_to_caret = true;
        }
    }

    fn redo(&mut self, text: &mut Rope) {
        if let Some(next) = self.redo.pop() {
            self.undo.push(Snapshot {
                text: text.clone(),
                carets: self.carets.clone(),
            });
            *text = next.text;
            self.carets = next.carets;
            self.pref_x = vec![None; self.carets.len()];
            self.last_kind = None;
            self.scroll_to_caret = true;
        }
    }
}

/// A splice: replace the characters in `[start, end)` with `repl`.
struct Splice {
    start: usize,
    end: usize,
    repl: String,
}

/// Applies non-overlapping splices (one per caret) and collapses each caret to the end of
/// its inserted text, shifting later carets by the net length change. All indices are
/// character indices.
fn apply_splices(text: &mut Rope, mut splices: Vec<Splice>) -> Vec<Caret> {
    splices.sort_by_key(|s| s.start);
    // Resulting caret positions, computed with a running character shift.
    let mut new_carets = Vec::with_capacity(splices.len());
    let mut shift: isize = 0;
    for sp in &splices {
        let repl_chars = sp.repl.chars().count();
        let pos = (sp.start as isize + shift + repl_chars as isize).max(0) as usize;
        new_carets.push(Caret::at(pos));
        shift += repl_chars as isize - (sp.end - sp.start) as isize;
    }
    // Apply highest-index first so the lower (still-pending) indices stay valid.
    for sp in splices.iter().rev() {
        if sp.start < sp.end {
            text.remove(sp.start..sp.end);
        }
        if !sp.repl.is_empty() {
            text.insert(sp.start, &sp.repl);
        }
    }
    new_carets
}

/// What the editor widget returns, mirroring the parts of egui's `TextEditOutput` the
/// surrounding code uses.
pub struct CodeEditorOutput {
    pub response: Response,
    pub galley: Arc<Galley>,
    pub galley_pos: Pos2,
    /// The primary caret as a character index.
    pub primary_char: usize,
    /// Whether the text changed this frame.
    pub changed: bool,
}

/// Draws the multi-cursor code editor. `job` is the pre-built highlight/diagnostic layout for
/// the current `text`; `font` is used to size the caret.
pub fn code_editor(
    ui: &mut Ui,
    text: &mut Rope,
    mc: &mut MultiCursor,
    job: LayoutJob,
    id_salt: &str,
) -> CodeEditorOutput {
    let galley = ui.fonts_mut(|f| f.layout_job(job));

    let size = Vec2::new(
        galley.size().x.max(ui.available_width()),
        galley.size().y.max(ui.available_height()),
    );
    // A stable id (per tab) so keyboard focus and the focus-lock filter persist across frames.
    let id = ui.make_persistent_id(id_salt);
    let (rect, _) = ui.allocate_exact_size(size, Sense::hover());
    let mut response = ui.interact(rect, id, Sense::click_and_drag());
    let galley_pos = rect.min;

    let nchars = text.len_chars();
    mc.clamp(nchars);
    mc.scroll_to_caret = false;

    // --- Mouse -------------------------------------------------------------
    let modifiers = ui.input(|i| i.modifiers);
    let pointer_char = |pos: Pos2| galley.cursor_from_pos(pos - galley_pos).index.0;
    if response.double_clicked() {
        if let Some(pos) = response.interact_pointer_pos() {
            let (s, e) = word_bounds(text, pointer_char(pos));
            mc.carets = vec![Caret { anchor: s, head: e }];
            mc.pref_x = vec![None];
        }
        response.request_focus();
    } else if response.clicked() {
        if let Some(pos) = response.interact_pointer_pos() {
            let c = pointer_char(pos);
            if modifiers.alt {
                mc.carets.push(Caret::at(c));
                mc.pref_x.push(None);
            } else if modifiers.shift {
                if let Some(p) = mc.carets.last_mut() {
                    p.head = c;
                }
            } else {
                // Plain (or Ctrl, for go-to-definition) click: one caret here.
                mc.carets = vec![Caret::at(c)];
                mc.pref_x = vec![None];
            }
        }
        response.request_focus();
    }
    if response.drag_started() && !modifiers.command {
        if let Some(pos) = response.interact_pointer_pos() {
            let c = pointer_char(pos);
            if modifiers.alt {
                mc.carets.push(Caret::at(c));
                mc.pref_x.push(None);
            } else if !modifiers.shift {
                mc.carets = vec![Caret::at(c)];
                mc.pref_x = vec![None];
            }
            mc.dragging = true;
        }
        response.request_focus();
    }
    if mc.dragging
        && response.dragged()
        && let Some(pos) = response.interact_pointer_pos()
    {
        let c = pointer_char(pos);
        if let Some(p) = mc.carets.last_mut() {
            p.head = c;
        }
    }
    if response.drag_stopped() {
        mc.dragging = false;
        mc.normalize();
    }

    // --- Keyboard & text ---------------------------------------------------
    let focused = response.has_focus();
    let mut changed = false;
    if focused {
        ui.memory_mut(|m| {
            m.set_focus_lock_filter(
                id,
                EventFilter {
                    tab: true,
                    horizontal_arrows: true,
                    vertical_arrows: true,
                    escape: true,
                },
            );
        });
        let events = ui.input(|i| i.events.clone());
        let mut keep = vec![true; events.len()];
        for (i, ev) in events.iter().enumerate() {
            if handle_event(ev, text, mc, &galley, &mut changed) {
                keep[i] = false;
            }
        }
        if keep.iter().any(|k| !k) {
            ui.input_mut(|inp| {
                let mut it = keep.iter();
                inp.events.retain(|_| *it.next().unwrap_or(&true));
            });
        }
        if changed {
            response.mark_changed();
            ui.ctx().request_repaint();
        }
    }

    // --- Paint -------------------------------------------------------------
    let painter = ui.painter_at(rect.intersect(ui.clip_rect()));
    let sel_color = {
        let c = ui.visuals().selection.bg_fill;
        if focused { c } else { c.gamma_multiply(0.65) }
    };
    let nchars = text.len_chars();
    // Selection highlights sit under the text.
    for caret in &mc.carets {
        let (s, e) = caret.range();
        if s != e {
            paint_selection(
                &painter,
                &galley,
                galley_pos,
                s.min(nchars),
                e.min(nchars),
                sel_color,
            );
        }
    }
    // The text itself (colours come from the layout job).
    painter.galley(galley_pos, Arc::clone(&galley), ui.visuals().text_color());
    if focused {
        let caret_color = ui.visuals().text_cursor.stroke.color;
        for caret in &mc.carets {
            let r = galley
                .pos_from_cursor(CCursor::new(caret.head.min(nchars)))
                .translate(galley_pos.to_vec2());
            painter.vline(r.center().x, r.y_range(), Stroke::new(2.0, caret_color));
        }
    }

    // Scroll to the primary caret after keyboard movement.
    if mc.scroll_to_caret {
        let r = galley
            .pos_from_cursor(CCursor::new(mc.primary_char().min(nchars)))
            .translate(galley_pos.to_vec2());
        ui.scroll_to_rect(r.expand2(Vec2::new(24.0, 8.0)), None);
    }

    CodeEditorOutput {
        primary_char: mc.primary_char().min(nchars),
        changed,
        response,
        galley,
        galley_pos,
    }
}

/// Handles one input event, returning true if it was consumed.
fn handle_event(
    ev: &Event,
    text: &mut Rope,
    mc: &mut MultiCursor,
    galley: &Galley,
    changed: &mut bool,
) -> bool {
    match ev {
        // Control chars (Tab, Enter) arrive as dedicated key events; don't double-insert them.
        Event::Text(s) if !s.is_empty() && !s.chars().all(char::is_control) => {
            insert_at_carets(text, mc, s);
            *changed = true;
            mc.scroll_to_caret = true;
            true
        }
        Event::Paste(s) => {
            paste(text, mc, s);
            *changed = true;
            mc.scroll_to_caret = true;
            true
        }
        Event::Copy => {
            if let Some(clip) = gather_clipboard(text, mc) {
                // Copy is handled by the app via ctx; we stash it through output below.
                COPY_PENDING.with(|c| *c.borrow_mut() = Some(clip));
            }
            true
        }
        Event::Cut => {
            if let Some(clip) = gather_clipboard(text, mc) {
                COPY_PENDING.with(|c| *c.borrow_mut() = Some(clip));
                delete_selections_or_lines(text, mc);
                *changed = true;
            }
            true
        }
        Event::Key {
            key,
            pressed: true,
            modifiers,
            ..
        } => handle_key(*key, *modifiers, text, mc, galley, changed),
        _ => false,
    }
}

thread_local! {
    /// Set by a Copy/Cut event; drained by the caller to push onto the OS clipboard.
    static COPY_PENDING: std::cell::RefCell<Option<String>> = const { std::cell::RefCell::new(None) };
}

/// Drains any text a Copy/Cut produced this frame (to be sent to the clipboard).
pub fn take_clipboard() -> Option<String> {
    COPY_PENDING.with(|c| c.borrow_mut().take())
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_lines)]
fn handle_key(
    key: Key,
    m: Modifiers,
    text: &mut Rope,
    mc: &mut MultiCursor,
    galley: &Galley,
    changed: &mut bool,
) -> bool {
    let word = m.command; // Ctrl+arrow = by word
    match key {
        Key::Backspace => {
            backspace(text, mc, word);
            *changed = true;
            mc.scroll_to_caret = true;
            true
        }
        Key::Delete => {
            delete_forward(text, mc, word);
            *changed = true;
            mc.scroll_to_caret = true;
            true
        }
        Key::Enter => {
            newline(text, mc);
            *changed = true;
            mc.scroll_to_caret = true;
            true
        }
        Key::Tab => {
            mc.push_undo(text, EditKind::Boundary);
            let splices = mc
                .carets
                .iter()
                .map(|c| {
                    let (s, e) = c.range();
                    Splice {
                        start: s,
                        end: e,
                        repl: "    ".to_string(),
                    }
                })
                .collect();
            mc.carets = apply_splices(text, splices);
            mc.pref_x = vec![None; mc.carets.len()];
            mc.normalize();
            *changed = true;
            mc.scroll_to_caret = true;
            true
        }
        Key::A if m.command => {
            let n = text.len_chars();
            mc.carets = vec![Caret { anchor: 0, head: n }];
            mc.pref_x = vec![None];
            mc.last_kind = Some(EditKind::Boundary);
            true
        }
        Key::Z if m.command && !m.shift => {
            mc.undo(text);
            *changed = true;
            true
        }
        Key::Z if m.command && m.shift => {
            mc.redo(text);
            *changed = true;
            true
        }
        Key::Y if m.command => {
            mc.redo(text);
            *changed = true;
            true
        }
        Key::D if m.command => {
            add_next_occurrence(text, mc);
            mc.scroll_to_caret = true;
            true
        }
        Key::Escape => {
            if mc.carets.len() > 1 || !mc.carets.last().map(Caret::is_empty).unwrap_or(true) {
                let head = mc.primary_char();
                mc.carets = vec![Caret::at(head)];
                mc.pref_x = vec![None];
                true
            } else {
                false
            }
        }
        Key::ArrowUp | Key::ArrowDown if m.command && m.alt => {
            add_caret_vertical(mc, galley, key == Key::ArrowUp);
            mc.scroll_to_caret = true;
            true
        }
        Key::ArrowLeft | Key::ArrowRight => {
            move_horizontal(text, mc, galley, key == Key::ArrowLeft, m.shift, word);
            mc.last_kind = Some(EditKind::Boundary);
            mc.scroll_to_caret = true;
            true
        }
        Key::ArrowUp | Key::ArrowDown => {
            move_vertical(mc, galley, key == Key::ArrowUp, m.shift);
            mc.last_kind = Some(EditKind::Boundary);
            mc.scroll_to_caret = true;
            true
        }
        Key::Home => {
            move_line_edge(mc, galley, true, m.shift);
            mc.scroll_to_caret = true;
            true
        }
        Key::End => {
            move_line_edge(mc, galley, false, m.shift);
            mc.scroll_to_caret = true;
            true
        }
        _ => false,
    }
}

fn insert_at_carets(text: &mut Rope, mc: &mut MultiCursor, s: &str) {
    mc.push_undo(text, EditKind::Insert);
    let splices = mc
        .carets
        .iter()
        .map(|c| {
            let (start, end) = c.range();
            Splice {
                start,
                end,
                repl: s.to_string(),
            }
        })
        .collect();
    mc.carets = apply_splices(text, splices);
    mc.pref_x = vec![None; mc.carets.len()];
    mc.normalize();
}

fn newline(text: &mut Rope, mc: &mut MultiCursor) {
    mc.push_undo(text, EditKind::Boundary);
    let splices = mc
        .carets
        .iter()
        .map(|c| {
            let (start, end) = c.range();
            let indent = line_indent(text, start);
            Splice {
                start,
                end,
                repl: format!("\n{indent}"),
            }
        })
        .collect();
    mc.carets = apply_splices(text, splices);
    mc.pref_x = vec![None; mc.carets.len()];
    mc.normalize();
}

fn backspace(text: &mut Rope, mc: &mut MultiCursor, word: bool) {
    mc.push_undo(text, EditKind::Delete);
    let splices = mc
        .carets
        .iter()
        .map(|c| {
            let (start, end) = c.range();
            if start != end {
                Splice {
                    start,
                    end,
                    repl: String::new(),
                }
            } else {
                let new_start = if word {
                    word_left(text, start)
                } else {
                    start.saturating_sub(1)
                };
                Splice {
                    start: new_start,
                    end: start,
                    repl: String::new(),
                }
            }
        })
        .collect();
    mc.carets = apply_splices(text, splices);
    mc.pref_x = vec![None; mc.carets.len()];
    mc.normalize();
}

fn delete_forward(text: &mut Rope, mc: &mut MultiCursor, word: bool) {
    mc.push_undo(text, EditKind::Delete);
    let n = text.len_chars();
    let splices = mc
        .carets
        .iter()
        .map(|c| {
            let (start, end) = c.range();
            if start != end {
                Splice {
                    start,
                    end,
                    repl: String::new(),
                }
            } else {
                let new_end = if word {
                    word_right(text, end)
                } else {
                    (end + 1).min(n)
                };
                Splice {
                    start: end,
                    end: new_end,
                    repl: String::new(),
                }
            }
        })
        .collect();
    mc.carets = apply_splices(text, splices);
    mc.pref_x = vec![None; mc.carets.len()];
    mc.normalize();
}

fn delete_selections_or_lines(text: &mut Rope, mc: &mut MultiCursor) {
    mc.push_undo(text, EditKind::Boundary);
    let splices = mc
        .carets
        .iter()
        .map(|c| {
            let (start, end) = c.range();
            if start != end {
                Splice {
                    start,
                    end,
                    repl: String::new(),
                }
            } else {
                let (ls, le) = line_span(text, start);
                Splice {
                    start: ls,
                    end: le,
                    repl: String::new(),
                }
            }
        })
        .collect();
    mc.carets = apply_splices(text, splices);
    mc.pref_x = vec![None; mc.carets.len()];
    mc.normalize();
}

fn paste(text: &mut Rope, mc: &mut MultiCursor, s: &str) {
    mc.push_undo(text, EditKind::Boundary);
    let lines: Vec<&str> = s.split('\n').collect();
    // Distribute one line per caret when the counts match (VS Code behaviour).
    let per_caret = lines.len() == mc.carets.len() && mc.carets.len() > 1;
    let mut ordered: Vec<usize> = (0..mc.carets.len()).collect();
    ordered.sort_by_key(|&i| mc.carets[i].range().0);
    let splices = mc
        .carets
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(i, c)| {
            let (start, end) = c.range();
            let repl = if per_caret {
                let rank = ordered.iter().position(|&x| x == i).unwrap_or(0);
                lines[rank].to_string()
            } else {
                s.to_string()
            };
            Splice { start, end, repl }
        })
        .collect();
    mc.carets = apply_splices(text, splices);
    mc.pref_x = vec![None; mc.carets.len()];
    mc.normalize();
}

fn gather_clipboard(text: &Rope, mc: &MultiCursor) -> Option<String> {
    let mut carets: Vec<Caret> = mc.carets.clone();
    carets.sort_by_key(|c| c.range().0);
    let any_sel = carets.iter().any(|c| !c.is_empty());
    let parts: Vec<String> = carets
        .iter()
        .map(|c| {
            if any_sel {
                let (s, e) = c.range();
                slice_chars(text, s, e)
            } else {
                let (ls, le) = line_span(text, c.head);
                slice_chars(text, ls, le)
            }
        })
        .collect();
    if parts.is_empty() {
        None
    } else {
        Some(parts.join(if any_sel { "\n" } else { "" }))
    }
}

/// Ctrl+D: select the word under the caret first, then add the next occurrence of the
/// selected text as a new (primary) caret.
fn add_next_occurrence(text: &Rope, mc: &mut MultiCursor) {
    let primary = *mc.carets.last().unwrap();
    if primary.is_empty() {
        let (s, e) = word_bounds(text, primary.head);
        if s != e
            && let Some(last) = mc.carets.last_mut()
        {
            *last = Caret { anchor: s, head: e };
        }
        return;
    }
    let (s, e) = primary.range();
    let needle = slice_chars(text, s, e);
    if needle.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    // Search from the end of the last caret, wrapping around. Ctrl+D is a user action, not
    // a per-frame path, so materializing the text for a substring search is fine.
    let haystack = text.to_string();
    let max_end = mc.carets.iter().map(|c| c.range().1).max().unwrap_or(e);
    let from_byte = char_to_byte(text, max_end);
    let found = haystack[from_byte..]
        .find(&needle)
        .map(|b| from_byte + b)
        .or_else(|| haystack.find(&needle));
    if let Some(byte) = found {
        let start = text.byte_to_char(byte);
        let end = start + needle.chars().count();
        if !mc.carets.iter().any(|c| c.range() == (start, end)) {
            mc.carets.push(Caret {
                anchor: start,
                head: end,
            });
            mc.pref_x.push(None);
        }
    }
}

fn add_caret_vertical(mc: &mut MultiCursor, galley: &Galley, up: bool) {
    let primary = *mc.carets.last().unwrap();
    let px = *mc.pref_x.last().unwrap_or(&None);
    let (new, new_px) = if up {
        galley.cursor_up_one_row(&CCursor::new(primary.head), px)
    } else {
        galley.cursor_down_one_row(&CCursor::new(primary.head), px)
    };
    let pos = new.index.0;
    if pos != primary.head {
        mc.carets.push(Caret::at(pos));
        mc.pref_x.push(new_px);
    }
}

fn move_horizontal(
    text: &Rope,
    mc: &mut MultiCursor,
    galley: &Galley,
    left: bool,
    shift: bool,
    word: bool,
) {
    let n = text.len_chars();
    for (c, px) in mc.carets.iter_mut().zip(mc.pref_x.iter_mut()) {
        *px = None;
        if !shift && !c.is_empty() {
            // Collapse to the appropriate edge instead of moving.
            let (s, e) = c.range();
            let target = if left { s } else { e };
            *c = Caret::at(target);
            continue;
        }
        let new_head = if word {
            if left {
                word_left(text, c.head)
            } else {
                word_right(text, c.head)
            }
        } else if left {
            galley
                .cursor_left_one_character(&CCursor::new(c.head))
                .index
                .0
        } else {
            galley
                .cursor_right_one_character(&CCursor::new(c.head))
                .index
                .0
        };
        c.head = new_head.min(n);
        if !shift {
            c.anchor = c.head;
        }
    }
    mc.normalize();
}

fn move_vertical(mc: &mut MultiCursor, galley: &Galley, up: bool, shift: bool) {
    for (c, px) in mc.carets.iter_mut().zip(mc.pref_x.iter_mut()) {
        let (new, new_px) = if up {
            galley.cursor_up_one_row(&CCursor::new(c.head), *px)
        } else {
            galley.cursor_down_one_row(&CCursor::new(c.head), *px)
        };
        *px = new_px;
        c.head = new.index.0;
        if !shift {
            c.anchor = c.head;
        }
    }
    mc.normalize();
}

fn move_line_edge(mc: &mut MultiCursor, galley: &Galley, begin: bool, shift: bool) {
    for (c, px) in mc.carets.iter_mut().zip(mc.pref_x.iter_mut()) {
        *px = None;
        let new = if begin {
            galley.cursor_begin_of_row(&CCursor::new(c.head))
        } else {
            galley.cursor_end_of_row(&CCursor::new(c.head))
        };
        c.head = new.index.0;
        if !shift {
            c.anchor = c.head;
        }
    }
    mc.normalize();
}

/// Paints the selection rectangles for `[s, e)` (character indices).
fn paint_selection(
    painter: &egui::Painter,
    galley: &Galley,
    origin: Pos2,
    s: usize,
    e: usize,
    color: Color32,
) {
    let r0 = galley.pos_from_cursor(CCursor::new(s));
    let r1 = galley.pos_from_cursor(CCursor::new(e));
    let lc0 = galley.layout_from_cursor(CCursor::new(s));
    let lc1 = galley.layout_from_cursor(CCursor::new(e));
    let paint_rect = |r: Rect| {
        painter.rect_filled(r.translate(origin.to_vec2()), 1.0, color);
    };
    if lc0.row == lc1.row {
        paint_rect(Rect::from_min_max(
            Pos2::new(r0.left(), r0.top()),
            Pos2::new(r1.left(), r0.bottom()),
        ));
        return;
    }
    // First row: from the start caret to the row's right edge.
    let row0 = galley.rows[lc0.row].rect();
    paint_rect(Rect::from_min_max(
        Pos2::new(r0.left(), row0.top()),
        Pos2::new(row0.right().max(r0.left() + 4.0), row0.bottom()),
    ));
    // Middle rows: full width.
    for ri in (lc0.row + 1)..lc1.row {
        let rr = galley.rows[ri].rect();
        paint_rect(Rect::from_min_max(
            Pos2::new(rr.left(), rr.top()),
            Pos2::new(rr.right().max(rr.left() + 4.0), rr.bottom()),
        ));
    }
    // Last row: from the row's left edge to the end caret.
    let rown = galley.rows[lc1.row].rect();
    paint_rect(Rect::from_min_max(
        Pos2::new(rown.left(), rown.top()),
        Pos2::new(r1.left(), rown.bottom()),
    ));
}

// --- character/byte helpers (all indices are character indices) -----------

fn char_to_byte(text: &Rope, ci: usize) -> usize {
    text.char_to_byte(ci.min(text.len_chars()))
}

fn slice_chars(text: &Rope, s: usize, e: usize) -> String {
    let n = text.len_chars();
    text.slice(s.min(n)..e.min(n)).to_string()
}

fn is_word(c: char) -> bool {
    c.is_alphanumeric() || c == '_'
}

fn char_at(text: &Rope, i: usize) -> Option<char> {
    text.get_char(i)
}

/// The word boundaries `[start, end)` around character index `ci`.
fn word_bounds(text: &Rope, ci: usize) -> (usize, usize) {
    let n = text.len_chars();
    let is_w = |i: usize| char_at(text, i).is_some_and(is_word);
    let anchor = if ci < n && is_w(ci) {
        ci
    } else if ci > 0 && is_w(ci - 1) {
        ci - 1
    } else {
        return (ci, ci);
    };
    let mut s = anchor;
    while s > 0 && is_w(s - 1) {
        s -= 1;
    }
    let mut e = anchor + 1;
    while e < n && is_w(e) {
        e += 1;
    }
    (s, e)
}

/// The next word boundary to the left of `ci` (skips whitespace, then a run of word chars).
fn word_left(text: &Rope, ci: usize) -> usize {
    let is_ws = |i: usize| char_at(text, i).is_some_and(char::is_whitespace);
    let is_w = |i: usize| char_at(text, i).is_some_and(is_word);
    let mut i = ci.min(text.len_chars());
    while i > 0 && is_ws(i - 1) {
        i -= 1;
    }
    if i > 0 && is_w(i - 1) {
        while i > 0 && is_w(i - 1) {
            i -= 1;
        }
    } else {
        i = i.saturating_sub(1);
    }
    i
}

fn word_right(text: &Rope, ci: usize) -> usize {
    let n = text.len_chars();
    let is_ws = |i: usize| char_at(text, i).is_some_and(char::is_whitespace);
    let is_w = |i: usize| char_at(text, i).is_some_and(is_word);
    let mut i = ci.min(n);
    while i < n && is_ws(i) {
        i += 1;
    }
    if i < n && is_w(i) {
        while i < n && is_w(i) {
            i += 1;
        }
    } else if i < n {
        i += 1;
    }
    i
}

/// The leading whitespace of the line containing character index `ci`.
fn line_indent(text: &Rope, ci: usize) -> String {
    let line = text.char_to_line(ci.min(text.len_chars()));
    let start = text.line_to_char(line);
    let mut indent = String::new();
    let mut i = start;
    while let Some(c) = char_at(text, i) {
        if c == ' ' || c == '\t' {
            indent.push(c);
            i += 1;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    indent
}

/// The character span of the whole line containing `ci`, including its trailing newline.
fn line_span(text: &Rope, ci: usize) -> (usize, usize) {
    let n = text.len_chars();
    let line = text.char_to_line(ci.min(n));
    let start = text.line_to_char(line);
    let end = if line + 1 < text.len_lines() {
        text.line_to_char(line + 1)
    } else {
        n
    };
    (start, end)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn mc(carets: &[(usize, usize)]) -> MultiCursor {
        let mut m = MultiCursor::default();
        m.carets = carets
            .iter()
            .map(|&(anchor, head)| Caret { anchor, head })
            .collect();
        m.pref_x = vec![None; m.carets.len()];
        m
    }

    fn heads(m: &MultiCursor) -> Vec<usize> {
        m.carets.iter().map(|c| c.head).collect()
    }

    #[test]
    fn insert_at_multiple_carets() {
        // Two carets, both collapsed, at the start of each word.
        let mut text = Rope::from_str("foo bar");
        let mut m = mc(&[(0, 0), (4, 4)]);
        insert_at_carets(&mut text, &mut m, "X");
        assert_eq!(text.to_string(), "Xfoo Xbar");
        // Carets land right after each inserted "X".
        assert_eq!(heads(&m), vec![1, 6]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn insert_replaces_selections() {
        let mut text = Rope::from_str("foo bar");
        // Select "foo" (0..3) and "bar" (4..7).
        let mut m = mc(&[(0, 3), (4, 7)]);
        insert_at_carets(&mut text, &mut m, "baz");
        assert_eq!(text.to_string(), "baz baz");
    }

    #[test]
    fn backspace_at_multiple_carets() {
        let mut text = Rope::from_str("ab cd");
        // Carets after 'b' (2) and after 'd' (5).
        let mut m = mc(&[(2, 2), (5, 5)]);
        backspace(&mut text, &mut m, false);
        assert_eq!(text.to_string(), "a c");
    }

    #[test]
    fn apply_splices_shifts_later_carets() {
        let mut text = Rope::from_str("0123456789");
        let splices = vec![
            Splice {
                start: 2,
                end: 2,
                repl: "AA".into(),
            },
            Splice {
                start: 6,
                end: 6,
                repl: "B".into(),
            },
        ];
        let carets = apply_splices(&mut text, splices);
        assert_eq!(text.to_string(), "01AA2345B6789");
        assert_eq!(carets[0].head, 4); // after "AA"
        assert_eq!(carets[1].head, 9); // 6 + 2 (shift) + 1 (len "B")
    }

    #[test]
    fn ctrl_d_selects_word_then_next_occurrence() {
        let text = Rope::from_str("let x = x + x;");
        // Caret inside the first "x" (collapsed at index 4).
        let mut m = mc(&[(4, 4)]);
        add_next_occurrence(&text, &mut m); // first: select the word
        assert_eq!(m.carets.last().unwrap().range(), (4, 5));
        add_next_occurrence(&text, &mut m); // second: add next "x"
        assert_eq!(m.carets.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(m.carets.last().unwrap().range(), (8, 9));
    }

    #[test]
    fn word_bounds_finds_identifier() {
        let text = Rope::from_str("foo_bar baz");
        assert_eq!(word_bounds(&text, 2), (0, 7)); // inside foo_bar
        assert_eq!(word_bounds(&text, 8), (8, 11)); // inside baz
    }

    #[test]
    fn normalize_merges_overlapping_carets() {
        let mut m = mc(&[(0, 5), (3, 8)]);
        m.normalize();
        assert_eq!(m.carets.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(m.carets[0].range(), (0, 8));
    }

    #[test]
    fn undo_restores_text_and_carets() {
        let mut text = Rope::from_str("abc");
        let mut m = mc(&[(3, 3)]);
        insert_at_carets(&mut text, &mut m, "d");
        assert_eq!(text.to_string(), "abcd");
        m.undo(&mut text);
        assert_eq!(text.to_string(), "abc");
    }
}
```

`crates/orress-views/src/collab.rs`:

```rs
//! The Collaboration panel (M13): join a team room over a relay, see who is where (presence +
//! follow mode), share renames/comments/bookmarks/notes through the CRDT, claim and chat about
//! challenges, and import/submit flags from a CTFd or rCTF instance — all in one place.
//!
//! The live [`CollabSession`] is polled every frame by [`CollabView::tick`]; CTF network calls run
//! on background threads so the UI never blocks.

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet, HashMap};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::sync::mpsc::{Receiver, TryRecvError};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};

use egui::{Color32, RichText, Ui};
use orress_collab::{ChatMessage, CollabSession, Peer};
use orress_ctf::{Challenge, CtfClient, Platform};
use orress_project::{Document, validate_name};
use orress_ui::muted;

fn now_ms() -> u64 {
    SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
        .map(|d| d.as_millis() as u64)
        .unwrap_or(0)
}

/// All collaboration + CTF UI state the app owns.
pub struct CollabView {
    // Connect form.
    url: String,
    room: String,
    pass: String,
    name: String,
    session: Option<CollabSession>,
    /// A connection being made on a worker thread (key derivation + WebSocket handshake).
    connecting: Option<Receiver<Result<CollabSession, String>>>,
    status: Option<String>,
    chat_input: String,
    claim_input: String,
    /// SHA-256 of the binary this room's annotations belong to: the first analysed document
    /// bridged after connecting. Other files are never merged into the room.
    room_sha: Option<String>,
    /// The file name of the room's binary, for the panel.
    room_file: Option<String>,
    /// Set when the active document is not the room's binary (its file name), for the panel.
    other_file: Option<String>,
    // Last annotation state reconciled with the CRDT, the base for the three-way merge in `bridge`,
    // tagged with the SHA-256 of the document it was taken from.
    synced_sha: Option<String>,
    synced_names: BTreeMap<u64, String>,
    synced_comments: BTreeMap<u64, String>,
    synced_bookmarks: BTreeSet<u64>,
    /// Last address we broadcast as our presence, and last address we jumped to while following —
    /// so we only act on changes.
    last_local_addr: Option<u64>,
    last_follow: Option<u64>,
    // CTF browser (network work runs on a thread).
    platform: Platform,
    ctf_base: String,
    ctf_token: String,
    challenges: Arc<Mutex<Vec<Challenge>>>,
    ctf_busy: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    ctf_status: Arc<Mutex<Option<String>>>,
    flags: HashMap<String, String>,
}

impl Default for CollabView {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            url: "ws://127.0.0.1:8787".to_string(),
            room: String::new(),
            pass: String::new(),
            name: String::new(),
            session: None,
            connecting: None,
            status: None,
            chat_input: String::new(),
            claim_input: String::new(),
            room_sha: None,
            room_file: None,
            other_file: None,
            synced_sha: None,
            synced_names: BTreeMap::new(),
            synced_comments: BTreeMap::new(),
            synced_bookmarks: BTreeSet::new(),
            last_local_addr: None,
            last_follow: None,
            platform: Platform::Ctfd,
            ctf_base: String::new(),
            ctf_token: String::new(),
            challenges: Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new())),
            ctf_busy: Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),
            ctf_status: Arc::new(Mutex::new(None)),
            flags: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }
}

impl CollabView {
    /// Polls the live session once (called every frame by the app). Returns whether the UI should
    /// repaint. Drops the session if the relay connection was lost.
    pub fn tick(&mut self) -> bool {
        let mut changed = false;
        // A connection finished on its worker thread.
        if let Some(rx) = &self.connecting {
            match rx.try_recv() {
                Ok(Ok(session)) => {
                    self.session = Some(session);
                    self.status = None;
                    self.reset_sync();
                    self.connecting = None;
                    changed = true;
                }
                Ok(Err(e)) => {
                    self.status = Some(e);
                    self.connecting = None;
                    changed = true;
                }
                Err(TryRecvError::Empty) => {}
                Err(TryRecvError::Disconnected) => {
                    self.status = Some("the connection attempt failed".into());
                    self.connecting = None;
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
        }
        if let Some(session) = &mut self.session {
            changed = session.poll(now_ms());
            if !session.is_connected() {
                self.status = Some(
                    session
                        .error()
                        .unwrap_or_else(|| "disconnected from the relay".to_string()),
                );
                self.session = None;
                self.reset_sync();
                changed = true;
            }
        }
        changed
    }

    /// Whether a live session is connected (so the app keeps repainting to drive sync).
    pub fn is_connected(&self) -> bool {
        self.session
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(CollabSession::is_connected)
    }

    /// Whether a connection is being made in the background (the app keeps polling).
    pub fn is_connecting(&self) -> bool {
        self.connecting.is_some()
    }

    /// Whether `doc` is the binary this room shares (so presence and follow jumps apply to it).
    /// Before the room's binary is known, any analysed document qualifies.
    pub fn shares(&self, doc: &Document) -> bool {
        let sha = &doc.annotations.sha256;
        !sha.is_empty() && self.room_sha.as_ref().is_none_or(|room| room == sha)
    }

    /// The address the user is currently following a teammate to, if any (the app can jump to it).
    pub fn follow_addr(&self) -> Option<u64> {
        self.session.as_ref().and_then(CollabSession::follow_addr)
    }

    /// Tells the session where this user is looking, so teammates following them jump along.
    pub fn set_local_addr(&mut self, addr: u64) {
        if let Some(s) = &mut self.session {
            s.set_local_addr(Some(addr), now_ms());
        }
    }

    fn reset_sync(&mut self) {
        self.room_sha = None;
        self.room_file = None;
        self.other_file = None;
        self.synced_sha = None;
        self.synced_names.clear();
        self.synced_comments.clear();
        self.synced_bookmarks.clear();
        self.last_local_addr = None;
        self.last_follow = None;
    }

    /// Broadcasts our current address as presence, but only when it changed (so teammates following
    /// us jump along without a flood of identical updates).
    pub fn set_local_addr_if_changed(&mut self, addr: u64) {
        if self.last_local_addr != Some(addr) {
            self.last_local_addr = Some(addr);
            self.set_local_addr(addr);
        }
    }

    /// The address to jump the disassembly to *now* because the teammate we follow moved there —
    /// `Some` only when the followed address changed since the last jump, so we do not fight the
    /// user's own scrolling while they sit on a followed location.
    pub fn take_follow_jump(&mut self) -> Option<u64> {
        let target = self.follow_addr();
        if target != self.last_follow {
            self.last_follow = target;
            return target;
        }
        None
    }

    /// Bidirectionally reconciles `doc`'s annotations (names, comments, bookmarks) with the shared
    /// CRDT, using the last-synced snapshot as the three-way-merge base: local edits are pushed to
    /// the room (local wins a tie), teammates' edits are applied to `doc`. Call every frame while a
    /// session is connected, with the active document. Returns whether `doc` changed (so the UI can
    /// refresh and persist).
    ///
    /// Only the room's binary is bridged: the first analysed document after connecting pins the
    /// room to its SHA-256, and any other file is left alone (the panel says so) — so switching
    /// files never pushes one binary's names as deletions or merges them into another's room.
    pub fn bridge(&mut self, doc: &mut Document) -> bool {
        if self.session.is_none() {
            return false;
        }
        let sha = doc.annotations.sha256.clone();
        if sha.is_empty() {
            return false; // not analysed yet: its annotations are not loaded
        }
        match &self.room_sha {
            None => {
                self.room_sha = Some(sha.clone());
                self.room_file = Some(doc.file_name());
            }
            Some(room) if *room != sha => {
                self.other_file = Some(doc.file_name());
                return false;
            }
            Some(_) => {}
        }
        self.other_file = None;
        // The merge base must come from this document. If it does not (first sync), start from
        // an empty base: the initial merge shares this file's annotations and takes the room's.
        if self.synced_sha.as_deref() != Some(sha.as_str()) {
            self.synced_names.clear();
            self.synced_comments.clear();
            self.synced_bookmarks.clear();
            self.synced_sha = Some(sha);
        }
        let mut changed = false;
        let session = self.session.as_ref().unwrap();

        // Names (validated on inbound, so a peer cannot inject an illegal identifier).
        let crdt_names = session.doc.renames();
        changed |= reconcile_map(
            &mut doc.annotations.names,
            &crdt_names,
            &self.synced_names,
            |addr, name| session.doc.set_rename(addr, name),
            |addr| session.doc.remove_rename(addr),
            |name| validate_name(name).is_ok(),
        );

        // Comments (free text).
        let crdt_comments = session.doc.comments();
        changed |= reconcile_map(
            &mut doc.annotations.comments,
            &crdt_comments,
            &self.synced_comments,
            |addr, text| session.doc.set_comment(addr, text),
            |addr| session.doc.remove_comment(addr),
            |_| true,
        );

        // Bookmarks (a local set <-> a CRDT map keyed by address; the label is unused here).
        let crdt_bm = session.doc.bookmarks();
        let bm_addrs: BTreeSet<u64> = doc
            .annotations
            .bookmarks
            .iter()
            .chain(crdt_bm.keys())
            .chain(self.synced_bookmarks.iter())
            .copied()
            .collect();
        for addr in bm_addrs {
            let local = doc.annotations.bookmarks.contains(&addr);
            let remote = crdt_bm.contains_key(&addr);
            let base = self.synced_bookmarks.contains(&addr);
            if local != base {
                if local {
                    session.doc.set_bookmark(addr, "");
                } else {
                    session.doc.remove_bookmark(addr);
                }
            } else if remote != base {
                if remote {
                    changed |= doc.annotations.bookmarks.insert(addr);
                } else {
                    changed |= doc.annotations.bookmarks.remove(&addr);
                }
            }
        }

        // New baseline: whatever the CRDT now holds (which both sides have converged to).
        self.synced_names = session.doc.renames();
        self.synced_comments = session.doc.comments();
        self.synced_bookmarks = session.doc.bookmarks().into_keys().collect();

        if changed {
            doc.touch_annotations();
        }
        changed
    }
}

/// Three-way merges one annotation dimension (`local` vs the shared `remote`, against the
/// last-synced `base`): local-only changes are pushed to the room (and win a concurrent tie),
/// remote-only changes are applied to `local`. Returns whether `local` changed.
fn reconcile_map(
    local: &mut BTreeMap<u64, String>,
    remote: &BTreeMap<u64, String>,
    base: &BTreeMap<u64, String>,
    mut push: impl FnMut(u64, &str),
    mut remove: impl FnMut(u64),
    valid: impl Fn(&str) -> bool,
) -> bool {
    let mut changed = false;
    let addrs: BTreeSet<u64> = local
        .keys()
        .chain(remote.keys())
        .chain(base.keys())
        .copied()
        .collect();
    for addr in addrs {
        let local_v = local.get(&addr);
        let remote_v = remote.get(&addr);
        let base_v = base.get(&addr);
        if local_v != base_v {
            // Edited locally since the last sync — push it (local wins a conflict).
            match local_v {
                Some(v) => push(addr, v),
                None => remove(addr),
            }
        } else if remote_v != base_v {
            // Only a teammate changed it — apply to the local document.
            match remote_v {
                Some(v) if valid(v) => {
                    local.insert(addr, v.clone());
                    changed = true;
                }
                Some(_) => {} // an invalid inbound value (e.g. a bad name) is ignored
                None => {
                    if local.remove(&addr).is_some() {
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    changed
}

/// Renders the Collaboration tab.
pub fn collab_panel(ui: &mut Ui, view: &mut CollabView) {
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.label(RichText::new("Collaboration").strong());
        ui.label(muted("team CTFs · shared project · follow mode"));
    });
    ui.separator();

    match view.session.is_some() {
        false => connect_form(ui, view),
        true => connected(ui, view),
    }

    ui.add_space(8.0);
    ui.separator();
    ctf_browser(ui, view);
}

fn connect_form(ui: &mut Ui, view: &mut CollabView) {
    ui.label(muted("Join a team room. Everything is end-to-end encrypted with the passphrase; the relay never sees your work."));
    egui::Grid::new("collab-connect")
        .num_columns(2)
        .spacing([8.0, 4.0])
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            ui.label("Relay URL:");
            ui.text_edit_singleline(&mut view.url);
            ui.end_row();
            ui.label("Room:");
            ui.text_edit_singleline(&mut view.room);
            ui.end_row();
            ui.label("Passphrase:");
            ui.add(egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut view.pass).password(true));
            ui.end_row();
            ui.label("Your name:");
            ui.text_edit_singleline(&mut view.name);
            ui.end_row();
        });
    let ready =
        !view.room.trim().is_empty() && !view.pass.is_empty() && !view.name.trim().is_empty();
    let connecting = view.connecting.is_some();
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        if ui
            .add_enabled(ready && !connecting, egui::Button::new("Connect"))
            .clicked()
        {
            start_connect(ui.ctx(), view);
        }
        if connecting {
            ui.spinner();
            ui.label(muted("connecting…"));
        }
    });
    if let Some(s) = &view.status {
        ui.colored_label(ui.visuals().error_fg_color, s);
    }
}

/// Connects on a worker thread: the passphrase key derivation is deliberately slow and the relay
/// handshake blocks on the network, neither of which may freeze the UI. [`CollabView::tick`]
/// adopts the session when it is ready.
fn start_connect(ctx: &egui::Context, view: &mut CollabView) {
    let id = format!("{}-{}", view.name.trim(), now_ms());
    let peer = Peer::new(id, view.name.trim());
    let (url, room, pass) = (
        view.url.trim().to_string(),
        view.room.trim().to_string(),
        view.pass.clone(),
    );
    let (tx, rx) = std::sync::mpsc::channel();
    let ctx = ctx.clone();
    let spawned = std::thread::Builder::new()
        .name("orress-collab-connect".into())
        .spawn(move || {
            let _ = tx.send(CollabSession::connect(&url, &room, &pass, peer));
            ctx.request_repaint();
        });
    match spawned {
        Ok(_) => {
            view.connecting = Some(rx);
            view.status = None;
        }
        Err(e) => view.status = Some(format!("could not start connecting: {e}")),
    }
}

fn connected(ui: &mut Ui, view: &mut CollabView) {
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.colored_label(Color32::from_rgb(0x4c, 0xaf, 0x50), "● connected");
        ui.label(muted(format!("room {}", view.room.trim())));
        if ui.button("Disconnect").clicked() {
            view.session = None;
            view.reset_sync();
        }
    });
    let Some(session) = &mut view.session else {
        return;
    };

    // Presence + follow mode.
    ui.add_space(6.0);
    ui.label(RichText::new("Team").strong());
    let following = session.presence().following().map(str::to_string);
    let peers: Vec<Peer> = session.presence().peers().into_iter().cloned().collect();
    if peers.is_empty() {
        ui.label(muted("No teammates connected yet."));
    }
    let mut follow: Option<String> = None;
    let mut unfollow = false;
    for p in &peers {
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            let [r, g, b] = [(p.color >> 16) as u8, (p.color >> 8) as u8, p.color as u8];
            ui.colored_label(Color32::from_rgb(r, g, b), "●");
            ui.label(&p.name);
            match p.addr {
                Some(a) => ui.label(muted(format!("@ {a:#x}"))),
                None => ui.label(muted("idle")),
            };
            if following.as_deref() == Some(p.id.as_str()) {
                if ui.small_button("unfollow").clicked() {
                    unfollow = true;
                }
            } else if ui.small_button("follow").clicked() {
                follow = Some(p.id.clone());
            }
        });
    }
    if let Some(id) = follow {
        session.follow(&id);
    }
    if unfollow {
        session.unfollow();
    }

    // Claims.
    ui.add_space(6.0);
    ui.label(RichText::new("Claims").strong());
    for (challenge, who) in session.doc.claims() {
        ui.label(muted(format!("{challenge} — {who}")));
    }
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.add(
            egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut view.claim_input)
                .hint_text("challenge id")
                .desired_width(140.0),
        );
        if ui.button("Claim").clicked() && !view.claim_input.trim().is_empty() {
            session.doc.claim(view.claim_input.trim(), view.name.trim());
            view.claim_input.clear();
        }
    });

    // Shared annotations (read-only summary of what the team has recorded).
    let (renames, comments, bookmarks) = (
        session.doc.renames().len(),
        session.doc.comments().len(),
        session.doc.bookmarks().len(),
    );
    ui.add_space(4.0);
    ui.label(muted(format!(
        "shared: {renames} renames · {comments} comments · {bookmarks} bookmarks"
    )));
    match (&view.room_file, &view.other_file) {
        (_, Some(other)) => {
            ui.colored_label(
                ui.visuals().warn_fg_color,
                format!(
                    "{other} is not this room's binary ({}), so its annotations are not shared. \
                     Switch back to that file to sync.",
                    view.room_file.as_deref().unwrap_or("?")
                ),
            );
        }
        (Some(file), None) => {
            ui.label(muted(format!("syncing annotations of {file}")));
        }
        (None, None) => {
            ui.label(muted(
                "Open the challenge binary: the first analysed file becomes the room's binary.",
            ));
        }
    }

    // Chat.
    ui.add_space(6.0);
    ui.label(RichText::new("Chat").strong());
    let chat = session.doc.chat();
    egui::ScrollArea::vertical()
        .max_height(140.0)
        .stick_to_bottom(true)
        .id_salt("collab-chat")
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            for m in &chat {
                chat_line(ui, m);
            }
        });
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        let send = ui
            .add(
                egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut view.chat_input)
                    .hint_text("message…")
                    .desired_width(ui.available_width() - 60.0),
            )
            .lost_focus()
            && ui.input(|i| i.key_pressed(egui::Key::Enter));
        if (ui.button("Send").clicked() || send) && !view.chat_input.trim().is_empty() {
            session.doc.post_chat(&ChatMessage {
                peer: view.name.trim().to_string(),
                text: view.chat_input.trim().to_string(),
                ts: now_ms(),
                addr: None,
            });
            view.chat_input.clear();
        }
    });
}

fn chat_line(ui: &mut Ui, m: &ChatMessage) {
    ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
        ui.label(RichText::new(format!("{}:", m.peer)).strong());
        ui.label(&m.text);
        if let Some(a) = m.addr {
            ui.label(muted(format!("@ {a:#x}")));
        }
    });
}

fn ctf_browser(ui: &mut Ui, view: &mut CollabView) {
    ui.label(RichText::new("CTF challenges").strong());
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt("ctf-platform")
            .selected_text(match view.platform {
                Platform::Ctfd => "CTFd",
                Platform::Rctf => "rCTF",
            })
            .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                ui.selectable_value(&mut view.platform, Platform::Ctfd, "CTFd");
                ui.selectable_value(&mut view.platform, Platform::Rctf, "rCTF");
            });
        ui.add(
            egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut view.ctf_base)
                .hint_text("https://ctf.example.com")
                .desired_width(220.0),
        );
    });
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.add(
            egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut view.ctf_token)
                .password(true)
                .hint_text("API token")
                .desired_width(220.0),
        );
        let busy = view.ctf_busy.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        let ready = !busy && !view.ctf_base.trim().is_empty() && !view.ctf_token.trim().is_empty();
        if ui.add_enabled(ready, egui::Button::new("Load")).clicked() {
            load_challenges(view);
        }
        if busy {
            ui.spinner();
        }
    });
    if let Some(s) = view.ctf_status.lock().unwrap().as_ref() {
        ui.label(muted(s));
    }

    let challenges = view.challenges.lock().unwrap().clone();
    egui::ScrollArea::vertical()
        .max_height(220.0)
        .id_salt("ctf-list")
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            for ch in &challenges {
                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                    let mark = if ch.solved { "✔ " } else { "" };
                    ui.label(format!(
                        "{mark}{} [{}] {}pts",
                        ch.name, ch.category, ch.value
                    ));
                });
                ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                    let flag = view.flags.entry(ch.id.clone()).or_default();
                    ui.add(
                        egui::TextEdit::singleline(flag)
                            .hint_text("flag{…}")
                            .desired_width(220.0),
                    );
                    if ui.button("Submit").clicked() {
                        submit_flag(view, &ch.id);
                    }
                });
            }
        });
}

fn client(view: &CollabView) -> CtfClient {
    CtfClient::new(view.platform, view.ctf_base.trim(), view.ctf_token.trim())
}

fn load_challenges(view: &CollabView) {
    let client = client(view);
    let out = Arc::clone(&view.challenges);
    let busy = Arc::clone(&view.ctf_busy);
    let status = Arc::clone(&view.ctf_status);
    busy.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
    *status.lock().unwrap() = None;
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        match client.challenges() {
            Ok(list) => {
                *status.lock().unwrap() = Some(format!("{} challenges", list.len()));
                *out.lock().unwrap() = list;
            }
            Err(e) => *status.lock().unwrap() = Some(e),
        }
        busy.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    });
}

fn submit_flag(view: &CollabView, id: &str) {
    let flag = view.flags.get(id).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
    if flag.trim().is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let client = client(view);
    let status = Arc::clone(&view.ctf_status);
    let busy = Arc::clone(&view.ctf_busy);
    let id = id.to_string();
    busy.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let msg = match client.submit(&id, flag.trim()) {
            Ok(o) if o.correct => format!("✔ {id}: {}", o.message),
            Ok(o) if o.already_solved => format!("{id}: already solved"),
            Ok(o) => format!("✘ {id}: {}", o.message),
            Err(e) => format!("{id}: {e}"),
        };
        *status.lock().unwrap() = Some(msg);
        busy.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    });
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::reconcile_map;
    use std::collections::BTreeMap;

    fn map(pairs: &[(u64, &str)]) -> BTreeMap<u64, String> {
        pairs.iter().map(|(a, v)| (*a, v.to_string())).collect()
    }

    #[test]
    fn pushes_local_edits_and_applies_remote_edits() {
        let base = BTreeMap::new();
        let mut local = map(&[(0x10, "local_fn")]); // added locally
        let remote = map(&[(0x20, "remote_fn")]); // added by a teammate
        let (mut pushes, mut removes) = (Vec::new(), Vec::new());
        let changed = reconcile_map(
            &mut local,
            &remote,
            &base,
            |a, v| pushes.push((a, v.to_string())),
            |a| removes.push(a),
            |_| true,
        );
        assert!(changed);
        assert_eq!(local.get(&0x20).map(String::as_str), Some("remote_fn")); // remote applied
        assert_eq!(pushes, vec![(0x10, "local_fn".to_string())]); // local pushed to the room
        assert!(removes.is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn local_edit_wins_a_conflict() {
        let base = map(&[(0x10, "old")]);
        let mut local = map(&[(0x10, "mine")]);
        let remote = map(&[(0x10, "theirs")]);
        let (mut pushes, mut removes) = (Vec::new(), Vec::new());
        let changed = reconcile_map(
            &mut local,
            &remote,
            &base,
            |a, v| pushes.push((a, v.to_string())),
            |a| removes.push(a),
            |_| true,
        );
        assert!(!changed); // local was not overwritten
        assert_eq!(local.get(&0x10).map(String::as_str), Some("mine"));
        assert_eq!(pushes, vec![(0x10, "mine".to_string())]); // local wins: pushed to the room
    }

    #[test]
    fn remote_removal_applies_and_local_removal_pushes() {
        // Remote removed a key both sides had.
        let base = map(&[(0x10, "x")]);
        let mut local = map(&[(0x10, "x")]);
        let remote = BTreeMap::new();
        let (mut pushes, mut removes) = (Vec::new(), Vec::new());
        let changed = reconcile_map(
            &mut local,
            &remote,
            &base,
            |a, v| pushes.push((a, v.to_string())),
            |a| removes.push(a),
            |_| true,
        );
        assert!(changed && local.is_empty() && pushes.is_empty() && removes.is_empty());

        // Local removed a key both sides had -> push a removal.
        let mut local2 = BTreeMap::new();
        let (mut pushes2, mut removes2): (Vec<(u64, String)>, Vec<u64>) = (Vec::new(), Vec::new());
        let changed2 = reconcile_map(
            &mut local2,
            &base,
            &base,
            |a, v| pushes2.push((a, v.to_string())),
            |a| removes2.push(a),
            |_| true,
        );
        assert!(!changed2 && removes2 == vec![0x10]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn invalid_inbound_value_is_ignored() {
        let base = BTreeMap::new();
        let mut local = BTreeMap::new();
        let remote = map(&[(0x10, "bad name")]);
        let (mut pushes, mut removes) = (Vec::new(), Vec::new());
        let changed = reconcile_map(
            &mut local,
            &remote,
            &base,
            |a, v| pushes.push((a, v.to_string())),
            |a| removes.push(a),
            |n| !n.contains(' '),
        );
        assert!(!changed && local.is_empty());
    }
}
```

`crates/orress-views/src/colors.rs`:

```rs
use egui::Color32;

/// Color for an entropy value (0..=8): blue for low, green for code-like, yellow for
/// dense, red for compressed or encrypted.
pub fn entropy_color(entropy: f32) -> Color32 {
    const STOPS: [(f32, [u8; 3]); 5] = [
        (0.0, [20, 30, 70]),
        (3.0, [40, 90, 170]),
        (5.5, [60, 170, 90]),
        (7.0, [230, 200, 60]),
        (8.0, [220, 60, 50]),
    ];
    let e = entropy.clamp(0.0, 8.0);
    for pair in STOPS.windows(2) {
        let ((a, ca), (b, cb)) = (pair[0], pair[1]);
        if e <= b {
            let t = (e - a) / (b - a);
            let mix = |i: usize| {
                (f32::from(ca[i]) + (f32::from(cb[i]) - f32::from(ca[i])) * t).round() as u8
            };
            return Color32::from_rgb(mix(0), mix(1), mix(2));
        }
    }
    Color32::from_rgb(220, 60, 50)
}

/// A distinct, readable color per section index, for the section bands in the hex view.
pub fn section_color(index: usize) -> Color32 {
    const PALETTE: [Color32; 8] = [
        Color32::from_rgb(97, 175, 239),
        Color32::from_rgb(152, 195, 121),
        Color32::from_rgb(229, 192, 123),
        Color32::from_rgb(198, 120, 221),
        Color32::from_rgb(86, 182, 194),
        Color32::from_rgb(224, 108, 117),
        Color32::from_rgb(209, 154, 102),
        Color32::from_rgb(171, 178, 191),
    ];
    PALETTE[index % PALETTE.len()]
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn entropy_colors_cover_range() {
        assert_eq!(entropy_color(-1.0), Color32::from_rgb(20, 30, 70));
        assert_eq!(entropy_color(8.0), Color32::from_rgb(220, 60, 50));
        assert_eq!(entropy_color(99.0), Color32::from_rgb(220, 60, 50));
        assert_ne!(entropy_color(5.5), entropy_color(7.0));
    }
}
```
