`crates/orress-views/src/graph.rs`:

```rs
//! Graph view: the function under the cursor as a flow chart of basic blocks.

use std::sync::Arc;

use egui::{
    Color32, FontId, Key, Modifiers, Pos2, Rect, RichText, Sense, Shape, Stroke, StrokeKind, Ui,
    Vec2,
};
use orress_analysis::{EdgeKind, Function, Program};
use orress_project::Document;
use orress_ui::ExplainExt as _;

use crate::code::{self, Style, Target};
use crate::edit::{self, EditPopup};
use crate::graph_layout::{self, Layout};
use crate::{DocView, ViewCtx, ViewRequest, menu};

const MIN_ZOOM: f32 = 0.04;
const MAX_ZOOM: f32 = 2.5;

struct Cached {
    entry: u64,
    generation: u64,
    layout: Layout,
    /// Per node: block start and the addresses of its lines (first line is the label).
    blocks: Vec<(u64, Vec<u64>)>,
    edge_kinds: Vec<EdgeKind>,
}

pub struct GraphState {
    cache: Option<Cached>,
    pan: Vec2,
    zoom: f32,
    last_cursor: Option<u64>,
    popup: Option<EditPopup>,
    fit: bool,
    /// The right-clicked instruction and the address under the pointer, if any.
    menu: Option<(u64, Option<u64>)>,
}

impl Default for GraphState {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            cache: None,
            pan: Vec2::new(40.0, 20.0),
            zoom: 1.0,
            last_cursor: None,
            popup: None,
            fit: false,
            menu: None,
        }
    }
}

fn style(ui: &Ui, program: &Program, size: f32) -> Style {
    Style {
        font: FontId::monospace(size),
        colors: code::syntax(ui.ctx()),
        text: ui.visuals().text_color(),
        muted: ui.visuals().weak_text_color(),
        wide: program.isa.pointer_size() == 8,
        show_address: false,
        show_bytes: false,
    }
}

fn build(ui: &Ui, doc: &Document, program: &Program, f: &Function) -> Cached {
    let st = style(ui, program, 13.0);
    let index_of = |addr: u64| f.blocks.iter().position(|b| b.start == addr);
    let mut sizes = Vec::new();
    let mut blocks = Vec::new();
    for b in &f.blocks {
        let mut width = label(doc, f, b.start).chars().count();
        for &a in &b.insns {
            if let Some(insn) = program.decode(a) {
                width = width.max(code::render_insn(doc, program, &insn, &st).chars);
            }
        }
        sizes.push(Vec2::new(width as f32 + 2.0, b.insns.len() as f32 + 1.6));
        let mut lines = vec![b.start];
        lines.extend(&b.insns);
        blocks.push((b.start, lines));
    }
    let mut edges = Vec::new();
    let mut edge_kinds = Vec::new();
    for (i, b) in f.blocks.iter().enumerate() {
        for e in &b.succs {
            if let Some(j) = index_of(e.target) {
                edges.push((i, j));
                edge_kinds.push(e.kind);
            }
        }
    }
    let root = index_of(f.entry).unwrap_or(0);
    Cached {
        entry: f.entry,
        generation: doc.generation,
        layout: graph_layout::layout(&sizes, &edges, root),
        blocks,
        edge_kinds,
    }
}

fn label(doc: &Document, f: &Function, start: u64) -> String {
    let name = doc.name_of(start).unwrap_or_else(|| {
        if start == f.entry {
            format!("sub_{start:x}")
        } else {
            format!("loc_{start:x}")
        }
    });
    format!("{name}:")
}

pub fn graph_view(ui: &mut Ui, doc: &mut Document, state: &mut GraphState, cx: &mut ViewCtx<'_>) {
    let Some(program) = crate::program_or_message(ui, doc) else {
        return;
    };
    cx.commands.clear();
    let cursor_addr = program.memory.address_of(doc.cursor);
    let Some(function) = cursor_addr.and_then(|a| program.function_containing(a)) else {
        ui.label(
            "The cursor is not inside a known function. Pick a function in the Functions list \
             or the disassembly, then come back here (Space).",
        );
        return;
    };

    let rebuild = state
        .cache
        .as_ref()
        .is_none_or(|c| c.entry != function.entry || c.generation != doc.generation);
    let new_function = state
        .cache
        .as_ref()
        .is_none_or(|c| c.entry != function.entry);
    if rebuild {
        state.cache = Some(build(ui, doc, &program, function));
    }
    // Taken out for the frame so the rest of `state` can be borrowed mutably.
    let Some(cache) = state.cache.take() else {
        return;
    };

    toolbar(ui, doc, &program, function, state);
    let font = FontId::monospace(13.0);
    let (char_w, row_h) = ui.fonts_mut(|f| (f.glyph_width(&font, '0'), f.row_height(&font) + 2.0));
    let rect = ui.available_rect_before_wrap();
    let id = ui.id().with("graph");
    let response = ui.interact(rect, id, Sense::click_and_drag());
    let response = response.note(
        "Graph view",
        "Each box is a basic block: instructions that always run together, top to bottom. \
         Arrows show where execution can go next. Green: the jump is taken (condition true). \
         Red: not taken (condition false). Blue: always. Arrows looping back up are loops. \
         Drag to move, Ctrl+scroll to zoom, Space for the linear listing.",
    );
    if response.clicked() || response.drag_started() {
        response.request_focus();
    }
    let focused = response.has_focus() && state.popup.is_none();

    // Zoom (Ctrl+scroll / pinch) around the pointer, pan with drag and scroll.
    let zoom_delta = ui.input(|i| i.zoom_delta());
    if zoom_delta != 1.0 && ui.rect_contains_pointer(rect) {
        let pointer = ui.input(|i| i.pointer.hover_pos()).unwrap_or(rect.center());
        let before = (pointer - rect.min - state.pan) / state.zoom;
        state.zoom = (state.zoom * zoom_delta).clamp(MIN_ZOOM, MAX_ZOOM);
        state.pan = pointer - rect.min - before * state.zoom;
    } else if ui.rect_contains_pointer(rect) {
        state.pan += ui.input(|i| i.smooth_scroll_delta);
    }
    if response.dragged() {
        state.pan += response.drag_delta();
    }

    if std::mem::take(&mut state.fit) {
        let b = cache.layout.bounds;
        let zx = rect.width() / (b.width().max(1.0) * char_w * 1.05);
        let zy = rect.height() / (b.height().max(1.0) * row_h * 1.05);
        state.zoom = zx.min(zy).clamp(MIN_ZOOM, MAX_ZOOM);
        let size = Vec2::new(b.width() * char_w, b.height() * row_h) * state.zoom;
        state.pan =
            (rect.size() - size) / 2.0 - Vec2::new(b.left() * char_w, b.top() * row_h) * state.zoom;
        state.last_cursor = Some(doc.cursor);
    }
    let sx = char_w * state.zoom;
    let sy = row_h * state.zoom;
    let to_screen = |p: Pos2| rect.min + state.pan + Vec2::new(p.x * sx, p.y * sy);

    // Keep the cursor's block in view when the cursor moves (or a new function opens).
    let cursor_block = cursor_addr.and_then(|a| {
        cache
            .blocks
            .iter()
            .position(|(_, lines)| lines[1..].contains(&a))
            .or_else(|| {
                function
                    .block_at(a)
                    .and_then(|b| cache.blocks.iter().position(|(s, _)| *s == b.start))
            })
    });
    if state.last_cursor != Some(doc.cursor) || new_function {
        state.last_cursor = Some(doc.cursor);
        let node = cursor_block.unwrap_or(0);
        if let Some(r) = cache.layout.nodes.get(node) {
            let screen = Rect::from_min_max(to_screen(r.min), to_screen(r.max));
            if new_function || !rect.contains_rect(screen) {
                // A new function starts at the top; a moved cursor goes a bit lower so
                // the blocks above it stay in sight.
                let y = if new_function {
                    rect.top() + 24.0
                } else {
                    rect.top() + rect.height() * 0.25
                };
                let target = Pos2::new(rect.center().x, y);
                state.pan += target - Pos2::new(screen.center().x, screen.top());
            }
        }
    }
    let to_screen = |p: Pos2| rect.min + state.pan + Vec2::new(p.x * sx, p.y * sy);

    let painter = ui.painter_at(rect);
    painter.rect_filled(rect, 0.0, ui.visuals().extreme_bg_color);
    let colors = code::syntax(ui.ctx());

    // Edges first, under the blocks.
    for (path, kind) in cache.layout.edges.iter().zip(&cache.edge_kinds) {
        let color = match kind {
            EdgeKind::Taken => Color32::from_rgb(80, 180, 90),
            EdgeKind::NotTaken => Color32::from_rgb(215, 85, 80),
            EdgeKind::Jump | EdgeKind::FallThrough => Color32::from_rgb(90, 140, 220),
        };
        let points: Vec<Pos2> = path.points.iter().map(|&p| to_screen(p)).collect();
        // Arrows into and out of the current block stand out.
        let touching = cursor_block.is_some_and(|c| path.from == c || path.to == c);
        let width = if touching {
            2.6
        } else if path.back {
            1.2
        } else {
            1.6
        };
        let stroke = Stroke::new(width, color);
        painter.add(Shape::line(points.clone(), stroke));
        if let [.., before, end] = points.as_slice() {
            let dir = (*end - *before).normalized();
            let side = Vec2::new(-dir.y, dir.x) * 4.0;
            let tip = *end;
            let base = tip - dir * 8.0;
            painter.add(Shape::convex_polygon(
                vec![tip, base + side, base - side],
                color,
                Stroke::NONE,
            ));
        }
    }

    // Blocks.
    let draw_text = state.zoom >= 0.35;
    let st = style(ui, &program, 13.0 * state.zoom);
    let mut hits: Vec<(Rect, u64, Vec<code::Span>)> = Vec::new();
    for (i, node) in cache.layout.nodes.iter().enumerate() {
        let screen = Rect::from_min_max(to_screen(node.min), to_screen(node.max));
        if !screen.intersects(rect) {
            continue;
        }
        let current = Some(i) == cursor_block;
        let entry = cache.blocks[i].0 == function.entry;
        painter.rect_filled(screen, 4.0 * state.zoom, ui.visuals().window_fill);
        let border = if current {
            Stroke::new(2.0, ui.visuals().selection.stroke.color)
        } else if entry {
            Stroke::new(1.5, colors.function.0)
        } else {
            Stroke::new(1.0, ui.visuals().widgets.noninteractive.bg_stroke.color)
        };
        painter.rect_stroke(screen, 4.0 * state.zoom, border, StrokeKind::Inside);
        if !draw_text {
            continue;
        }
        let (start, lines) = &cache.blocks[i];
        for (row, &addr) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
            let y = screen.top() + (0.3 + row as f32) * sy;
            let x = screen.left() + sx;
            let line_rect =
                Rect::from_min_size(Pos2::new(screen.left(), y), Vec2::new(screen.width(), sy));
            if row == 0 {
                let text = label(doc, function, *start);
                let color = if entry {
                    colors.function.0
                } else {
                    colors.label.0
                };
                painter.text(
                    Pos2::new(x, y),
                    egui::Align2::LEFT_TOP,
                    text,
                    st.font.clone(),
                    color,
                );
                continue;
            }
            if Some(addr) == cursor_addr {
                painter.rect_filled(line_rect, 0.0, ui.visuals().selection.bg_fill);
            }
            if let Some(insn) = program.decode(addr) {
                let rendered = code::render_insn(doc, &program, &insn, &st);
                let galley = ui.fonts_mut(|f| f.layout_job(rendered.job));
                painter.galley(Pos2::new(x, y), galley, st.text);
                hits.push((line_rect, addr, rendered.spans));
            }
        }
    }

    // Clicks: on an address token navigate, on a line move the cursor.
    let hit_at = |pos: Pos2| {
        let (r, addr, spans) = hits.iter().find(|(r, _, _)| r.contains(pos))?;
        let column = ((pos.x - r.left() - sx) / sx).floor();
        let span = (column >= 0.0)
            .then(|| code::span_at(spans, column as usize))
            .flatten()
            .cloned();
        Some((*addr, span))
    };
    if let Some(pos) = response.hover_pos()
        && let Some((_, Some(span))) = hit_at(pos)
    {
        match &span.target {
            Target::Mnemonic(m) => {
                if let Some(text) = orress_arch::explain::mnemonic(program.isa, m) {
                    response.clone().explain(m, text);
                }
            }
            Target::Register(r) => {
                if let Some(text) = orress_arch::explain::register(program.isa, r) {
                    response.clone().explain(r, text);
                }
            }
            Target::Number(value) => {
                response
                    .clone()
                    .on_hover_text_at_pointer(code::describe_number(*value));
            }
            Target::Address(a) => {
                ui.ctx().set_cursor_icon(egui::CursorIcon::PointingHand);
                let name = doc.name_of(*a).unwrap_or_else(|| format!("0x{a:x}"));
                response
                    .clone()
                    .on_hover_text_at_pointer(format!("{name}\nclick to go there"));
            }
        }
    }
    if response.clicked()
        && let Some(pos) = response.interact_pointer_pos()
        && let Some((addr, span)) = hit_at(pos)
    {
        match span.map(|s| s.target) {
            Some(Target::Address(a)) => {
                doc.navigate_to_address(a);
            }
            _ => {
                if let Some(offset) = program.memory.offset_of(addr) {
                    doc.go_to(offset);
                    state.last_cursor = Some(doc.cursor);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Right click: move the cursor to that instruction, then show what can be done there.
    if response.secondary_clicked()
        && let Some(pos) = response.interact_pointer_pos()
        && let Some((addr, span)) = hit_at(pos)
    {
        if let Some(offset) = program.memory.offset_of(addr) {
            doc.go_to(offset);
            state.last_cursor = Some(doc.cursor);
        }
        let target = match span.map(|s| s.target) {
            Some(Target::Address(a)) => Some(a),
            _ => None,
        };
        state.menu = Some((addr, target));
    }
    response.context_menu(|ui| {
        if let Some((addr, target)) = state.menu {
            context_menu(ui, doc, &program, function, state, addr, target, cx);
        }
    });

    if focused {
        keyboard(ui, doc, &program, function, state, cx);
    }
    if let Some(popup) = &mut state.popup
        && !edit::show(ui, doc, popup)
    {
        state.popup = None;
        response.request_focus();
    }
    state.cache = Some(cache);
}

fn toolbar(
    ui: &mut Ui,
    doc: &Document,
    program: &Arc<Program>,
    f: &Function,
    state: &mut GraphState,
) {
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        let name = doc
            .name_of(f.entry)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("sub_{:x}", f.entry));
        ui.label(RichText::new(name).monospace().strong());
        ui.label(
            RichText::new(format!(
                "{} blocks · {} instructions · {} bytes · {} callers",
                f.blocks.len(),
                f.insn_count(),
                f.size(),
                program.xrefs(f.entry).len()
            ))
            .weak(),
        );
        ui.separator();
        if ui.small_button("−").clicked() {
            state.zoom = (state.zoom / 1.25).max(MIN_ZOOM);
        }
        ui.label(format!("{:.0}%", state.zoom * 100.0));
        if ui.small_button("+").clicked() {
            state.zoom = (state.zoom * 1.25).min(MAX_ZOOM);
        }
        if ui.small_button("100%").clicked() {
            state.zoom = 1.0;
            state.last_cursor = None;
        }
        if ui
            .small_button("Fit")
            .on_hover_text("Zoom to show the whole function")
            .clicked()
        {
            state.fit = true;
        }
        ui.separator();
        ui.label(
            RichText::new("green = taken · red = not taken · blue = always")
                .weak()
                .small(),
        );
    });
}

/// The right-click menu of an instruction in the graph.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn context_menu(
    ui: &mut Ui,
    doc: &mut Document,
    program: &Program,
    f: &Function,
    state: &mut GraphState,
    addr: u64,
    target: Option<u64>,
    cx: &mut ViewCtx<'_>,
) {
    ui.set_min_width(220.0);
    ui.style_mut().wrap_mode = Some(egui::TextWrapMode::Extend);
    let shortcut = |label: &str, keys: &str| egui::Button::new(label).shortcut_text(keys);
    if let Some(a) = target {
        let name = code::describe_address(doc, program, a);
        if ui.button(format!("Go to {name}")).clicked() {
            doc.navigate_to_address(a);
            ui.close();
        }
        if ui.button(format!("Rename {name}…")).clicked() {
            state.popup = Some(EditPopup::rename(doc, a));
            ui.close();
        }
        ui.separator();
    }
    let name = code::describe_address(doc, program, f.entry);
    if ui.add(shortcut(&format!("Rename {name}…"), "N")).clicked() {
        state.popup = Some(EditPopup::rename(doc, f.entry));
        ui.close();
    }
    if ui.add(shortcut("Comment…", ";")).clicked() {
        state.popup = Some(EditPopup::comment(doc, addr));
        ui.close();
    }
    if ui
        .add(shortcut(&format!("Cross-references to {name}"), "X"))
        .clicked()
    {
        doc.xref_target = Some(f.entry);
        cx.requests.push(ViewRequest::ShowXrefs);
        ui.close();
    }
    let has = cx.debugger.breakpoints().contains(&addr);
    if ui
        .button(if has {
            "Remove breakpoint"
        } else {
            "Set breakpoint"
        })
        .clicked()
    {
        cx.debugger.toggle_breakpoint(addr);
        ui.close();
    }
    crate::disasm::patch_menu(ui, doc, program, addr, cx);
    ui.menu_button("Copy", |ui| {
        menu::copy_item(ui, "Address", format!("0x{addr:x}"));
        if let Some(len) = program.insns.get(&addr)
            && let Some(bytes) = program.memory.read(addr, usize::from(*len))
        {
            let hex: Vec<String> = bytes.iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02X}")).collect();
            menu::copy_item(ui, "Instruction bytes", hex.join(" "));
        }
        menu::copy_item(ui, "Function name", name.clone());
    });
    ui.separator();
    if ui.add(shortcut("Show in disassembly", "Space")).clicked() {
        cx.requests
            .push(ViewRequest::Open(doc.path.clone(), DocView::Disassembly));
        ui.close();
    }
    menu::command(ui, cx.requests, "view::Decompiler");
    if ui.button("Fit the whole function").clicked() {
        state.fit = true;
        ui.close();
    }
    menu::views_and_commands(ui, cx.requests);
}

fn keyboard(
    ui: &Ui,
    doc: &mut Document,
    program: &Program,
    f: &Function,
    state: &mut GraphState,
    cx: &mut ViewCtx<'_>,
) {
    let press = |key| ui.input_mut(|i| i.consume_key(Modifiers::NONE, key));
    let cursor = program.memory.address_of(doc.cursor);
    if press(Key::Space) {
        cx.requests
            .push(ViewRequest::Open(doc.path.clone(), DocView::Disassembly));
    }
    if press(Key::Escape) || press(Key::Backspace) {
        doc.go_back();
    }
    if press(Key::N) {
        state.popup = Some(EditPopup::rename(doc, f.entry));
    }
    if press(Key::Semicolon)
        && let Some(addr) = cursor
    {
        state.popup = Some(EditPopup::comment(doc, addr));
    }
    if press(Key::X) {
        doc.xref_target = Some(f.entry);
        cx.requests.push(ViewRequest::ShowXrefs);
    }
}
```

`crates/orress-views/src/graph_layout.rs`:

```rs
//! Layered graph layout for control-flow graphs (a small Sugiyama-style layout).
//!
//! 1. Find back edges (loops) with a depth-first search, so the rest is acyclic.
//! 2. Put each node in a layer: the longest path from the entry.
//! 3. Order nodes within layers by the average position of their neighbors.
//! 4. Place nodes horizontally under their predecessors without overlapping.
//! 5. Route edges: forward edges go down, back edges loop around the left side.
//!
//! Sizes and positions are in abstract units (the view multiplies by the zoom).

use egui::{Pos2, Rect, Vec2};

pub const H_GAP: f32 = 4.0;
pub const V_GAP: f32 = 3.0;

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct EdgePath {
    pub from: usize,
    pub to: usize,
    pub points: Vec<Pos2>,
    pub back: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Layout {
    /// Top-left corner of each node.
    pub nodes: Vec<Rect>,
    pub edges: Vec<EdgePath>,
    pub bounds: Rect,
}

pub fn layout(sizes: &[Vec2], edges: &[(usize, usize)], root: usize) -> Layout {
    let n = sizes.len();
    if n == 0 {
        return Layout {
            nodes: Vec::new(),
            edges: Vec::new(),
            bounds: Rect::NOTHING,
        };
    }
    let mut succs = vec![Vec::new(); n];
    for &(a, b) in edges {
        succs[a].push(b);
    }

    // 1. Back edges via iterative DFS.
    let mut state = vec![0u8; n]; // 0 new, 1 on stack, 2 done
    let mut back = vec![false; edges.len()];
    let mut dfs_order = Vec::with_capacity(n);
    let mut roots: Vec<usize> = vec![root];
    roots.extend((0..n).filter(|&i| i != root));
    for r in roots {
        if state[r] != 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let mut stack = vec![(r, 0usize)];
        state[r] = 1;
        dfs_order.push(r);
        while let Some((node, i)) = stack.pop() {
            if i < succs[node].len() {
                stack.push((node, i + 1));
                let next = succs[node][i];
                match state[next] {
                    0 => {
                        state[next] = 1;
                        dfs_order.push(next);
                        stack.push((next, 0));
                    }
                    1 => {
                        for (e, &(a, b)) in edges.iter().enumerate() {
                            if a == node && b == next {
                                back[e] = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    _ => {}
                }
            } else {
                state[node] = 2;
            }
        }
    }

    // 2. Longest-path layering over forward edges (Kahn's algorithm).
    let mut indegree = vec![0usize; n];
    for (e, &(_, b)) in edges.iter().enumerate() {
        if !back[e] {
            indegree[b] += 1;
        }
    }
    let mut layer = vec![0usize; n];
    let mut queue: Vec<usize> = (0..n).filter(|&i| indegree[i] == 0).collect();
    while let Some(node) = queue.pop() {
        for (e, &(a, b)) in edges.iter().enumerate() {
            if a == node && !back[e] {
                layer[b] = layer[b].max(layer[a] + 1);
                indegree[b] -= 1;
                if indegree[b] == 0 {
                    queue.push(b);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let layers_count = layer.iter().max().map_or(1, |m| m + 1);

    // Dummy nodes: a forward edge that skips layers gets an invisible waypoint in every
    // layer it crosses, so ordering and placement route it around real blocks instead
    // of straight through them.
    let mut vsize: Vec<Vec2> = sizes.to_vec();
    let mut vlayer = layer.clone();
    let mut vpreds: Vec<Vec<usize>> = vec![Vec::new(); n];
    let mut vsuccs: Vec<Vec<usize>> = vec![Vec::new(); n];
    let mut chains: Vec<Vec<usize>> = vec![Vec::new(); edges.len()];
    for (e, &(a, b)) in edges.iter().enumerate() {
        if back[e] {
            continue;
        }
        let mut prev = a;
        for l in layer[a] + 1..layer[b] {
            let d = vsize.len();
            vsize.push(Vec2::new(1.0, 0.0));
            vlayer.push(l);
            vpreds.push(vec![prev]);
            vsuccs.push(Vec::new());
            vsuccs[prev].push(d);
            chains[e].push(d);
            prev = d;
        }
        vsuccs[prev].push(b);
        vpreds[b].push(prev);
    }
    let vn = vsize.len();
    let mut layers: Vec<Vec<usize>> = vec![Vec::new(); layers_count];
    for &node in &dfs_order {
        layers[layer[node]].push(node);
    }
    for d in n..vn {
        layers[vlayer[d]].push(d);
    }

    // 3. Barycenter ordering, a few sweeps down and up.
    let mut position = vec![0f32; vn];
    let refresh = |layers: &Vec<Vec<usize>>, position: &mut Vec<f32>| {
        for l in layers {
            for (i, &node) in l.iter().enumerate() {
                position[node] = i as f32;
            }
        }
    };
    refresh(&layers, &mut position);
    for sweep in 0..6 {
        let down = sweep % 2 == 0;
        let order: Vec<usize> = if down {
            (1..layers_count).collect()
        } else {
            (0..layers_count.saturating_sub(1)).rev().collect()
        };
        for li in order {
            let mut keyed: Vec<(f32, usize)> = layers[li]
                .iter()
                .map(|&node| {
                    let neighbors = if down { &vpreds[node] } else { &vsuccs[node] };
                    let key = if neighbors.is_empty() {
                        position[node]
                    } else {
                        neighbors.iter().map(|&m| position[m]).sum::<f32>() / neighbors.len() as f32
                    };
                    (key, node)
                })
                .collect();
            keyed.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.total_cmp(&b.0));
            layers[li] = keyed.into_iter().map(|(_, node)| node).collect();
            refresh(&layers, &mut position);
        }
    }

    // 4. Coordinates.
    let gap = |a: usize, b: usize| if a >= n || b >= n { H_GAP / 2.0 } else { H_GAP };
    let mut x = vec![0f32; vn];
    let mut layer_top = vec![0f32; layers_count];
    let mut layer_height = vec![0f32; layers_count];
    let mut top = 0f32;
    for (li, l) in layers.iter().enumerate() {
        let height = l.iter().map(|&i| vsize[i].y).fold(0.0, f32::max);
        let mut left = 0f32;
        for (k, &node) in l.iter().enumerate() {
            if k > 0 {
                left += gap(l[k - 1], node);
            }
            x[node] = left;
            left += vsize[node].x;
        }
        layer_top[li] = top;
        layer_height[li] = height;
        top += height + V_GAP * 2.0;
    }
    // Pull nodes under the center of their predecessors, keeping the layer order.
    for _ in 0..4 {
        for l in layers.iter().skip(1) {
            let mut wanted: Vec<f32> = l
                .iter()
                .map(|&node| {
                    let preds = &vpreds[node];
                    if preds.is_empty() {
                        x[node]
                    } else {
                        preds.iter().map(|&a| x[a] + vsize[a].x / 2.0).sum::<f32>()
                            / preds.len() as f32
                            - vsize[node].x / 2.0
                    }
                })
                .collect();
            // Remove overlaps once pushing right and once pushing left, then average the
            // two. Both satisfy the spacing constraints, so their average does too, and
            // the layout no longer drifts to one side.
            let mut right = wanted.clone();
            for i in 1..l.len() {
                let min = right[i - 1] + vsize[l[i - 1]].x + gap(l[i - 1], l[i]);
                right[i] = right[i].max(min);
            }
            for i in (0..l.len().saturating_sub(1)).rev() {
                let max = wanted[i + 1] - vsize[l[i]].x - gap(l[i], l[i + 1]);
                wanted[i] = wanted[i].min(max);
            }
            for (i, &node) in l.iter().enumerate() {
                x[node] = (wanted[i] + right[i]) / 2.0;
            }
        }
    }
    let min_x = x.iter().copied().fold(f32::INFINITY, f32::min);
    for v in &mut x {
        *v -= min_x;
    }

    let nodes: Vec<Rect> = (0..n)
        .map(|i| Rect::from_min_size(Pos2::new(x[i], layer_top[layer[i]]), sizes[i]))
        .collect();
    let mut bounds = nodes.iter().fold(Rect::NOTHING, |acc, r| acc.union(*r));

    // 5. Edge routes. Out-edges leave a node spread along its bottom; forward edges pass
    // through their dummy waypoints with right-angle bends.
    let mut paths = Vec::with_capacity(edges.len());
    let mut back_lane = 0f32;
    let mut outs = vec![0usize; n];
    let mut out_index = vec![0usize; edges.len()];
    for (e, &(a, _)) in edges.iter().enumerate() {
        out_index[e] = outs[a];
        outs[a] += 1;
    }
    for (e, &(a, b)) in edges.iter().enumerate() {
        let src = nodes[a];
        let dst = nodes[b];
        let start_x =
            src.left() + src.width() * (out_index[e] as f32 + 1.0) / (outs[a] as f32 + 1.0);
        let start = Pos2::new(start_x, src.bottom());
        let end = Pos2::new(dst.center().x, dst.top());
        let points = if back[e] {
            back_lane += 1.0;
            let lane = bounds.left() - 1.5 * back_lane;
            vec![
                start,
                Pos2::new(start.x, start.y + V_GAP * 0.5),
                Pos2::new(lane, start.y + V_GAP * 0.5),
                Pos2::new(lane, end.y - V_GAP * 0.5),
                Pos2::new(end.x, end.y - V_GAP * 0.5),
                end,
            ]
        } else {
            let mut waypoints = vec![start];
            for &d in &chains[e] {
                let cx = x[d] + 0.5;
                let li = vlayer[d];
                waypoints.push(Pos2::new(cx, layer_top[li]));
                waypoints.push(Pos2::new(cx, layer_top[li] + layer_height[li]));
            }
            waypoints.push(end);
            orthogonal(&waypoints)
        };
        for p in &points {
            bounds = bounds.union(Rect::from_min_size(*p, Vec2::ZERO));
        }
        paths.push(EdgePath {
            from: a,
            to: b,
            points,
            back: back[e],
        });
    }

    Layout {
        nodes,
        edges: paths,
        bounds,
    }
}

/// Joins waypoints with horizontal and vertical segments, bending halfway between them.
fn orthogonal(waypoints: &[Pos2]) -> Vec<Pos2> {
    let mut out = vec![waypoints[0]];
    for pair in waypoints.windows(2) {
        let (p, q) = (pair[0], pair[1]);
        if (p.x - q.x).abs() > 0.01 {
            let mid = (p.y + q.y) / 2.0;
            out.push(Pos2::new(p.x, mid));
            out.push(Pos2::new(q.x, mid));
        }
        out.push(q);
    }
    out
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn sizes(n: usize) -> Vec<Vec2> {
        vec![Vec2::new(10.0, 4.0); n]
    }

    #[test]
    fn if_else_diamond() {
        // 0 -> 1, 0 -> 2, 1 -> 3, 2 -> 3
        let l = layout(&sizes(4), &[(0, 1), (0, 2), (1, 3), (2, 3)], 0);
        assert!(l.nodes[0].top() < l.nodes[1].top());
        assert_eq!(
            l.nodes[1].top(),
            l.nodes[2].top(),
            "both branches on one layer"
        );
        assert!(l.nodes[3].top() > l.nodes[1].top());
        assert!(!l.nodes[1].intersects(l.nodes[2]), "no overlap");
        assert!(l.edges.iter().all(|e| !e.back));
    }

    #[test]
    fn loops_have_back_edges() {
        // 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 1 (loop), 1 -> 3
        let l = layout(&sizes(4), &[(0, 1), (1, 2), (2, 1), (1, 3)], 0);
        let back: Vec<_> = l.edges.iter().filter(|e| e.back).collect();
        assert_eq!(back.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!((back[0].from, back[0].to), (2, 1));
        assert!(l.nodes[2].top() > l.nodes[1].top());
    }

    #[test]
    fn handles_self_loop_unreachable_and_empty() {
        let l = layout(&sizes(3), &[(0, 0), (0, 1)], 0);
        assert_eq!(l.nodes.len(), 3);
        assert!(l.edges[0].back);
        assert!(layout(&[], &[], 0).nodes.is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn long_edges_go_around_blocks() {
        // 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3 and a long edge 0 -> 3 that skips two layers.
        let l = layout(&sizes(4), &[(0, 1), (1, 2), (2, 3), (0, 3)], 0);
        let long = l.edges.iter().find(|e| e.from == 0 && e.to == 3).unwrap();
        for p in &long.points[1..long.points.len() - 1] {
            assert!(
                !l.nodes[1].contains(*p) && !l.nodes[2].contains(*p),
                "waypoint {p:?} inside a block"
            );
        }
    }
}
```

`crates/orress-views/src/heap.rs`:

```rs
//! The Heap panel: while a Linux program is stopped in the debugger, read its `[heap]` and show the
//! glibc chunks and the tcache bins (GEF's `heap chunks` / `heap bins tcache`). The parsing lives
//! in `orress-heap`; this reads the target's memory through the debugger's pid-based helpers.
//!
//! Chunks + tcache need only the `[heap]` region. The arena bins (fastbins/unsorted/small/large)
//! need `main_arena`, whose address is libc-version dependent and located in a later tier; until
//! then a note says so.

use egui::{RichText, Ui};
use orress_heap::Heap;
use orress_ui::muted;

use crate::DebugSession;

/// Persistent UI state for the Heap tab.
pub struct HeapView {
    /// (pid, generation, mangled, main_arena) the cached parse belongs to.
    cache_key: Option<(u32, u64, bool, Option<u64>)>,
    heap: Option<Heap>,
    error: Option<String>,
    /// Whether to de-mangle free-list pointers (glibc >= 2.32 safe-linking).
    mangled: bool,
    /// Optional `main_arena` address (hex), to show the fastbins/unsorted/small/large bins.
    arena_input: String,
}

impl Default for HeapView {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            cache_key: None,
            heap: None,
            error: None,
            mangled: true,
            arena_input: String::new(),
        }
    }
}

/// Parses a `0x…` / decimal hex address, if non-empty and valid.
fn parse_addr(s: &str) -> Option<u64> {
    let s = s.trim();
    if s.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    s.strip_prefix("0x")
        .or_else(|| s.strip_prefix("0X"))
        .map_or_else(|| s.parse().ok(), |h| u64::from_str_radix(h, 16).ok())
}

pub fn heap_view(ui: &mut Ui, view: &mut HeapView, session: &mut DebugSession) {
    orress_ui::spotlight::mark(ui.ctx(), "view.Heap", ui.max_rect());
    session.refresh();

    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.label(RichText::new("Heap").strong());
        ui.label(muted("glibc chunks and bins · stop the program to inspect"));
    });
    ui.separator();

    let Some(pid) = session.stopped_pid() else {
        ui.label(muted(
            "Start the program in the Debugger and stop it (a breakpoint), then the heap shows here.",
        ));
        return;
    };

    let generation = session.generation();
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        if ui.button("⟳ Refresh").clicked() {
            view.cache_key = None;
        }
        if ui
            .checkbox(&mut view.mangled, "safe-linking")
            .on_hover_text("De-mangle free-list pointers (glibc >= 2.32).")
            .changed()
        {
            view.cache_key = None;
        }
    });
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.label("main_arena");
        ui.add(
            egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut view.arena_input)
                .hint_text("0x… (auto-located from the unsorted bin; set to override)")
                .desired_width(260.0),
        )
        .on_hover_text(
            "Paste the main_arena address (e.g. from GEF, or libc base + offset) to also show the \
             arena bins. Chunks and tcache show without it.",
        );
    });

    let arena_addr = parse_addr(&view.arena_input);
    let key = (pid, generation, view.mangled, arena_addr);
    if view.cache_key != Some(key) {
        recompute(view, pid, arena_addr);
        view.cache_key = Some(key);
    }

    if let Some(e) = &view.error {
        ui.add_space(4.0);
        ui.colored_label(ui.visuals().warn_fg_color, e);
        return;
    }
    let Some(heap) = &view.heap else {
        return;
    };

    for note in &heap.notes {
        ui.label(muted(note));
    }
    ui.add_space(4.0);

    egui::ScrollArea::vertical()
        .auto_shrink([false, false])
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            // Bins first (what you usually want), then the chunk list.
            if heap.bins.is_empty() {
                ui.label(muted("No free chunks on any bin."));
            } else {
                ui.label(RichText::new("Bins").strong());
                for bin in &heap.bins {
                    let size = bin
                        .size
                        .map(|s| format!(" (size {s:#x})"))
                        .unwrap_or_default();
                    let chain = bin
                        .entries
                        .iter()
                        .map(|a| format!("{a:#x}"))
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                        .join(" -> ");
                    ui.label(
                        RichText::new(format!("{} {}{size}: {chain}", bin.kind.label(), bin.index))
                            .monospace(),
                    );
                }
            }

            ui.add_space(8.0);
            ui.label(RichText::new(format!("Chunks ({})", heap.chunks.len())).strong());
            let row_h = ui.text_style_height(&egui::TextStyle::Monospace) + 2.0;
            egui::ScrollArea::vertical()
                .id_salt("heap-chunks")
                .max_height(ui.available_height().max(120.0))
                .auto_shrink([false, false])
                .show_rows(ui, row_h, heap.chunks.len(), |ui, range| {
                    for c in &heap.chunks[range] {
                        let state = if c.in_use { "in use" } else { "free" };
                        let mut flags = String::new();
                        if c.prev_inuse {
                            flags.push('P');
                        }
                        if c.is_mmapped {
                            flags.push('M');
                        }
                        if c.non_main_arena {
                            flags.push('N');
                        }
                        let free_info = if c.in_use {
                            String::new()
                        } else {
                            format!("  fd={:#x} bk={:#x}", c.fd, c.bk)
                        };
                        ui.label(
                            RichText::new(format!(
                                "{:#x}  size {:#x}  [{flags:<3}]  {state}{free_info}",
                                c.addr, c.size
                            ))
                            .monospace(),
                        );
                    }
                });
        });
}

fn recompute(view: &mut HeapView, pid: u32, arena_addr: Option<u64>) {
    view.heap = None;
    view.error = None;
    let map = match orress_debug::memory_map(pid) {
        Ok(m) => m,
        Err(e) => {
            view.error = Some(format!("Could not read the memory map: {e}"));
            return;
        }
    };
    let Some(region) = map.iter().find(|r| r.name == "[heap]") else {
        view.error = Some(
            "No [heap] mapping yet — nothing has been allocated, or this is not a glibc program."
                .into(),
        );
        return;
    };
    let heap_base = region.base;
    let bytes = match orress_debug::read_mem(pid, heap_base, region.size as usize) {
        Ok(b) => b,
        Err(e) => {
            view.error = Some(format!("Could not read the heap: {e}"));
            return;
        }
    };

    // Use the user's main_arena, or auto-locate it from a chunk in the unsorted bin.
    let mut auto_note = None;
    let arena_addr = arena_addr.or_else(|| {
        let libc = libc_range(&map)?;
        let chunks = orress_heap::walk_chunks(&bytes, heap_base);
        let found = orress_heap::guess_main_arena(&chunks, libc)?;
        auto_note = Some(format!(
            "main_arena auto-located at {found:#x} (set the field to override)."
        ));
        Some(found)
    });

    let arena = arena_addr.and_then(|addr| {
        orress_debug::read_mem(pid, addr, 0x900)
            .ok()
            .map(|b| (b, addr))
    });
    let arena_ref = arena.as_ref().map(|(b, a)| (b.as_slice(), *a));
    let mut heap = orress_heap::parse(&bytes, heap_base, arena_ref, view.mangled);
    if let Some(note) = auto_note {
        heap.notes.insert(0, note);
    }
    view.heap = Some(heap);
}

/// The address range spanned by libc's mappings (lowest base .. highest end).
fn libc_range(map: &[orress_debug::MapRegion]) -> Option<std::ops::Range<u64>> {
    let libc: Vec<&orress_debug::MapRegion> = map
        .iter()
        .filter(|r| {
            let n = r.name.rsplit(['/', '\\']).next().unwrap_or(&r.name);
            n.starts_with("libc.so") || n.starts_with("libc-")
        })
        .collect();
    let lo = libc.iter().map(|r| r.base).min()?;
    let hi = libc.iter().map(|r| r.base + r.size).max()?;
    Some(lo..hi)
}
```

`crates/orress-views/src/hex.rs`:

```rs
//! The hex editor view. Edit mode overwrites bytes as patches; the file on disk is never
//! changed (save a patched copy instead).
//!
//! Scrolling is virtual: only visible rows are laid out, and the position is a row
//! number (u64), not a pixel offset, so files of any size scroll precisely. The entropy
//! minimap on the right doubles as the scrollbar.

use egui::text::LayoutJob;
use egui::{
    Color32, FontId, Key, Modifiers, Pos2, Rect, RichText, Sense, Stroke, StrokeKind, TextFormat,
    Ui, Vec2,
};
use orress_bytes::search::Pattern;
use orress_project::Document;
use orress_ui::ExplainExt as _;

use crate::colors::{entropy_color, section_color};
use crate::{ViewCommand, ViewCtx};

const BYTES_PER_ROW: u64 = 16;
/// Character columns: 8-digit offset + 2 spaces, then 16 hex bytes (3 chars each, plus
/// one extra space in the middle), 1 space, then 16 ASCII characters.
const HEX_COL: f32 = 10.0;
const ASCII_COL: f32 = HEX_COL + 16.0 * 3.0 + 1.0 + 1.0;
const MINIMAP_WIDTH: f32 = 16.0;
const MAX_COUNT: usize = 100_000;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
enum FindMode {
    #[default]
    Text,
    Utf16,
    Hex,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct FindBar {
    open: bool,
    mode: FindMode,
    query: String,
    status: Option<Result<String, String>>,
    focus: bool,
    /// Matches in the whole file for (mode, query, document generation): counting scans the
    /// file, so it runs once per pattern, not on every Find / F3.
    count: Option<((FindMode, String, u64), usize)>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
enum GotoMode {
    #[default]
    Offset,
    Address,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct GotoBar {
    open: bool,
    mode: GotoMode,
    input: String,
    error: Option<String>,
    focus: bool,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct HexState {
    top_row: u64,
    anchor: Option<u64>,
    wheel: f32,
    find: FindBar,
    goto: GotoBar,
    dragging_minimap: bool,
    /// Edit mode: typing hex digits overwrites bytes (as patches).
    edit: bool,
    /// First hex digit typed for the byte at the cursor.
    nibble: Option<u8>,
    message: Option<String>,
}

struct Geometry {
    char_w: f32,
    row_h: f32,
    content: Rect,
    visible_rows: u64,
}

/// Space left of the offset column for the section band.
const LEFT_PAD: f32 = 7.0;

impl Geometry {
    fn x0(&self) -> f32 {
        self.content.left() + LEFT_PAD
    }

    fn row_y(&self, row_from_top: u64) -> f32 {
        self.content.top() + row_from_top as f32 * self.row_h
    }

    fn hex_x(&self, i: u64) -> f32 {
        let extra = if i >= 8 { 1.0 } else { 0.0 };
        self.x0() + (HEX_COL + i as f32 * 3.0 + extra) * self.char_w
    }

    fn ascii_x(&self, i: u64) -> f32 {
        self.x0() + (ASCII_COL + i as f32) * self.char_w
    }

    /// Byte column (0..16) under x, and whether x is in the hex or ascii area.
    fn column_at(&self, x: f32) -> u64 {
        let col = (x - self.x0()) / self.char_w;
        if col >= ASCII_COL - 0.5 {
            ((col - ASCII_COL).floor().max(0.0) as u64).min(15)
        } else {
            let c = (col - HEX_COL).max(0.0);
            let i = if c >= 24.5 {
                8.0 + ((c - 25.0).max(0.0) / 3.0).floor()
            } else {
                (c / 3.0).floor()
            };
            (i as u64).min(15)
        }
    }
}

pub fn hex_view(ui: &mut Ui, doc: &mut Document, state: &mut HexState, cx: &mut ViewCtx<'_>) {
    let Some(data) = doc.bytes().cloned() else {
        return;
    };
    let len = data.len() as u64;

    for command in std::mem::take(&mut cx.commands) {
        match command {
            ViewCommand::GoTo => {
                state.goto.open = true;
                state.goto.focus = true;
                state.find.open = false;
            }
            ViewCommand::Find => {
                state.find.open = true;
                state.find.focus = true;
                state.goto.open = false;
            }
            ViewCommand::FindNext => find(doc, &data, &mut state.find, true),
            ViewCommand::FindPrevious => find(doc, &data, &mut state.find, false),
            ViewCommand::CopyHex | ViewCommand::CopyCArray | ViewCommand::CopyPython => {
                copy_selection(ui, doc, &data, command);
            }
        }
    }

    toolbar(ui, doc, state);
    // Patching re-analyzes in the background; use the freshest bytes.
    let Some(data) = doc.bytes().cloned() else {
        return;
    };
    if state.goto.open {
        goto_bar(ui, doc, &mut state.goto);
    }
    if state.find.open {
        find_bar(ui, doc, &data, &mut state.find);
    }
    ui.add_space(2.0);

    if len == 0 {
        ui.label(RichText::new("The file is empty.").weak());
        return;
    }

    // Layout
    let font = FontId::monospace(13.0);
    let (char_w, row_h) = ui.fonts_mut(|f| (f.glyph_width(&font, '0'), f.row_height(&font) + 2.0));
    let full = ui.available_rect_before_wrap();
    let content = Rect::from_min_max(
        full.min,
        Pos2::new(full.right() - MINIMAP_WIDTH - 4.0, full.bottom()),
    );
    let minimap = Rect::from_min_max(
        Pos2::new(full.right() - MINIMAP_WIDTH, full.top()),
        full.max,
    );
    let geo = Geometry {
        char_w,
        row_h,
        content,
        visible_rows: ((content.height() / row_h).floor() as u64).max(1),
    };
    let total_rows = len.div_ceil(BYTES_PER_ROW);
    let max_top = total_rows.saturating_sub(geo.visible_rows);

    let id = ui.id().with("hex_grid");
    let response = ui.interact(content, id, Sense::click_and_drag());
    let response = response.note(
        "Hex view",
        "Each row shows 16 bytes. Left: the offset (position in the file) of the first byte. \
         Middle: the bytes as two-digit hexadecimal numbers. Right: the same bytes as text, \
         with a dot for bytes that are not printable. Click a byte to inspect it; drag to \
         select. Arrow keys move, Shift extends the selection, Ctrl+G goes to an offset, \
         Ctrl+F searches.",
    );
    if response.clicked() || response.drag_started() {
        response.request_focus();
    }
    let focused = response.has_focus();
    if focused {
        ui.memory_mut(|m| {
            m.set_focus_lock_filter(
                id,
                egui::EventFilter {
                    horizontal_arrows: true,
                    vertical_arrows: true,
                    tab: false,
                    escape: false,
                },
            );
        });
    }

    // Mouse
    let byte_at = |pos: Pos2, top_row: u64| -> u64 {
        let row = top_row + ((pos.y - content.top()) / row_h).max(0.0) as u64;
        (row * BYTES_PER_ROW + geo.column_at(pos.x)).min(len - 1)
    };
    if let Some(pos) = response.interact_pointer_pos() {
        let byte = byte_at(pos, state.top_row);
        let shift = ui.input(|i| i.modifiers.shift);
        if response.drag_started() || (response.clicked() && !shift) {
            state.anchor = Some(byte);
            doc.cursor = byte;
            doc.selection = None;
        } else if response.dragged() || (response.clicked() && shift) {
            let anchor = *state.anchor.get_or_insert(doc.cursor);
            doc.cursor = byte;
            doc.selection = (anchor != byte).then(|| (anchor.min(byte), anchor.max(byte) + 1));
        }
        // Auto-scroll while dragging past the edges.
        if response.dragged() {
            if pos.y < content.top() {
                state.top_row = state.top_row.saturating_sub(1);
            } else if pos.y > content.bottom() {
                state.top_row = (state.top_row + 1).min(max_top);
            }
        }
    }
    if ui.rect_contains_pointer(full) {
        let dy = ui.input(|i| i.smooth_scroll_delta.y);
        state.wheel -= dy / row_h;
        let whole = state.wheel.trunc();
        state.wheel -= whole;
        state.top_row = if whole < 0.0 {
            state.top_row.saturating_sub((-whole) as u64)
        } else {
            (state.top_row + whole as u64).min(max_top)
        };
    }

    // Right click: on a byte outside the selection, move the cursor there first.
    if response.secondary_clicked()
        && let Some(pos) = response.interact_pointer_pos()
    {
        let byte = byte_at(pos, state.top_row);
        let inside = doc.selection.is_some_and(|(a, b)| (a..b).contains(&byte));
        if !inside {
            doc.cursor = byte;
            doc.selection = None;
            state.anchor = Some(byte);
        }
    }
    response.context_menu(|ui| context_menu(ui, doc, &data, state, cx));

    // Keyboard
    if focused {
        keyboard(ui, doc, state, &geo, len);
        if state.edit {
            edit_keys(ui, doc, state, len);
        }
        // Ctrl+C arrives as a Copy event rather than a key press.
        if ui.input(|i| i.events.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, egui::Event::Copy))) {
            copy_selection(ui, doc, &data, ViewCommand::CopyHex);
        }
    }

    // Keep the cursor visible after keyboard moves and reveal requests.
    if doc.reveal {
        doc.reveal = false;
        let row = doc.cursor / BYTES_PER_ROW;
        if row < state.top_row || row >= state.top_row + geo.visible_rows {
            state.top_row = row.saturating_sub(geo.visible_rows / 3).min(max_top);
        }
    }
    state.top_row = state.top_row.min(max_top);

    paint_rows(ui, doc, &data, state.top_row, &geo, &font, focused);
    minimap_ui(ui, doc, state, minimap, &geo, total_rows, max_top);
}

fn toolbar(ui: &mut Ui, doc: &mut Document, state: &mut HexState) {
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        if ui
            .selectable_label(state.edit, "Edit bytes")
            .explain(
                "Edit bytes",
                "Turn on, click a byte and type two hex digits to change it. Changes are \
                 patches: the file on disk stays untouched until you save a patched copy. \
                 Changed bytes are shown in orange.",
            )
            .clicked()
        {
            state.edit = !state.edit;
            state.nibble = None;
        }
        if let Some(n) = state.nibble {
            ui.label(RichText::new(format!("typing: {n:X}_")).monospace().strong());
        }
        let patched = doc.annotations.patches.len();
        if patched > 0 {
            ui.label(
                RichText::new(format!("{patched} byte{} patched", if patched == 1 { "" } else { "s" }))
                    .color(ui.visuals().warn_fg_color),
            );
            if ui.small_button("Revert all").explain("Revert all", "Remove every patch and go back to the original bytes.").clicked() {
                doc.revert_patches();
            }
            if ui
                .small_button("Save patched file…")
                .explain("Save patched file", "Write a copy of the file with your patches applied, e.g. to run the cracked program.")
                .clicked()
            {
                state.message = Some(crate::save_patched(doc));
            }
        }
        if let Some(m) = &state.message {
            ui.label(RichText::new(m).weak());
        }
        ui.separator();
        ui.label(RichText::new(doc.file_name()).strong())
            .on_hover_text(doc.path.display().to_string());
        ui.label(RichText::new(format!("{} bytes", doc.len())).weak());
        ui.separator();
        if ui
            .selectable_label(state.goto.open, "Go to…")
            .explain(
                "Go to",
                "Jump to a file offset or a memory address. Shortcut: Ctrl+G.",
            )
            .clicked()
        {
            state.goto.open = !state.goto.open;
            state.goto.focus = state.goto.open;
        }
        if ui
            .selectable_label(state.find.open, "Find…")
            .explain(
                "Find",
                "Search for text or a byte pattern. Shortcut: Ctrl+F, then F3 for the next match.",
            )
            .clicked()
        {
            state.find.open = !state.find.open;
            state.find.focus = state.find.open;
        }
        ui.separator();
        let sel = match doc.selection {
            Some((a, b)) => format!(
                "selection 0x{a:X}–0x{:X} ({} bytes)",
                b.saturating_sub(1).max(a),
                b.saturating_sub(a)
            ),
            None => format!("cursor 0x{:X}", doc.cursor),
        };
        ui.label(RichText::new(sel).monospace().weak());
    });
}

fn parse_number(text: &str) -> Result<u64, String> {
    let t = text.trim().replace('_', "");
    if let Some(dec) = t.strip_prefix('#') {
        return dec
            .parse()
            .map_err(|_| format!("`{dec}` is not a decimal number"));
    }
    let hex = t
        .strip_prefix("0x")
        .or_else(|| t.strip_prefix("0X"))
        .unwrap_or(&t);
    let hex = hex.strip_suffix('h').unwrap_or(hex);
    u64::from_str_radix(hex, 16).map_err(|_| format!("`{t}` is not a hexadecimal number"))
}

/// Resolves the go-to input to a file offset.
fn resolve_goto(doc: &Document, input: &str, mode: GotoMode) -> Result<u64, String> {
    let input = input.trim();
    if input.is_empty() {
        return Err("type an offset, e.g. 1F0 or 0x1F0".into());
    }
    if let Some(rest) = input.strip_prefix('+') {
        return Ok(doc.cursor.saturating_add(parse_number(rest)?));
    }
    if let Some(rest) = input.strip_prefix('-') {
        return Ok(doc.cursor.saturating_sub(parse_number(rest)?));
    }
    let value = parse_number(input)?;
    let offset = match mode {
        GotoMode::Offset => value,
        GotoMode::Address => {
            let analysis = doc
                .analysis()
                .ok_or("still analyzing; try again in a moment")?;
            analysis
                .info
                .address_to_offset(value)
                .ok_or_else(|| format!("address 0x{value:X} is not part of the file (not mapped, or only exists in memory)"))?
        }
    };
    if offset >= doc.len() {
        return Err(format!(
            "offset 0x{offset:X} is past the end of the file (size 0x{:X})",
            doc.len()
        ));
    }
    Ok(offset)
}

fn goto_bar(ui: &mut Ui, doc: &mut Document, bar: &mut GotoBar) {
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.radio_value(&mut bar.mode, GotoMode::Offset, "File offset")
            .explain(
                "File offset",
                "Position in the file, counted in bytes from the start (0). This is what the hex \
             view shows on the left.",
            );
        ui.radio_value(&mut bar.mode, GotoMode::Address, "Address")
            .explain(
                "Address (virtual address)",
                "Where a byte ends up in memory when the program runs, as shown by disassemblers \
             and debuggers. ORRESS converts it to a file offset using the section table.",
            );
        let edit = ui.add(
            egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut bar.input)
                .hint_text("hex, e.g. 401000 · #1234 for decimal · +10 relative")
                .desired_width(280.0)
                .font(egui::TextStyle::Monospace),
        );
        if bar.focus {
            edit.request_focus();
            bar.focus = false;
        }
        let submit = edit.lost_focus() && ui.input(|i| i.key_pressed(Key::Enter));
        if ui.button("Go").clicked() || submit {
            match resolve_goto(doc, &bar.input, bar.mode) {
                Ok(offset) => {
                    doc.go_to(offset);
                    bar.error = None;
                    bar.open = false;
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    bar.error = Some(e);
                    bar.focus = true;
                }
            }
        }
        if ui.button("×").on_hover_text("Close").clicked()
            || (edit.has_focus() && ui.input(|i| i.key_pressed(Key::Escape)))
        {
            bar.open = false;
        }
    });
    if let Some(e) = &bar.error {
        ui.colored_label(ui.visuals().warn_fg_color, e);
    }
}

fn pattern(bar: &FindBar) -> Result<Pattern, String> {
    match bar.mode {
        FindMode::Text => Pattern::text(&bar.query, false),
        FindMode::Utf16 => Pattern::text(&bar.query, true),
        FindMode::Hex => Pattern::parse_hex(&bar.query),
    }
    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

fn find(doc: &mut Document, data: &[u8], bar: &mut FindBar, forward: bool) {
    let pattern = match pattern(bar) {
        Ok(p) => p,
        Err(e) => {
            bar.status = Some(Err(e));
            return;
        }
    };
    let found = if forward {
        pattern.find_next_wrapping(data, doc.cursor as usize)
    } else {
        pattern
            .find_before(data, doc.cursor as usize)
            .or_else(|| pattern.find_before(data, data.len()))
    };
    bar.status = Some(match found {
        Some(at) => {
            doc.select(at as u64, pattern.len() as u64);
            let key = (bar.mode, bar.query.clone(), doc.generation);
            let count = match &bar.count {
                Some((k, n)) if *k == key => *n,
                _ => {
                    let n = pattern.count(data, MAX_COUNT);
                    bar.count = Some((key, n));
                    n
                }
            };
            let more = if count >= MAX_COUNT { "+" } else { "" };
            Ok(format!(
                "found at 0x{at:X} · {count}{more} matches in the file"
            ))
        }
        None => Err("not found".into()),
    });
}

fn find_bar(ui: &mut Ui, doc: &mut Document, data: &[u8], bar: &mut FindBar) {
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt("find_mode")
            .selected_text(match bar.mode {
                FindMode::Text => "Text",
                FindMode::Utf16 => "Wide text (UTF-16)",
                FindMode::Hex => "Hex bytes",
            })
            .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                ui.selectable_value(&mut bar.mode, FindMode::Text, "Text")
                    .explain(
                        "Text search",
                        "Finds ASCII/UTF-8 text, as most Linux programs store it.",
                    );
                ui.selectable_value(&mut bar.mode, FindMode::Utf16, "Wide text (UTF-16)").explain(
                    "Wide text",
                    "Finds text stored as UTF-16, the way Windows programs often store strings: \
                     every letter followed by a 0 byte.",
                );
                ui.selectable_value(&mut bar.mode, FindMode::Hex, "Hex bytes")
                    .explain(
                        "Hex pattern",
                        "Finds a sequence of bytes such as `E8 ?? ?? ?? ??` (a call instruction). \
                     `??` matches any byte.",
                    );
            });
        let hint = match bar.mode {
            FindMode::Hex => "e.g. 4D 5A ?? 00",
            _ => "e.g. flag{  or  Wrong password",
        };
        let edit = ui.add(
            egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut bar.query)
                .hint_text(hint)
                .desired_width(260.0),
        );
        if bar.focus {
            edit.request_focus();
            bar.focus = false;
        }
        let submit = edit.lost_focus() && ui.input(|i| i.key_pressed(Key::Enter));
        if ui.button("Next").on_hover_text("F3").clicked() || submit {
            find(doc, data, bar, true);
            if submit {
                bar.focus = true;
            }
        }
        if ui.button("Previous").on_hover_text("Shift+F3").clicked() {
            find(doc, data, bar, false);
        }
        if ui.button("×").on_hover_text("Close").clicked()
            || (edit.has_focus() && ui.input(|i| i.key_pressed(Key::Escape)))
        {
            bar.open = false;
        }
        match &bar.status {
            Some(Ok(s)) => {
                ui.label(RichText::new(s).weak());
            }
            Some(Err(e)) => {
                ui.colored_label(ui.visuals().warn_fg_color, e);
            }
            None => {}
        }
    });
}

/// Hex digits typed in edit mode overwrite the byte at the cursor.
fn edit_keys(ui: &Ui, doc: &mut Document, state: &mut HexState, len: u64) {
    let typed: Vec<char> = ui.input(|i| {
        i.events
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|e| match e {
                egui::Event::Text(t) => Some(t.chars().collect::<Vec<_>>()),
                _ => None,
            })
            .flatten()
            .collect()
    });
    if ui.input(|i| i.key_pressed(Key::Escape)) {
        state.nibble = None;
    }
    for c in typed {
        let Some(digit) = c.to_digit(16) else {
            continue;
        };
        let digit = digit as u8;
        match state.nibble.take() {
            None => state.nibble = Some(digit),
            Some(high) => {
                let offset = doc.cursor;
                if let Err(e) = doc.patch(offset, &[high << 4 | digit]) {
                    state.message = Some(e);
                }
                if offset + 1 < len {
                    doc.cursor = offset + 1;
                    state.anchor = Some(doc.cursor);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn keyboard(ui: &Ui, doc: &mut Document, state: &mut HexState, geo: &Geometry, len: u64) {
    let page = geo.visible_rows.saturating_sub(1).max(1) * BYTES_PER_ROW;
    let (moves, shift) = ui.input_mut(|i| {
        let shift = i.modifiers.shift;
        let ctrl = i.modifiers.command;
        fn pressed(i: &mut egui::InputState, key: Key) -> bool {
            i.consume_key(Modifiers::NONE, key) || i.consume_key(Modifiers::SHIFT, key)
        }
        let mut target: Option<i128> = None;
        let cur = i128::from(doc.cursor);
        let row_start = cur - cur % 16;
        if pressed(i, Key::ArrowLeft) {
            target = Some(cur - 1);
        }
        if pressed(i, Key::ArrowRight) {
            target = Some(cur + 1);
        }
        if pressed(i, Key::ArrowUp) {
            target = Some(cur - 16);
        }
        if pressed(i, Key::ArrowDown) {
            target = Some(cur + 16);
        }
        if pressed(i, Key::PageUp) {
            target = Some(cur - i128::from(page));
        }
        if pressed(i, Key::PageDown) {
            target = Some(cur + i128::from(page));
        }
        let home = i.consume_key(Modifiers::COMMAND, Key::Home)
            || i.consume_key(Modifiers::COMMAND | Modifiers::SHIFT, Key::Home);
        let end = i.consume_key(Modifiers::COMMAND, Key::End)
            || i.consume_key(Modifiers::COMMAND | Modifiers::SHIFT, Key::End);
        if home {
            target = Some(0);
        } else if end {
            target = Some(i128::from(len) - 1);
        } else if !ctrl && pressed(i, Key::Home) {
            target = Some(row_start);
        } else if !ctrl && pressed(i, Key::End) {
            target = Some(row_start + 15);
        }
        (target, shift)
    });
    let Some(target) = moves else {
        return;
    };
    let new = target.clamp(0, i128::from(len) - 1) as u64;
    if shift {
        let anchor = *state.anchor.get_or_insert(doc.cursor);
        doc.selection = (anchor != new).then(|| (anchor.min(new), anchor.max(new) + 1));
    } else {
        state.anchor = Some(new);
        doc.selection = None;
    }
    doc.cursor = new;
    // Minimal scroll to keep the cursor on screen.
    let row = new / BYTES_PER_ROW;
    if row < state.top_row {
        state.top_row = row;
    } else if row >= state.top_row + geo.visible_rows {
        state.top_row = row + 1 - geo.visible_rows;
    }
}

struct Palette {
    offset: Color32,
    zero: Color32,
    printable: Color32,
    other: Color32,
    selection: Color32,
    cursor: Stroke,
    patched: Color32,
}

impl Palette {
    fn new(ui: &Ui, focused: bool) -> Self {
        let v = ui.visuals();
        Self {
            offset: v.weak_text_color(),
            zero: v.weak_text_color().gamma_multiply(0.7),
            printable: v.text_color(),
            other: v.hyperlink_color,
            selection: v.selection.bg_fill,
            cursor: Stroke::new(
                1.5,
                if focused {
                    v.selection.stroke.color
                } else {
                    v.weak_text_color()
                },
            ),
            patched: Color32::from_rgb(255, 150, 50),
        }
    }

    fn byte(&self, doc: &Document, offset: u64, b: u8) -> Color32 {
        if doc.is_patched(offset) {
            self.patched
        } else {
            self.of(b)
        }
    }

    fn of(&self, b: u8) -> Color32 {
        match b {
            0 => self.zero,
            0x20..=0x7e => self.printable,
            _ => self.other,
        }
    }
}

fn paint_rows(
    ui: &Ui,
    doc: &Document,
    data: &[u8],
    top_row: u64,
    geo: &Geometry,
    font: &FontId,
    focused: bool,
) {
    let painter = ui.painter_at(geo.content);
    let pal = Palette::new(ui, focused);
    let len = data.len() as u64;
    let sections = doc.analysis().map(|a| &a.info.sections);
    let selected = |off: u64| doc.selection.is_some_and(|(a, b)| off >= a && off < b);

    for r in 0..=geo.visible_rows {
        let row = top_row + r;
        let start = row * BYTES_PER_ROW;
        if start >= len {
            break;
        }
        let end = (start + BYTES_PER_ROW).min(len);
        let y = geo.row_y(r);

        // Section band: a thin colored bar showing which section the row belongs to.
        if let Some(sections) = sections
            && let Some(index) = sections.iter().position(|s| s.contains_offset(start))
        {
            let band =
                Rect::from_min_size(Pos2::new(geo.content.left(), y), Vec2::new(3.0, geo.row_h));
            painter.rect_filled(band, 0.0, section_color(index));
        }

        // Selection and cursor backgrounds.
        for off in start..end {
            let i = off - start;
            let hex_rect = Rect::from_min_size(
                Pos2::new(geo.hex_x(i) - 1.0, y),
                Vec2::new(geo.char_w * 2.0 + 2.0, geo.row_h),
            );
            let ascii_rect = Rect::from_min_size(
                Pos2::new(geo.ascii_x(i), y),
                Vec2::new(geo.char_w, geo.row_h),
            );
            if selected(off) {
                painter.rect_filled(hex_rect, 0.0, pal.selection);
                painter.rect_filled(ascii_rect, 0.0, pal.selection);
            }
            if off == doc.cursor {
                painter.rect_stroke(hex_rect, 2.0, pal.cursor, StrokeKind::Inside);
                painter.rect_stroke(ascii_rect, 1.0, pal.cursor, StrokeKind::Inside);
            }
        }

        let mut job = LayoutJob::default();
        let fmt = |color| TextFormat::simple(font.clone(), color);
        job.append(&format!("{start:08X}  "), 0.0, fmt(pal.offset));
        for i in 0..BYTES_PER_ROW {
            let gap = if i == 8 { " " } else { "" };
            match data.get((start + i) as usize) {
                Some(&b) if start + i < end => job.append(
                    &format!("{gap}{b:02X} "),
                    0.0,
                    fmt(pal.byte(doc, start + i, b)),
                ),
                _ => job.append(&format!("{gap}   "), 0.0, fmt(pal.zero)),
            }
        }
        job.append(" ", 0.0, fmt(pal.offset));
        for (i, &b) in data[start as usize..end as usize].iter().enumerate() {
            let ch = if (0x20..=0x7e).contains(&b) {
                b as char
            } else {
                '.'
            };
            job.append(
                &ch.to_string(),
                0.0,
                fmt(pal.byte(doc, start + i as u64, b)),
            );
        }
        let galley = ui.fonts_mut(|f| f.layout_job(job));
        painter.galley(Pos2::new(geo.x0(), y + 1.0), galley, pal.printable);
    }
}

fn minimap_ui(
    ui: &mut Ui,
    doc: &Document,
    state: &mut HexState,
    rect: Rect,
    geo: &Geometry,
    total_rows: u64,
    max_top: u64,
) {
    let response = ui.interact(rect, ui.id().with("hex_minimap"), Sense::click_and_drag());
    let painter = ui.painter_at(rect);
    painter.rect_filled(rect, 2.0, ui.visuals().extreme_bg_color);

    let entropy = doc.analysis().map(|a| (&a.entropy, a.entropy_block));
    if let Some((blocks, _)) = entropy
        && !blocks.is_empty()
    {
        let h = rect.height().max(1.0);
        let steps = h.floor() as usize;
        for px in 0..steps {
            let frac = px as f32 / h;
            let index = ((frac * blocks.len() as f32) as usize).min(blocks.len() - 1);
            let y = rect.top() + px as f32;
            painter.line_segment(
                [
                    Pos2::new(rect.left() + 2.0, y),
                    Pos2::new(rect.right() - 2.0, y),
                ],
                Stroke::new(1.0, entropy_color(blocks[index])),
            );
        }
    }

    // Viewport indicator.
    if total_rows > 0 {
        let top = state.top_row as f32 / total_rows as f32;
        let size = (geo.visible_rows as f32 / total_rows as f32).min(1.0);
        let view = Rect::from_min_max(
            Pos2::new(rect.left(), rect.top() + top * rect.height()),
            Pos2::new(
                rect.right(),
                rect.top() + (top + size) * rect.height().max(4.0),
            ),
        );
        painter.rect_stroke(
            view,
            2.0,
            Stroke::new(1.5, ui.visuals().text_color()),
            StrokeKind::Inside,
        );
    }

    if response.drag_started() || response.clicked() {
        state.dragging_minimap = true;
    }
    if !response.dragged() && !response.clicked() {
        state.dragging_minimap = false;
    }
    if let Some(pos) = response.interact_pointer_pos()
        && state.dragging_minimap
    {
        let frac = ((pos.y - rect.top()) / rect.height()).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        let row = (frac * total_rows as f32) as u64;
        state.top_row = row.saturating_sub(geo.visible_rows / 2).min(max_top);
    }

    let response = response.note(
        "Entropy map",
        "This strip is a map of the whole file, colored by entropy (how random the bytes \
         are). Blue: zeros or simple data. Green: normal code and data. Yellow and red: \
         compressed or encrypted. The white box shows what is on screen; click or drag to jump.",
    );
    if let Some(pos) = response.hover_pos()
        && let Some((blocks, block)) = entropy
        && !blocks.is_empty()
    {
        let frac = ((pos.y - rect.top()) / rect.height()).clamp(0.0, 0.9999);
        let index = (frac * blocks.len() as f32) as usize;
        let e = blocks[index];
        response.on_hover_text(format!(
            "offset 0x{:X}\nentropy {e:.2}: {}",
            index * block,
            orress_bytes::entropy::describe(e)
        ));
    }
}

/// The right-click menu: copy, go to, find, edit, and the matching code.
fn context_menu(
    ui: &mut Ui,
    doc: &mut Document,
    data: &[u8],
    state: &mut HexState,
    cx: &mut ViewCtx<'_>,
) {
    ui.set_min_width(220.0);
    ui.style_mut().wrap_mode = Some(egui::TextWrapMode::Extend);
    let what = if doc.selection.is_some() {
        "selection"
    } else {
        "byte"
    };
    ui.menu_button(format!("Copy {what}"), |ui| {
        for (label, format) in [
            ("As hex", ViewCommand::CopyHex),
            ("As C array", ViewCommand::CopyCArray),
            ("As Python bytes", ViewCommand::CopyPython),
        ] {
            if ui.button(label).clicked() {
                copy_selection(ui, doc, data, format);
                ui.close();
            }
        }
        crate::menu::copy_item(ui, "Offset", format!("0x{:X}", doc.cursor));
    });
    let shortcut = |label: &str, keys: &str| egui::Button::new(label).shortcut_text(keys);
    if ui
        .add(shortcut("Go to offset or address…", "Ctrl+G"))
        .clicked()
    {
        state.goto.open = true;
        state.goto.focus = true;
        state.find.open = false;
        ui.close();
    }
    if ui.add(shortcut("Find…", "Ctrl+F")).clicked() {
        state.find.open = true;
        state.find.focus = true;
        state.goto.open = false;
        ui.close();
    }
    if ui
        .button(if state.edit {
            "Stop editing bytes"
        } else {
            "Edit bytes"
        })
        .clicked()
    {
        state.edit = !state.edit;
        ui.close();
    }
    let in_code = doc.program().is_some_and(|p| {
        p.memory
            .address_of(doc.cursor)
            .is_some_and(|a| p.insn_start(a).is_some())
    });
    if in_code {
        ui.separator();
        if ui.button("Show in disassembly").clicked() {
            cx.requests.push(crate::ViewRequest::Open(
                doc.path.clone(),
                crate::DocView::Disassembly,
            ));
            ui.close();
        }
        crate::menu::command(ui, cx.requests, "view::Decompiler");
    }
    // Apply a user-defined type to the data at the cursor (needs a loaded address).
    if let Some(addr) = doc.cursor_address() {
        let names: Vec<String> = doc.type_catalog().types.keys().cloned().collect();
        let applied = doc.annotations.data_types.get(&addr).cloned();
        ui.separator();
        ui.menu_button("Apply type", |ui| {
            if names.is_empty() {
                ui.label(orress_ui::muted(
                    "No types yet — define one in the Types view.",
                ));
                crate::menu::command(ui, cx.requests, "view::Types");
            }
            for name in &names {
                if ui.button(name).clicked() {
                    doc.apply_data_type(addr, orress_project::TypeRef::Named(name.clone()));
                    ui.close();
                }
            }
        });
        if let Some(ty) = applied
            && ui.button(format!("Clear type ({})", ty.label())).clicked()
        {
            doc.clear_data_type(addr);
            ui.close();
        }
    }
    ui.separator();
    crate::menu::command(ui, cx.requests, "view::Inspector");
    crate::menu::views_and_commands(ui, cx.requests);
}

fn copy_selection(ui: &Ui, doc: &Document, data: &[u8], format: ViewCommand) {
    let (a, b) = doc.selection.unwrap_or((doc.cursor, doc.cursor + 1));
    let Some(bytes) = data.get(a as usize..(b as usize).min(data.len())) else {
        return;
    };
    let text = match format {
        ViewCommand::CopyCArray => {
            let body: Vec<String> = bytes.iter().map(|b| format!("0x{b:02x}")).collect();
            format!(
                "unsigned char data[{}] = {{\n    {}\n}};",
                bytes.len(),
                body.chunks(12)
                    .map(|c| c.join(", "))
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .join(",\n    ")
            )
        }
        ViewCommand::CopyPython => {
            let body: String = bytes.iter().map(|b| format!("\\x{b:02x}")).collect();
            format!("data = b\"{body}\"")
        }
        _ => bytes
            .iter()
            .map(|b| format!("{b:02X}"))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join(" "),
    };
    ui.ctx().copy_text(text);
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn numbers_default_to_hex() {
        assert_eq!(parse_number("1F0"), Ok(0x1f0));
        assert_eq!(parse_number("0x401000"), Ok(0x40_1000));
        assert_eq!(parse_number("401000h"), Ok(0x40_1000));
        assert_eq!(parse_number("#100"), Ok(100));
        assert_eq!(parse_number("0x_10_00"), Ok(0x1000));
        assert!(parse_number("xyz").is_err());
    }

    const TOTAL_COLS: f32 = ASCII_COL + 16.0;

    #[test]
    fn column_hit_testing() {
        let geo = Geometry {
            char_w: 10.0,
            row_h: 16.0,
            content: Rect::from_min_size(Pos2::ZERO, Vec2::new(1000.0, 500.0)),
            visible_rows: 30,
        };
        // Byte 0 starts at column 10, byte 8 at column 10 + 24 + 1.
        assert_eq!(geo.column_at(geo.hex_x(0) + 5.0), 0);
        assert_eq!(geo.column_at(geo.hex_x(7) + 5.0), 7);
        assert_eq!(geo.column_at(geo.hex_x(8) + 5.0), 8);
        assert_eq!(geo.column_at(geo.hex_x(15) + 5.0), 15);
        assert_eq!(geo.column_at(geo.ascii_x(3) + 5.0), 3);
        assert_eq!(geo.column_at(0.0), 0);
        assert_eq!(geo.column_at(LEFT_PAD + TOTAL_COLS * 10.0 + 50.0), 15);
    }
}
```
