```rs
//! Imports and exports.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;

use egui::{RichText, Ui};
use orress_loaders::apis;
use orress_project::Document;
use orress_ui::{ExplainExt as _, muted};

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ImportsState {
    filter: String,
    interesting_only: bool,
}

pub fn imports(
    ui: &mut Ui,
    doc: &mut Document,
    state: &mut ImportsState,
    cx: &mut crate::ViewCtx<'_>,
) {
    let Some(analysis) = doc.analysis().cloned() else {
        return;
    };
    let info = &analysis.info;
    ui.label(muted(
        "Imports are functions from other libraries that this program calls, such as strcmp \
         or CreateFileW. They tell you what the program can do before you read any code. \
         Hover a function for an explanation.",
    ));
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.add(
            egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut state.filter)
                .hint_text("Filter…")
                .desired_width(220.0),
        );
        ui.checkbox(&mut state.interesting_only, "Only functions ORRESS knows")
            .explain(
                "Known functions",
                "Show only functions in ORRESS's knowledge base: input, comparison, crypto, \
             anti-debugging, network, injection and similar. A quick way to spot behavior.",
            );
    });
    ui.add_space(4.0);

    let filter = state.filter.to_lowercase();
    let mut groups: BTreeMap<&str, Vec<&orress_loaders::Import>> = BTreeMap::new();
    for import in &info.imports {
        let known = apis::lookup(&import.name);
        if state.interesting_only && known.is_none() {
            continue;
        }
        if !filter.is_empty()
            && !import.name.to_lowercase().contains(&filter)
            && !import.library.to_lowercase().contains(&filter)
        {
            continue;
        }
        let lib = if import.library.is_empty() {
            "(shared libraries)"
        } else {
            import.library.as_str()
        };
        groups.entry(lib).or_default().push(import);
    }

    let program = doc.program().cloned();
    let slots: std::collections::HashMap<&str, u64> = info
        .import_slots
        .iter()
        .map(|s| (s.name.as_str(), s.address))
        .collect();
    let mut follow = None;
    egui::ScrollArea::vertical()
        .auto_shrink([false, false])
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            ui.label(
                RichText::new(format!("Imports ({})", info.imports.len()))
                    .strong()
                    .size(15.0),
            );
            if info.imports.is_empty() {
                ui.label(muted(
                    "No imports. Either the program is statically linked (all library code is \
                 inside it), or a packer hides them.",
                ));
            }
            let open_all = !filter.is_empty() || state.interesting_only || groups.len() <= 3;
            for (lib, list) in &groups {
                egui::CollapsingHeader::new(format!("{lib} ({})", list.len()))
                    .id_salt(lib)
                    .default_open(true)
                    .open(open_all.then_some(true))
                    .show(ui, |ui| {
                        for import in list {
                            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                                let name = RichText::new(&import.name).monospace();
                                match apis::lookup(&import.name) {
                                    Some(api) => {
                                        let color = if api.category.suspicious() {
                                            ui.visuals().warn_fg_color
                                        } else {
                                            ui.visuals().hyperlink_color
                                        };
                                        ui.label(name).explain(&import.name, api.explain);
                                        ui.label(
                                            RichText::new(api.category.name()).small().color(color),
                                        );
                                    }
                                    None => {
                                        ui.label(name);
                                    }
                                }
                                let callers = program
                                    .as_ref()
                                    .zip(slots.get(import.name.as_str()))
                                    .map(|(p, &slot)| import_callers(p, slot))
                                    .unwrap_or_default();
                                if let Some(&first) = callers.first()
                                    && ui
                                        .link(RichText::new(format!("{} »", callers.len())).small())
                                        .on_hover_text("Number of places that call it. Click to go to the first one.")
                                        .clicked()
                                {
                                    follow = Some(first);
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    });
            }

            ui.add_space(10.0);
            ui.label(
                RichText::new(format!("Exports ({})", info.exports.len()))
                    .strong()
                    .size(15.0),
            );
            if info.exports.is_empty() {
                ui.label(muted(
                    "No exports. Normal for programs; libraries (DLLs) export functions.",
                ));
            }
            let wide = info.bits == Some(64);
            egui::Grid::new("exports")
                .striped(true)
                .num_columns(2)
                .show(ui, |ui| {
                    for e in info
                        .exports
                        .iter()
                        .filter(|e| filter.is_empty() || e.name.to_lowercase().contains(&filter))
                        .take(5_000)
                    {
                        ui.monospace(crate::fmt_addr(e.address, wide));
                        ui.monospace(&e.name);
                        ui.end_row();
                    }
                });
        });
    if let Some(from) = follow {
        doc.navigate_to_address(from);
        cx.requests.push(crate::ViewRequest::Open(
            doc.path.clone(),
            crate::DocView::Disassembly,
        ));
    }
}

/// Instructions that call an import: direct uses of its slot, and calls to stubs (PLT
/// entries, thunks) that jump through the slot.
fn import_callers(program: &orress_analysis::Program, slot: u64) -> Vec<u64> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for xref in program.xrefs(slot) {
        match program.functions.get(&xref.from) {
            Some(f) if f.kind == orress_analysis::FunctionKind::Thunk => {
                out.extend(program.xrefs(f.entry).iter().map(|x| x.from));
            }
            _ => out.push(xref.from),
        }
    }
    out.sort_unstable();
    out.dedup();
    out
}
```

```rs
//! "What is this file?": the triage overview.

use egui::{Pos2, Rect, RichText, Sense, Stroke, Ui, Vec2};
use orress_loaders::{DetectionCategory, InsightLevel, ProtectionState};
use orress_project::Document;
use orress_ui::{ExplainExt as _, muted};

use crate::colors::entropy_color;
use crate::{DocView, ViewCtx, ViewRequest, fmt_addr};

fn card(ui: &mut Ui, title: &str, add: impl FnOnce(&mut Ui)) {
    egui::Frame::group(ui.style())
        .inner_margin(10.0)
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            ui.set_width(ui.available_width());
            ui.label(RichText::new(title).strong().size(15.0));
            ui.add_space(4.0);
            add(ui);
        });
    ui.add_space(6.0);
}

fn row(ui: &mut Ui, label: &str, value: impl Into<egui::WidgetText>, explain: &str) {
    ui.label(RichText::new(label).weak())
        .explain(label, explain);
    ui.label(value);
    ui.end_row();
}

pub fn info(ui: &mut Ui, doc: &mut Document, cx: &mut ViewCtx<'_>) {
    let Some(analysis) = doc.analysis().cloned() else {
        return;
    };
    let info = &analysis.info;
    let wide = info.bits == Some(64);
    let path = doc.path.clone();

    egui::ScrollArea::vertical().auto_shrink([false, false]).show(ui, |ui| {
        ui.heading(doc.file_name());
        ui.label(muted(doc.path.display().to_string()));
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            if let Some(main) = doc.program().and_then(|p| p.main)
                && ui
                    .button(RichText::new("Go to main").strong())
                    .explain(
                        "Go to main",
                        "Jump to the program's own main function. The entry point runs C                          runtime start-up code first; main is where the programmer's code begins                          and usually where you want to start reading.",
                    )
                    .clicked()
            {
                doc.navigate_to_address(main);
                cx.requests.push(ViewRequest::Open(path.clone(), DocView::Disassembly));
            }
            for view in [
                DocView::Functions,
                DocView::Disassembly,
                DocView::Strings,
                DocView::Imports,
                DocView::Sections,
                DocView::Hex,
            ] {
                if ui.button(view.name()).explain(view.name(), view.explain()).clicked() {
                    cx.requests.push(ViewRequest::Open(path.clone(), view));
                }
            }
        });
        ui.add_space(8.0);

        card(ui, "What is this file?", |ui| {

                    );

                        "Image base",
                        fmt_addr(info.image_base, wide),
                        "The preferred memory address the file is loaded at. Addresses in the \
                         disassembly are this base plus an offset.",
                    );

                        ui.label(RichText::new("Entry point").weak()).explain(
                            "Entry point",
                            "The address where the program starts running. Note: for C programs \
                             this is the C runtime start-up code, which calls main() a bit later.",
                        );

                            ui.label(RichText::new(fmt_addr(entry, wide)).monospace());

                "Randomness of the bytes along the file, from start (left) to end (right). Flat \
                 low parts are padding, middle values are code and data, values near 8 are \
                 compressed or encrypted. Colored bars below mark the sections. Click to jump there.",
            ));
            entropy_graph(ui, doc, cx);
        });
    });
}

fn entropy_graph(ui: &mut Ui, doc: &mut Document, cx: &mut ViewCtx<'_>) {
    let Some(analysis) = doc.analysis().cloned() else {
        return;
    };
    let blocks = &analysis.entropy;
    if blocks.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let width = ui.available_width();
    let (rect, response) = ui.allocate_exact_size(Vec2::new(width, 140.0), Sense::click());
    let painter = ui.painter_at(rect);
    let plot = Rect::from_min_max(rect.min, Pos2::new(rect.right(), rect.bottom() - 14.0));
    painter.rect_filled(rect, 3.0, ui.visuals().extreme_bg_color);
    for level in [2.0f32, 4.0, 6.0] {
        let y = plot.bottom() - level / 8.0 * plot.height();
        painter.line_segment(
            [Pos2::new(plot.left(), y), Pos2::new(plot.right(), y)],
            Stroke::new(0.5, ui.visuals().weak_text_color().gamma_multiply(0.4)),
        );
    }
    let n = blocks.len() as f32;
    let bar_w = (plot.width() / n).max(1.0);
    for (i, &e) in blocks.iter().enumerate() {
        let x = plot.left() + i as f32 / n * plot.width();
        let h = e / 8.0 * plot.height();
        painter.rect_filled(
            Rect::from_min_max(
                Pos2::new(x, plot.bottom() - h),
                Pos2::new(x + bar_w, plot.bottom()),
            ),
            0.0,
            entropy_color(e),
        );
    }
    let size = analysis.info.size.max(1) as f32;
    for (i, s) in analysis
        .info
        .sections
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .filter(|(_, s)| s.file_size > 0)
    {
        let x0 = plot.left() + s.offset as f32 / size * plot.width();
        let x1 = plot.left() + s.offset.saturating_add(s.file_size) as f32 / size * plot.width();
        let band = Rect::from_min_max(
            Pos2::new(x0, plot.bottom() + 3.0),
            Pos2::new(x1.max(x0 + 1.0), rect.bottom() - 2.0),
        );
        painter.rect_filled(band, 1.0, crate::colors::section_color(i));
    }

    if let Some(pos) = response.hover_pos() {
        let frac = ((pos.x - plot.left()) / plot.width()).clamp(0.0, 0.9999);
        let offset = (frac * size) as u64;
        let index = (frac * n) as usize;
        let section = analysis
            .info
            .section_at_offset(offset)
            .map_or("no section", |s| s.name.as_str());
        let tip = format!(
            "offset 0x{offset:X} · {section}\nentropy {:.2}: {}",
            blocks[index],
            orress_bytes::entropy::describe(blocks[index])
        );
        if response.clicked() {
            doc.go_to(offset);
            cx.requests
                .push(ViewRequest::Open(doc.path.clone(), DocView::Hex));
        }
        response.on_hover_text(tip);
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Data inspector: the bytes at the cursor read as every common type.

use egui::{RichText, Ui};
use orress_bytes::Endian;
use orress_project::types::{Prim, TypeRef};
use orress_project::{DocStore, TypeCatalog};
use orress_ui::{ExplainExt as _, muted};

pub fn inspector(ui: &mut Ui, docs: &mut DocStore) {
    let Some(doc) = docs.active_mut() else {
        ui.heading("Inspector");
        ui.label("Open a file and click a byte in the hex view. The inspector shows what those bytes mean as numbers, text, dates and more.");
        return;
    };
    let Some(data) = doc.bytes().cloned() else {
        ui.spinner();
        return;
    };
    let offset = doc.cursor;
    let analysis = doc.analysis().cloned();

    ui.label(RichText::new(doc.file_name()).strong());
    egui::Grid::new("inspector_pos").num_columns(2).spacing([12.0, 3.0]).show(ui, |ui| {
        ui.label(RichText::new("Offset").weak()).explain("Offset", "Position of the cursor in the file, in hexadecimal and decimal.");
        ui.label(RichText::new(format!("0x{offset:X} ({offset})")).monospace());
        ui.end_row();
        if let Some(a) = &analysis {
            ui.label(RichText::new("Address").weak()).explain(
                "Address",
                "Where this byte is in memory when the program runs. Empty if the byte is not loaded (headers, overlay data).",
            );
            match a.info.offset_to_address(offset) {
                Some(va) => ui.label(RichText::new(format!("0x{va:X}")).monospace()),
                None => ui.label(muted("not loaded in memory")),
            };
            ui.end_row();
            ui.label(RichText::new("Section").weak());
            ui.label(a.info.section_at_offset(offset).map_or("—", |s| s.name.as_str()));
            ui.end_row();
        }
        if let Some((s, e)) = doc.selection {
            ui.label(RichText::new("Selection").weak());
            ui.label(format!("{} bytes", e.saturating_sub(s)));
            ui.end_row();
        }
    });

    // A type applied to this address: lay its fields out over the bytes.
    if let Some(addr) = analysis
        .as_ref()
        .and_then(|a| a.info.offset_to_address(offset))
        && let Some(applied) = doc.annotations.data_types.get(&addr).cloned()
    {
        let catalog = doc.type_catalog();
        applied_type(ui, &catalog, &applied, &data, offset as usize, doc.endian);
    }

    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.label(RichText::new("Byte order").weak()).explain(
            "Byte order (endianness)",
            "Multi-byte numbers can be stored lowest byte first (little-endian, used by x86 and \
             most ARM) or highest byte first (big-endian, used by network protocols). The bytes \
             01 00 00 00 are 1 in little-endian but 16777216 in big-endian.",
        );
        ui.selectable_value(&mut doc.endian, Endian::Little, "little");
        ui.selectable_value(&mut doc.endian, Endian::Big, "big");
    });
    ui.separator();

    let start = offset as usize;
    let bytes = &data[start.min(data.len())..(start + 16).min(data.len())];
    egui::ScrollArea::both()
        .auto_shrink([false, false])
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            egui::Grid::new("inspector_values")
                .num_columns(2)
                .striped(true)
                .spacing([12.0, 4.0])
                .show(ui, |ui| {
                    for item in orress_bytes::inspect::interpret(bytes, doc.endian) {
                        ui.label(RichText::new(item.label).weak())
                            .explain(item.label, item.explain);
                        let value = ui.add(
                            egui::Label::new(RichText::new(&item.value).monospace())
                                .sense(egui::Sense::click()),
                        );
                        if value.on_hover_text("Click to copy").clicked() {
                            ui.ctx().copy_text(item.value.clone());
                        }
                        ui.end_row();
                    }
                });
        });
}

/// Renders the fields of a type applied at the cursor: `+off  name : type = value`.
fn applied_type(
    ui: &mut Ui,
    catalog: &TypeCatalog,
    applied: &TypeRef,
    data: &[u8],
    base: usize,
    endian: Endian,
) {
    // Resolve the applied reference to a named user type we can lay out.
    let name = match applied {
        TypeRef::Named(n) => n.clone(),
        other => {
            ui.label(RichText::new("Applied type").strong());
            ui.label(muted(format!(
                "{} (apply a struct/union to see fields)",
                other.label()
            )));
            ui.separator();
            return;
        }
    };
    let Some(ty) = catalog.types.get(&name) else {
        return;
    };
    ui.label(RichText::new(format!("Applied type: {name}")).strong());
    match catalog.layout(ty) {
        Some(fields) if !fields.is_empty() => {
            egui::Grid::new("inspector_applied")
                .num_columns(4)
                .striped(true)
                .spacing([12.0, 3.0])
                .show(ui, |ui| {
                    for f in &fields {
                        ui.label(
                            RichText::new(format!("+0x{:X}", f.offset))
                                .monospace()
                                .weak(),
                        );
                        ui.label(&f.path);
                        let tylabel = if f.count > 1 {
                            format!("{}[{}]", f.ty.label(), f.count)
                        } else {
                            f.ty.label()
                        };
                        ui.label(RichText::new(tylabel).monospace().weak());
                        let at = base + f.offset as usize;
                        ui.label(
                            RichText::new(field_value(catalog, &f.ty, f.count, data, at, endian))
                                .monospace(),
                        );
                        ui.end_row();
                    }
                });
        }
        Some(_) => {
            ui.label(muted("(no fields — enum or typedef)"));
        }
        None => {
            ui.label(muted(
                "layout unavailable (unknown or self-referential member)",
            ));
        }
    }
    ui.separator();
}

/// Formats the value of one (possibly array) field read from `data` at `at`.
fn field_value(
    catalog: &TypeCatalog,
    ty: &TypeRef,
    count: u64,
    data: &[u8],
    at: usize,
    endian: Endian,
) -> String {
    let elem_size = catalog.size_of(ty).unwrap_or(0) as usize;
    // Char arrays read as text; other arrays show their element count.
    if count > 1 {
        if matches!(ty, TypeRef::Prim(Prim::Char | Prim::I8 | Prim::U8)) {
            let end = (at + count as usize).min(data.len());
            let raw = data.get(at..end).unwrap_or(&[]);
            let text: String = raw
                .iter()
                .take_while(|&&b| b != 0)
                .map(|&b| {
                    if (0x20..0x7f).contains(&b) {
                        b as char
                    } else {
                        '.'
                    }
                })
                .collect();
            return format!("\"{text}\"");
        }
        return format!("[{count} × {}]", ty.label());
    }
    let Some(bytes) = data.get(at..at + elem_size) else {
        return "—".into();
    };
    scalar_value(ty, bytes, endian)
}

/// Formats a single scalar value from its raw bytes.
fn scalar_value(ty: &TypeRef, bytes: &[u8], endian: Endian) -> String {
    let le = endian == Endian::Little;
    macro_rules! int {
        ($t:ty) => {{
            const N: usize = std::mem::size_of::<$t>();
            let mut buf = [0u8; N];
            if bytes.len() < N {
                return "—".into();
            }
            buf.copy_from_slice(&bytes[..N]);
            let v = if le {
                <$t>::from_le_bytes(buf)
            } else {
                <$t>::from_be_bytes(buf)
            };
            v.to_string()
        }};
    }
    match ty {
        TypeRef::Prim(Prim::U8) => int!(u8),
        TypeRef::Prim(Prim::I8) => int!(i8),
        TypeRef::Prim(Prim::U16) => int!(u16),
        TypeRef::Prim(Prim::I16) => int!(i16),
        TypeRef::Prim(Prim::U32) => int!(u32),
        TypeRef::Prim(Prim::I32) => int!(i32),
        TypeRef::Prim(Prim::U64) => int!(u64),
        TypeRef::Prim(Prim::I64) => int!(i64),
        TypeRef::Prim(Prim::F32) => {
            let mut buf = [0u8; 4];
            if bytes.len() < 4 {
                return "—".into();
            }
            buf.copy_from_slice(&bytes[..4]);
            let v = if le {
                f32::from_le_bytes(buf)
            } else {
                f32::from_be_bytes(buf)
            };
            format!("{v}")
        }
        TypeRef::Prim(Prim::F64) => {
            let mut buf = [0u8; 8];
            if bytes.len() < 8 {
                return "—".into();
            }
            buf.copy_from_slice(&bytes[..8]);
            let v = if le {
                f64::from_le_bytes(buf)
            } else {
                f64::from_be_bytes(buf)
            };
            format!("{v}")
        }
        TypeRef::Prim(Prim::Bool) => {
            if bytes.first() == Some(&0) {
                "false".into()
            } else {
                "true".into()
            }
        }
        TypeRef::Prim(Prim::Char) => {
            let b = bytes.first().copied().unwrap_or(0);
            if (0x20..0x7f).contains(&b) {
                format!("'{}'", b as char)
            } else {
                format!("0x{b:02X}")
            }
        }
        TypeRef::Prim(Prim::Void) => "void".into(),
        TypeRef::Pointer(_) => {
            // Pointer width follows the catalog; show as hex.
            let mut v: u64 = 0;
            for (i, &b) in bytes.iter().enumerate().take(8) {
                if le {
                    v |= (b as u64) << (8 * i);
                } else {
                    v = (v << 8) | b as u64;
                }
            }
            format!("0x{v:X}")
        }
        // A nested named type: show its raw bytes; apply it separately to expand.
        TypeRef::Named(n) => format!("<{n}>"),
    }
}
```

```rs
//! The Java class view: open a `.class` file and browse its header, fields (with recovered
//! constant values), and methods with a JVM bytecode disassembly — powered by the pure-Rust
//! `orress-java` loader. Parsing is cached per file.

use std::path::PathBuf;

use egui::{RichText, Ui};
use orress_java::{ClassFile, Member};
use orress_project::DocStore;
use orress_ui::muted;

/// Persistent UI state for the Java class tab.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct JavaView {
    key: Option<(PathBuf, usize, u64)>,
    class: Option<Result<ClassFile, String>>,
    /// Index into the methods list.
    selected: usize,
}

pub fn java_view(ui: &mut Ui, view: &mut JavaView, docs: &DocStore) {
    orress_ui::spotlight::mark(ui.ctx(), "view.Java", ui.max_rect());
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.label(RichText::new("Java class").strong());
        ui.label(muted("constant pool · fields · methods · JVM disassembly"));
    });
    ui.separator();

    let Some(doc) = docs.active() else {
        ui.label(muted("Open a .class file to inspect it."));
        return;
    };
    let Some(bytes) = doc.bytes() else {
        ui.label(muted("Reading the file…"));
        return;
    };
    if !orress_java::is_class(bytes) {
        ui.label(muted(format!(
            "{} is not a Java class file (no 0xCAFEBABE magic).",
            doc.file_name()
        )));
        return;
    }

    let key = (doc.path.clone(), bytes.len(), doc.generation);
    if view.key.as_ref() != Some(&key) {
        view.class = Some(orress_java::parse(bytes));
        // A patch or rename re-parses; only another file resets the selection (it is
        // clamped to the new contents below).
        if view.key.as_ref().map(|k| &k.0) != Some(&key.0) {
            view.selected = 0;
        }
        view.key = Some(key);
    }

    let cf = match view.class.as_ref().unwrap() {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(e) => {
            ui.colored_label(ui.visuals().error_fg_color, format!("Could not parse: {e}"));
            return;
        }
    };

    class_file_panel(ui, cf, &mut view.selected, "java");
}

/// Renders a parsed class file: header, fields (with recovered constants), a method list and the
/// selected method's JVM disassembly. Shared by the Java tab and the Archive tab (for `.class`
/// members); `id` keeps scroll areas distinct between callers.
pub(crate) fn class_file_panel(ui: &mut Ui, cf: &ClassFile, selected: &mut usize, id: &str) {
    // 0x20 on a class is ACC_SUPER (a historical artifact), not "synchronized".
    let flags = orress_java::access_flag_names(cf.access & !0x0020).join(" ");
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.label(
            RichText::new(format!("{flags} class {}", cf.this_class))
                .strong()
                .monospace(),
        );
        ui.label(muted(cf.java_version()));
    });
    if let Some(sup) = &cf.super_class {
        let impls = if cf.interfaces.is_empty() {
            String::new()
        } else {
            format!(" · implements {}", cf.interfaces.join(", "))
        };
        ui.label(muted(format!("extends {sup}{impls}")));
    }

    // Fields (with recovered compile-time constants).
    if !cf.fields.is_empty() {
        ui.add_space(4.0);
        ui.label(RichText::new("Fields").strong());
        for f in &cf.fields {
            let fl = orress_java::access_flag_names(f.access).join(" ");
            let cv = f
                .constant_value
                .map(|i| format!("  = {}", cf.cp.resolve(i)))
                .unwrap_or_default();
            ui.label(
                RichText::new(format!("  {fl} {}: {}{cv}", f.name, f.descriptor))
                    .monospace()
                    .weak(),
            );
        }
    }

    ui.add_space(6.0);
    ui.separator();

    if cf.methods.is_empty() {
        ui.label(muted("No methods."));
        return;
    }
    if *selected >= cf.methods.len() {
        *selected = 0;
    }

    ui.horizontal_top(|ui| {
        // Left: method list.
        ui.vertical(|ui| {
            ui.set_width(260.0);
            ui.label(muted(format!("{} methods", cf.methods.len())));
            egui::ScrollArea::vertical()
                .id_salt(format!("{id}-methods"))
                .auto_shrink([false, false])
                .show(ui, |ui| {
                    for (idx, m) in cf.methods.iter().enumerate() {
                        let label = format!("{}{}", m.name, m.descriptor);
                        if ui
                            .selectable_label(*selected == idx, RichText::new(label).monospace())
                            .clicked()
                        {
                            *selected = idx;
                        }
                    }
                });
        });
        ui.separator();
        // Right: selected method.
        ui.vertical(|ui| {
            if let Some(m) = cf.methods.get(*selected) {
                method_detail(ui, m, cf, id);
            }
        });
    });
}

fn method_detail(ui: &mut Ui, m: &Member, cf: &ClassFile, id: &str) {
    let flags = orress_java::access_flag_names(m.access).join(" ");
    ui.label(
        RichText::new(format!("{flags} {}{}", m.name, m.descriptor))
            .strong()
            .monospace(),
    );

    let Some(code) = &m.code else {
        ui.label(muted("No Code attribute (abstract or native method)."));
        return;
    };
    ui.label(muted(format!(
        "max_stack {} · max_locals {} · {} bytes",
        code.max_stack,
        code.max_locals,
        code.bytecode.len()
    )));
    if !code.exceptions.is_empty() {
        for e in &code.exceptions {
            let ty = e.catch_type.as_deref().unwrap_or("any");
            ui.label(
                RichText::new(format!(
                    "  catch {ty}: [{}..{}) → {}",
                    e.start, e.end, e.handler
                ))
                .monospace()
                .weak(),
            );
        }
    }

    ui.add_space(4.0);
    let insns = orress_java::disassemble(code, &cf.cp);
    ui.label(RichText::new(format!("Disassembly ({} instructions)", insns.len())).strong());
    egui::ScrollArea::both()
        .id_salt(format!("{id}-disasm"))
        .auto_shrink([false, false])
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            for ins in &insns {
                let marker = if ins.is_branch_target { ">>" } else { "  " };
                let line = format!(
                    "{marker} {:>4}: {:<16} {}",
                    ins.offset, ins.mnemonic, ins.operands
                );
                let text = RichText::new(line).monospace();
                if ins.is_branch_target {
                    ui.label(text.color(ui.visuals().hyperlink_color));
                } else {
                    ui.label(text);
                }
            }
        });
}
```

`crates/orress-views/src/js.rs`:

```rs
//! The JavaScript view: deobfuscate, beautify and extract strings from an open `.js` file (or any
//! text), powered by the pure-Rust `orress-js` transforms. Results are computed on demand and
//! cached until the file or the selected transform changes.

use std::path::PathBuf;

use egui::{RichText, Ui};
use orress_project::DocStore;
use orress_ui::muted;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum Mode {
    Deobfuscate,
    Beautify,
    Strings,
}

/// Persistent UI state for the JavaScript tab.
pub struct JsView {
    key: Option<(PathBuf, usize, u64)>,
    src: String,
    mode: Mode,
    /// Beautify the deobfuscated output.
    beautify_result: bool,
    out: Option<String>,
    strings: Vec<String>,
}

impl Default for JsView {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            key: None,
            src: String::new(),
            mode: Mode::Deobfuscate,
            beautify_result: true,
            out: None,
            strings: Vec::new(),
        }
    }
}

pub fn js_view(ui: &mut Ui, view: &mut JsView, docs: &DocStore) {
    orress_ui::spotlight::mark(ui.ctx(), "view.Js", ui.max_rect());
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.label(RichText::new("JavaScript").strong());
        ui.label(muted(
            "deobfuscate · beautify · extract strings (pure-Rust)",
        ));
    });
    ui.separator();

    let Some(doc) = docs.active() else {
        ui.label(muted("Open a .js file (or any text) to deobfuscate it."));
        return;
    };
    let Some(bytes) = doc.bytes() else {
        ui.label(muted("Reading the file…"));
        return;
    };

    let key = (doc.path.clone(), bytes.len(), doc.generation);
    if view.key.as_ref() != Some(&key) {
        view.src = String::from_utf8_lossy(bytes).into_owned();
        view.strings = orress_js::extract_strings(&view.src);
        view.out = None;
        view.key = Some(key);
    }

    let before = (view.mode, view.beautify_result);
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.selectable_value(&mut view.mode, Mode::Deobfuscate, "Deobfuscate");
        ui.selectable_value(&mut view.mode, Mode::Beautify, "Beautify");
        ui.selectable_value(&mut view.mode, Mode::Strings, "Strings");
        if view.mode == Mode::Deobfuscate {
            ui.separator();
            ui.checkbox(&mut view.beautify_result, "beautify result");
        }
    });
    if (view.mode, view.beautify_result) != before {
        view.out = None;
    }
    ui.add_space(4.0);

    if view.mode == Mode::Strings {
        strings_panel(ui, &view.strings);
        return;
    }

    // Compute (and cache) the transformed output.
    if view.out.is_none() {
        let out = match view.mode {
            Mode::Deobfuscate => {
                let d = orress_js::deobfuscate(&view.src);
                if view.beautify_result {
                    orress_js::beautify(&d)
                } else {
                    d
                }
            }
            Mode::Beautify => orress_js::beautify(&view.src),
            Mode::Strings => String::new(),
        };
        view.out = Some(out);
    }

    let out = view.out.as_deref().unwrap_or("");
    ui.label(muted(format!(
        "{} bytes in · {} bytes out",
        view.src.len(),
        out.len()
    )));
    egui::ScrollArea::both()
        .id_salt("js-output")
        .auto_shrink([false, false])
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            let mut buf = out;
            ui.add(
                egui::TextEdit::multiline(&mut buf)
                    .code_editor()
                    .desired_width(f32::INFINITY),
            );
        });
}

fn strings_panel(ui: &mut Ui, strings: &[String]) {
    if strings.is_empty() {
        ui.label(muted("No string literals found."));
        return;
    }
    ui.label(RichText::new(format!("{} distinct string(s)", strings.len())).strong());
    egui::ScrollArea::vertical()
        .id_salt("js-strings")
        .auto_shrink([false, false])
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            for s in strings {
                let interesting = looks_interesting(s);
                let text = RichText::new(format!("  {s:?}")).monospace();
                if interesting {
                    ui.label(text.color(ui.visuals().warn_fg_color));
                } else {
                    ui.label(text.weak());
                }
            }
        });
}

/// Highlights strings that often matter in a dropper: URLs, flags, commands, encoded blobs.
fn looks_interesting(s: &str) -> bool {
    let l = s.to_ascii_lowercase();
    l.contains("http")
        || l.contains("://")
        || l.contains("flag")
        || l.contains("eval")
        || l.contains("powershell")
        || l.contains("cmd")
        || l.contains(".exe")
        || l.contains("base64")
}
```

```rs
/// Asks where to save a patched copy of the file and writes it. Returns a status message.
pub fn save_patched(doc: &Document) -> String {
    let stem = doc
        .path
        .file_stem()
        .map_or_else(|| "file".into(), |s| s.to_string_lossy().into_owned());
    let ext = doc
        .path
        .extension()
        .map(|e| format!(".{}", e.to_string_lossy()))
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let dialog = rfd::FileDialog::new()
        .set_title("Save patched copy")
        .set_file_name(format!("{stem}.patched{ext}"));
    let dialog = match doc.path.parent() {
        Some(dir) => dialog.set_directory(dir),
        None => dialog,
    };
    match dialog.save_file() {
        Some(path) => match doc.export(&path) {
            Ok(()) => format!("Saved {}", path.display()),
            Err(e) => e,
        },
        None => "Not saved.".into(),
    }
}

/// The kinds of views a document can be shown in.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
pub enum DocView {
    Info,
    Hex,
    Sections,
    Imports,
    Strings,
    Disassembly,
    Graph,
    Functions,
}

impl DocView {
    pub const ALL: [Self; 8] = [
        Self::Info,
        Self::Functions,
        Self::Disassembly,
        Self::Graph,
        Self::Strings,
        Self::Imports,
        Self::Sections,
        Self::Hex,
    ];

    pub fn name(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Disassembly => "Disassembly",
            Self::Graph => "Graph",
            Self::Functions => "Functions",
            Self::Info => "Info",
            Self::Hex => "Hex",
            Self::Sections => "Sections",
            Self::Imports => "Imports",
            Self::Strings => "Strings",
        }
    }

    pub fn explain(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Disassembly => {
                "The program's machine code as assembly instructions, one per line, with names and cross-references."
            }
            Self::Graph => {
                "The current function as a flow chart: boxes of instructions joined by arrows for every jump."
            }
            Self::Functions => {
                "Every function found in the program, with size and number of callers."
            }
            Self::Info => {
                "What is this file? Format, protections, detected compiler or packer, hashes and tips on where to start."
            }
            Self::Hex => "The raw bytes of the file, as hexadecimal numbers and as text.",
            Self::Sections => {
                "The parts the file is divided into: code, data, resources. Each has a size, an address and permissions."
            }
            Self::Imports => {
                "Library functions the program uses, and functions it offers to others. A quick look at what it can do."
            }
            Self::Strings => {
                "Readable text found in the file: messages, file names, URLs, sometimes the password or flag itself."
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Commands from the app (keyboard shortcuts, palette) for the focused document view.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]

    GoTo,
    Find,
    FindNext,
    FindPrevious,
    CopyHex,
    CopyCArray,
    CopyPython,

/// Requests a view makes to the workspace.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ViewRequest {
    /// Open (or focus) a view of a document.
    Open(PathBuf, DocView),
    /// Show the cross-references panel (for the document's `xref_target`).
    ShowXrefs,
    /// Show a short message to the user.
    Message(String),
    /// Open generated text as a new, named scratch buffer in the code editor. The language (and
    /// so the highlighting) is inferred from `name`'s extension.
    OpenInEditor { name: String, contents: String },
    /// Install an extension from a source — a local directory path or a git URL.
    InstallExtension(String),
    /// Uninstall the extension with this id.
    UninstallExtension(String),
    /// Run an app command (action id), e.g. from a right-click menu.
    RunAction(String),
    /// Open an arbitrary file path (from the folder tree), routed the usual way: source/text to
    /// the editor, binaries to analysis.
    OpenPath(PathBuf),
    /// Reveal a path in the operating system's file manager.
    RevealInOs(PathBuf),
    /// Create a new notes file in this directory (prompting for a name), then open it.
    NewNotesFile(PathBuf),
    /// Extract the resources of this executable into the project folder.
    ExtractResources(PathBuf),
    /// Adopt this folder as the open project root (and persist it).
    SetProjectRoot(PathBuf),
}

/// Per-tab state of a document view. Not saved between sessions.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ViewState {
    pub hex: hex::HexState,
    strings: strings::StringsState,
    imports: imports::ImportsState,
    disasm: disasm::DisasmState,
    graph: graph::GraphState,
    functions: functions::FunctionsState,
}

/// The code analysis, or a message explaining why there is none yet.
fn program_or_message(ui: &mut Ui, doc: &Document) -> Option<Arc<Program>> {
    match doc.program_state() {
        None => {
            loading(
                ui,
                "Disassembling… finding functions and cross-references in the background.",
            );
            None
        }
        Some(None) => {
            let arch = doc
                .analysis()
                .map_or_else(String::new, |a| a.info.arch.clone());
            ui.label(format!(
                "ORRESS cannot disassemble this file yet (architecture: {arch}). Supported: x86, \
                 x86-64 and ARM64. The hex view, strings and imports still work."
            ));
            None
        }
        Some(Some(p)) => Some(Arc::clone(p)),
    }
}

/// Context passed to a view each frame.
pub struct ViewCtx<'a> {
    /// Commands for this view (only filled for the focused tab).
    pub commands: Vec<ViewCommand>,
    pub requests: &'a mut Vec<ViewRequest>,
    /// The debug session, so the disassembly can show the current instruction and
    /// breakpoints and toggle them.
    pub debugger: &'a mut DebugSession,
}

/// Draws `view` of the document at `path`, opening the document if needed.
pub fn show(
    ui: &mut Ui,
    docs: &mut DocStore,
    path: &std::path::Path,
    view: DocView,
    state: &mut ViewState,
    cx: &mut ViewCtx<'_>,
) {
    let doc = docs.open(path);
    match doc.data() {
        None => {
            loading(ui, &format!("Reading {}…", doc.file_name()));
            return;
        }
        Some(Err(e)) => {
            ui.colored_label(ui.visuals().error_fg_color, "Could not open this file");
            ui.label(e.as_str());
            return;
        }
        Some(Ok(_)) => {}
    }
    match view {
        DocView::Hex => hex::hex_view(ui, doc, &mut state.hex, cx),
        DocView::Info => with_analysis(ui, doc, |ui, doc| info::info(ui, doc, cx)),
        DocView::Sections => with_analysis(ui, doc, |ui, doc| sections::sections(ui, doc, cx)),
        DocView::Imports => with_analysis(ui, doc, |ui, doc| {
            imports::imports(ui, doc, &mut state.imports, cx)
        }),
        DocView::Disassembly => disasm::disasm_view(ui, doc, &mut state.disasm, cx),
        DocView::Graph => graph::graph_view(ui, doc, &mut state.graph, cx),
        DocView::Functions => functions::functions(ui, doc, &mut state.functions, cx),
        DocView::Strings => with_analysis(ui, doc, |ui, doc| {
            strings::strings(ui, doc, &mut state.strings, cx)
        }),
    }
}

fn with_analysis(ui: &mut Ui, doc: &mut Document, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Ui, &mut Document)) {
    if doc.analysis().is_none() {
        loading(
            ui,
            "Analyzing… (this runs in the background; the hex view already works)",
        );
        return;
    }
    f(ui, doc);
}

fn loading(ui: &mut Ui, text: &str) {
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.spinner();
        ui.label(RichText::new(text).weak());
    });
}

/// `0x1A2B` style address formatting, padded for the file's pointer size.
pub fn fmt_addr(value: u64, wide: bool) -> String {
    if wide {
        format!("0x{value:016X}")
    } else {
        format!("0x{value:08X}")
    }
}
```

`crates/orress-views/src/menu.rs`:

```rs
//! Right-click menus. Each code view adds its own actions for what was clicked, then the
//! shared part: every view that can be opened, and every command of the app, grouped like
//! the command palette. The app publishes its command list with [`set_commands`].

use std::sync::Arc;

use egui::{Context, Ui};
use orress_ui::ExplainExt as _;

use crate::ViewRequest;

/// One app command, as the menus show it.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct CommandEntry {
    /// Action id, e.g. `view::Decompiler`.
    pub id: String,
    pub title: String,
    pub explain: String,
    /// Shortcut label, e.g. `Ctrl+D`, if any.
    pub shortcut: Option<String>,
}

fn commands_id() -> egui::Id {
    egui::Id::new("orress::menu_commands")
}

/// Publishes the app's commands for the right-click menus.
pub fn set_commands(ctx: &Context, commands: Vec<CommandEntry>) {
    ctx.data_mut(|d| d.insert_temp(commands_id(), Arc::new(commands)));
}

fn commands(ctx: &Context) -> Arc<Vec<CommandEntry>> {
    ctx.data(|d| d.get_temp::<Arc<Vec<CommandEntry>>>(commands_id()))
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

/// File views, in the order of the View menu.
const FILE_VIEWS: &[&str] = &[
    "file::Info",
    "file::Functions",
    "view::Disassembly",
    "view::Graph",
    "view::Decompiler",
    "file::Strings",
    "file::Imports",
    "file::Sections",
    "file::Hex",
    "view::Xrefs",
];

/// `view::` commands that change the look instead of opening a view.
const NOT_VIEWS: &[&str] = &[
    "view::ZoomIn",
    "view::ZoomOut",
    "view::ZoomReset",
    "view::ToggleExplainMode",
];

/// A menu item that runs the command `id`; nothing if the app has no such command.
pub(crate) fn command(ui: &mut Ui, requests: &mut Vec<ViewRequest>, id: &str) {
    let all = commands(ui.ctx());
    if let Some(c) = all.iter().find(|c| c.id == id) {
        item(ui, requests, c);
    }
}

fn item(ui: &mut Ui, requests: &mut Vec<ViewRequest>, c: &CommandEntry) {
    let button =
        egui::Button::new(c.title.as_str()).shortcut_text(c.shortcut.clone().unwrap_or_default());
    if ui.add(button).explain(&c.title, &c.explain).clicked() {
        requests.push(ViewRequest::RunAction(c.id.clone()));
        ui.close();
    }
}

/// "Open view" and "All commands" submenus, shared by every right-click menu.
pub(crate) fn views_and_commands(ui: &mut Ui, requests: &mut Vec<ViewRequest>) {
    let all = commands(ui.ctx());
    if all.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    ui.separator();
    ui.menu_button("Open view", |ui| {
        for id in FILE_VIEWS {
            if let Some(c) = all.iter().find(|c| c.id == *id) {
                item(ui, requests, c);
            }
        }
        ui.separator();
        let mut tools: Vec<&CommandEntry> = all
            .iter()
            .filter(|c| {
                c.id.starts_with("view::")
                    && !FILE_VIEWS.contains(&c.id.as_str())
                    && !NOT_VIEWS.contains(&c.id.as_str())
            })
            .collect();
        tools.sort_by(|a, b| a.title.cmp(&b.title));
        for c in tools {
            item(ui, requests, c);
        }
    });
    ui.menu_button("All commands", |ui| {
        let mut groups: Vec<&str> = Vec::new();
        for c in all.iter() {
            let group = namespace(&c.id);
            if !groups.contains(&group) {
                groups.push(group);
            }
        }
        for group in groups {
            ui.menu_button(group_title(group), |ui| {
                egui::ScrollArea::vertical()
                    .max_height(480.0)
                    .show(ui, |ui| {
                        for c in all.iter().filter(|c| namespace(&c.id) == group) {
                            item(ui, requests, c);
                        }
                    });
            });
        }
    });
}

fn namespace(id: &str) -> &str {
    id.split_once("::").map_or(id, |(ns, _)| ns)
}

/// `command_palette` -> `Command palette`.
fn group_title(namespace: &str) -> String {
    let words = namespace.replace('_', " ");
    let mut chars = words.chars();
    chars.next().map_or_else(String::new, |first| {
        first.to_uppercase().chain(chars).collect()
    })
}

/// Copy items shared by the code views.
pub(crate) fn copy_item(ui: &mut Ui, label: &str, text: String) {
    if ui.button(label).clicked() {
        ui.ctx().copy_text(text);
        ui.close();
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn groups_by_namespace() {
        assert_eq!(namespace("view::Graph"), "view");
        assert_eq!(group_title("command_palette"), "Command palette");
        assert_eq!(group_title("hex"), "Hex");
    }
}
```

`crates/orress-views/src/project.rs`:

```rs
//! Project overview (left dock): open files and their views.

use egui::{RichText, Ui};
use orress_project::DocStore;
use orress_ui::{ExplainExt as _, muted};

use crate::{DocView, ViewRequest};

pub fn project_tree(ui: &mut Ui, docs: &DocStore, requests: &mut Vec<ViewRequest>) {
    if docs.iter().next().is_none() {
        ui.heading("Project");
        ui.label("No files open. Use File > Open (Ctrl+O) or drop a file on the window.");
        return;
    }
    for doc in docs.iter() {
        let active = docs.active.as_deref() == Some(doc.path.as_path());
        let title = RichText::new(doc.file_name());
        egui::CollapsingHeader::new(if active { title.strong() } else { title })
            .id_salt(&doc.path)
            .default_open(true)
            .show(ui, |ui| {
                match (doc.data(), doc.analysis()) {
                    (None, _) => {
                        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                            ui.spinner();
                            ui.label(muted("reading…"));
                        });
                    }
                    (Some(Err(e)), _) => {
                        ui.colored_label(ui.visuals().error_fg_color, e);
                        return;
                    }
                    (Some(Ok(_)), None) => {
                        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                            ui.spinner();
                            ui.label(muted("analyzing…"));
                        });
                    }
                    (Some(Ok(_)), Some(a)) => {
                        ui.label(muted(format!("{} · {}", a.info.format.name(), a.info.arch)));
                    }
                }
                for view in DocView::ALL {
                    let mut label = view.name().to_owned();
                    if let Some(a) = doc.analysis() {
                        match view {
                            DocView::Sections => label += &format!(" ({})", a.info.sections.len()),
                            DocView::Imports => label += &format!(" ({})", a.info.imports.len()),
                            DocView::Strings => label += &format!(" ({})", a.strings.len()),
                            DocView::Functions => {
                                if let Some(p) = doc.program() {
                                    label += &format!(" ({})", p.functions.len());
                                }
                            }
                            _ => {}
                        }
                    }
                    let response = ui
                        .selectable_label(false, label)
                        .explain(view.name(), view.explain());
                    orress_ui::spotlight::mark(
                        ui.ctx(),
                        &format!("tree.{}", view.name()),
                        response.rect,
                    );
                    if response.clicked() {
                        requests.push(ViewRequest::Open(doc.path.clone(), view));
                    }
                }
            });
    }
}
```

`crates/orress-views/src/prototype.rs`:

```rs
//! The "set prototype" editor for the decompiler: pin a function's return type and named,
//! typed parameters so the decompiler prints that signature instead of the recovered one.
//! It writes `func_prototypes` on the document; the decompiler consumes them (see
//! `orress_decompiler::decompile_with`). Types come from the same catalog the Types view edits.

use egui::{RichText, Ui};
use orress_project::Document;
use orress_project::types::{FuncProto, Prim};
use orress_ui::muted;

use crate::typepick::{Base, base_combo, from_typeref, to_typeref};

/// One parameter being edited: a name and a base type with an optional pointer.
#[derive(Clone)]
struct ParamDraft {
    name: String,
    base: Base,
    pointer: bool,
}

impl ParamDraft {
    fn blank(i: usize) -> Self {
        Self {
            name: format!("a{}", i + 1),
            base: Base::Prim(Prim::U64),
            pointer: false,
        }
    }
}

/// The in-progress prototype for one function.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct ProtoDraft {
    func: u64,
    ret_enabled: bool,
    ret_base: Base,
    ret_pointer: bool,
    params: Vec<ParamDraft>,
}

impl ProtoDraft {
    /// Loads the saved prototype for `func`, or a blank one-parameter draft.
    pub(crate) fn load(doc: &Document, func: u64) -> Self {
        if let Some(p) = doc.annotations.func_prototypes.get(&func) {
            let (ret_base, ret_pointer) = p
                .ret
                .as_ref()
                .map(from_typeref)
                .unwrap_or((Base::Prim(Prim::U64), false));
            let params = p
                .params
                .iter()
                .map(|(name, ty)| {
                    let (base, pointer) = from_typeref(ty);
                    ParamDraft {
                        name: name.clone(),
                        base,
                        pointer,
                    }
                })
                .collect();
            Self {
                func,
                ret_enabled: p.ret.is_some(),
                ret_base,
                ret_pointer,
                params,
            }
        } else {
            Self {
                func,
                ret_enabled: false,
                ret_base: Base::Prim(Prim::U64),
                ret_pointer: false,
                params: vec![ParamDraft::blank(0)],
            }
        }
    }

    fn to_proto(&self) -> FuncProto {
        FuncProto {
            ret: self
                .ret_enabled
                .then(|| to_typeref(&self.ret_base, self.ret_pointer)),
            params: self
                .params
                .iter()
                .enumerate()
                .map(|(i, p)| {
                    let name = if p.name.trim().is_empty() {
                        format!("a{}", i + 1)
                    } else {
                        p.name.trim().to_owned()
                    };
                    (name, to_typeref(&p.base, p.pointer))
                })
                .collect(),
        }
    }
}

/// Draws the prototype editor as a window while `draft` is set. Applies changes to `doc`
/// and clears `draft` when the user saves, clears or closes.
pub(crate) fn window(ui: &mut Ui, draft: &mut Option<ProtoDraft>, doc: &mut Document, name: &str) {
    let Some(d) = draft.as_mut() else {
        return;
    };
    let names: Vec<String> = doc.type_catalog().types.keys().cloned().collect();
    let has_saved = doc.annotations.func_prototypes.contains_key(&d.func);

    let mut open = true;
    let mut close = false;
    let mut save = false;
    let mut clear = false;

    egui::Window::new(format!("Prototype — {name}"))
        .id(egui::Id::new(("orress::proto_window", d.func)))
        .collapsible(false)
        .resizable(true)
        .open(&mut open)
        .show(ui.ctx(), |ui| {
            ui.label(muted(format!("Function at 0x{:x}", d.func)));
            ui.separator();

            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                ui.checkbox(&mut d.ret_enabled, "Returns");
                ui.add_enabled_ui(d.ret_enabled, |ui| {
                    base_combo(ui, usize::MAX, &mut d.ret_base, &names);
                    ui.checkbox(&mut d.ret_pointer, "pointer");
                });
            });
            ui.separator();

            ui.label(RichText::new("Parameters").strong());
            let mut remove = None;
            egui::Grid::new("proto_params")
                .num_columns(4)
                .spacing([8.0, 4.0])
                .show(ui, |ui| {
                    ui.label(muted("name"));
                    ui.label(muted("type"));
                    ui.label(muted("ptr"));
                    ui.label("");
                    ui.end_row();
                    for (i, p) in d.params.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                        ui.add(egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut p.name).desired_width(120.0));
                        base_combo(ui, i, &mut p.base, &names);
                        ui.checkbox(&mut p.pointer, "");
                        if ui.small_button("✕").clicked() {
                            remove = Some(i);
                        }
                        ui.end_row();
                    }
                });
            if let Some(i) = remove {
                d.params.remove(i);
            }
            if ui.button("+ Add parameter").clicked() {
                let n = d.params.len();
                d.params.push(ParamDraft::blank(n));
            }

            ui.separator();
            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                if ui.button("Save").clicked() {
                    save = true;
                }
                if has_saved && ui.button("Clear prototype").clicked() {
                    clear = true;
                }
                if ui.button("Close").clicked() {
                    close = true;
                }
            });
            ui.label(muted(
                "Names come from the Types view; pointer-to-struct params print as field accesses.",
            ));
        });

    if save {
        let proto = d.to_proto();
        doc.set_prototype(d.func, proto);
    }
    if clear {
        doc.clear_prototype(d.func);
    }
    if !open || close || save || clear {
        *draft = None;
    }
}
```

`crates/orress-views/src/pyc.rs`:

```rs
//! The Python bytecode view: open a `.pyc` and browse its code-object tree (module, functions,
//! comprehensions) with each one's metadata, constants, names and a disassembly, powered by the
//! pure-Rust `orress-pyc` loader. Parsing is cached per file.

use std::path::PathBuf;

use egui::{RichText, Ui};
use orress_project::DocStore;
use orress_pyc::{CodeObject, Insn, Pyc};
use orress_ui::muted;

/// Persistent UI state for the Python bytecode tab.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct PycView {
    key: Option<(PathBuf, usize, u64)>,
    pyc: Option<Result<Pyc, String>>,
    /// Index into the flattened code-object tree.
    selected: usize,
}

/// Flattens the code-object tree depth-first into `(depth, code)` pairs.
fn flatten<'a>(code: &'a CodeObject, depth: usize, out: &mut Vec<(usize, &'a CodeObject)>) {
    out.push((depth, code));
    for nested in code.nested() {
        flatten(nested, depth + 1, out);
    }
}

pub fn pyc_view(ui: &mut Ui, view: &mut PycView, docs: &DocStore) {
    orress_ui::spotlight::mark(ui.ctx(), "view.Pyc", ui.max_rect());
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.label(RichText::new("Python bytecode").strong());
        ui.label(muted(
            "code-object tree · disassembly (pure-Rust .pyc loader)",
        ));
    });
    ui.separator();

    let Some(doc) = docs.active() else {
        ui.label(muted("Open a .pyc file to inspect it."));
        return;
    };
    let Some(bytes) = doc.bytes() else {
        ui.label(muted("Reading the file…"));
        return;
    };
    if !orress_pyc::looks_like_pyc(bytes) {
        ui.label(muted(format!(
            "{} is not a .pyc file (no Python magic + \\r\\n header).",
            doc.file_name()
        )));
        return;
    }

    let key = (doc.path.clone(), bytes.len(), doc.generation);
    if view.key.as_ref() != Some(&key) {
        view.pyc = Some(orress_pyc::parse(bytes));
        // A patch or rename re-parses; only another file resets the selection (it is
        // clamped to the new contents below).
        if view.key.as_ref().map(|k| &k.0) != Some(&key.0) {
            view.selected = 0;
        }
        view.key = Some(key);
    }

    let pyc = match view.pyc.as_ref().unwrap() {
        Ok(p) => p,
        Err(e) => {
            ui.colored_label(ui.visuals().error_fg_color, format!("Could not parse: {e}"));
            return;
        }
    };

    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.label(RichText::new(pyc.version_label()).strong());
        ui.label(muted(format!(
            "magic {} · {} · {}-byte header",
            pyc.magic,
            if pyc.hash_based {
                "hash-based"
            } else {
                "timestamp"
            },
            pyc.header_len
        )));
    });
    if !pyc.can_disassemble() {
        ui.label(muted(
            "ORRESS doesn't bundle this Python version's opcode table yet — showing structure, \
             constants and raw bytecode. (Named disassembly: 3.14.)",
        ));
    }
    ui.add_space(4.0);

    let mut flat = Vec::new();
    flatten(&pyc.top, 0, &mut flat);
    if view.selected >= flat.len() {
        view.selected = 0;
    }

    ui.horizontal_top(|ui| {
        // Left: the code-object tree.
        ui.vertical(|ui| {
            ui.set_width(250.0);
            ui.label(muted(format!("{} code objects", flat.len())));
            egui::ScrollArea::vertical()
                .id_salt("pyc-tree")
                .auto_shrink([false, false])
                .show(ui, |ui| {
                    for (idx, (depth, c)) in flat.iter().enumerate() {
                        let label = format!("{}{}", "   ".repeat(*depth), c.name);
                        if ui
                            .selectable_label(
                                view.selected == idx,
                                RichText::new(label).monospace(),
                            )
                            .clicked()
                        {
                            view.selected = idx;
                        }
                    }
                });
        });
        ui.separator();
        // Right: the selected code object.
        ui.vertical(|ui| {
            if let Some((_, code)) = flat.get(view.selected) {
                code_detail(ui, code, pyc);
            }
        });
    });
}

fn code_detail(ui: &mut Ui, code: &CodeObject, pyc: &Pyc) {
    ui.label(RichText::new(code.signature()).strong().monospace());
    if let Some(doc) = code.docstring() {
        let one_line = doc.lines().next().unwrap_or("");
        ui.label(
            RichText::new(format!("  \"\"\"{one_line}\"\"\""))
                .monospace()
                .weak(),
        );
    }
    let flags = orress_pyc::flag_names(code.flags).join(" | ");
    ui.label(muted(format!(
        "args: {} (+{} pos-only, {} kw-only) · stack {} · flags 0x{:x} {}",
        code.argcount, code.posonlyargcount, code.kwonlyargcount, code.stacksize, code.flags, flags
    )));
    if !code.filename.is_empty() {
        ui.label(muted(format!(
            "file: {} · line {}",
            code.filename, code.firstlineno
        )));
    }

    egui::ScrollArea::both()
        .id_salt("pyc-detail")
        .auto_shrink([false, false])
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            // Constants & names (where flags and strings usually hide).
            if !code.consts.is_empty() {
                ui.add_space(4.0);
                ui.label(RichText::new("Constants").strong());
                for (i, c) in code.consts.iter().enumerate() {
                    ui.label(
                        RichText::new(format!("  [{i}] {}", c.render()))
                            .monospace()
                            .weak(),
                    );
                }
            }
            if !code.names.is_empty() {
                ui.add_space(4.0);
                ui.label(RichText::new("Names").strong());
                ui.label(
                    RichText::new(format!("  {}", code.names.join(", ")))
                        .monospace()
                        .weak(),
                );
            }

            ui.add_space(6.0);
            match orress_pyc::disassemble(code, pyc.version) {
                Some(insns) => disasm_table(ui, &insns),
                None => {
                    ui.label(RichText::new("Raw bytecode").strong());
                    ui.label(RichText::new(hex_dump(&code.code)).monospace().weak());
                }
            }
        });
}

fn disasm_table(ui: &mut Ui, insns: &[Insn]) {
    ui.label(RichText::new(format!("Disassembly ({} instructions)", insns.len())).strong());
    for ins in insns {
        let marker = if ins.is_jump_target { ">>" } else { "  " };
        let arg = match (ins.arg, &ins.argval) {
            (Some(a), Some(v)) => format!("{a:<5} ({v})"),
            (Some(a), None) => format!("{a}"),
            (None, _) => String::new(),
        };
        let line = format!("{marker} {:>5}  {:<28} {}", ins.offset, ins.opname, arg);
        let text = RichText::new(line).monospace();
        if ins.is_jump_target {
            ui.label(text.color(ui.visuals().hyperlink_color));
        } else {
            ui.label(text);
        }
    }
}

fn hex_dump(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    bytes
        .iter()
        .take(2048)
        .enumerate()
        .map(|(i, b)| {
            if i % 16 == 15 {
                format!("{b:02x}\n")
            } else {
                format!("{b:02x} ")
            }
        })
        .collect()
}
```

`crates/orress-views/src/resources.rs`:

```rs
//! The Resources view: list everything inside the open executable — native Win32 resources,
//! embedded files, sections and overlay — and extract a selection into the project folder.
//! The extraction engine is `orress-resources`; this is the egui front end.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use egui::{RichText, Ui};
use orress_project::DocStore;
use orress_resources::{Resource, ResourceKind};
use orress_ui::muted;

use crate::ViewRequest;

/// Persistent UI state for the Resources tab.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ResourcesView {
    /// The file the cache belongs to (path + generation), so a new file or a patch re-scans.
    doc: Option<(PathBuf, u64)>,
    items: Vec<Resource>,
    selected: Vec<bool>,
}

impl ResourcesView {
    fn ensure(&mut self, path: &Path, generation: u64, bytes: &[u8]) {
        if self
            .doc
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|(p, g)| p == path && *g == generation)
        {
            return;
        }
        self.items = orress_resources::extract(bytes);
        self.selected = vec![false; self.items.len()];
        self.doc = Some((path.to_path_buf(), generation));
    }
}

pub fn resources_view(
    ui: &mut Ui,
    view: &mut ResourcesView,
    docs: &DocStore,
    project_root: Option<&Path>,
    requests: &mut Vec<ViewRequest>,
) {
    orress_ui::spotlight::mark(ui.ctx(), "view.Resources", ui.max_rect());
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.label(RichText::new("Resources").strong());
        ui.label(muted(
            "icons · manifest · version · embedded files · sections · overlay",
        ));
    });
    ui.separator();

    let Some(doc) = docs.active() else {
        ui.label(muted("Open an executable to pull its resources out of it."));
        return;
    };
    let Some(bytes) = doc.bytes() else {
        ui.label(muted("Reading the file…"));
        return;
    };
    let path = doc.path.clone();
    view.ensure(&path, doc.generation, bytes);

    if view.items.is_empty() {
        ui.label(muted(format!(
            "Nothing extractable found in {}.",
            doc.file_name()
        )));
        return;
    }

    let stem = path
        .file_stem()
        .map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "file".into());

    // Controls.
    ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
        if ui.button("Select all").clicked() {
            view.selected.iter_mut().for_each(|s| *s = true);
        }
        if ui.button("Select none").clicked() {
            view.selected.iter_mut().for_each(|s| *s = false);
        }
        let any = view.selected.iter().any(|&s| s);
        ui.separator();
        if ui
            .add_enabled(any, egui::Button::new("Extract selected"))
            .clicked()
        {
            let chosen: Vec<Resource> = view
                .items
                .iter()
                .zip(&view.selected)
                .filter(|&(_, &s)| s)
                .map(|(r, _)| r.clone())
                .collect();
            extract_to_project(ui, &chosen, &stem, project_root, requests);
        }
        if ui.button("Extract all").clicked() {
            let all = view.items.clone();
            extract_to_project(ui, &all, &stem, project_root, requests);
        }
    });
    match project_root {
        Some(root) => ui.label(muted(format!(
            "Extracts into {}",
            root.join("extracted").join(&stem).display()
        ))),
        None => ui.label(muted(
            "No project folder open — extracting will ask for one (and adopt it as the project).",
        )),
    };
    ui.separator();

    // The list, grouped by kind.
    egui::ScrollArea::vertical()
        .auto_shrink([false, false])
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            for kind in [
                ResourceKind::Resource,
                ResourceKind::Embedded,
                ResourceKind::Overlay,
                ResourceKind::Section,
            ] {
                let indices: Vec<usize> = view
                    .items
                    .iter()
                    .enumerate()
                    .filter(|(_, r)| r.kind == kind)
                    .map(|(i, _)| i)
                    .collect();
                if indices.is_empty() {
                    continue;
                }
                ui.add_space(4.0);
                ui.label(RichText::new(group_title(kind, indices.len())).strong());
                for i in indices {
                    let r = &view.items[i];
                    let detail = match r.offset {
                        Some(o) => {
                            format!("{}  ·  {}  ·  0x{o:x}", r.ext, human_size(r.data.len()))
                        }
                        None => format!("{}  ·  {}", r.ext, human_size(r.data.len())),
                    };
                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                        ui.checkbox(&mut view.selected[i], "");
                        ui.label(&r.name);
                        ui.label(muted(detail));
                    });
                }
            }
        });
}

/// Writes `chosen` to `<project>/extracted/<stem>/`; with no project open, asks for a folder and
/// adopts it as the project root first.
fn extract_to_project(
    ui: &Ui,
    chosen: &[Resource],
    stem: &str,
    project_root: Option<&Path>,
    requests: &mut Vec<ViewRequest>,
) {
    if chosen.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let root = match project_root {
        Some(r) => r.to_path_buf(),
        None => {
            let Some(dir) = rfd::FileDialog::new()
                .set_title("Choose a project folder for the extracted files")
                .pick_folder()
            else {
                return;
            };
            requests.push(ViewRequest::SetProjectRoot(dir.clone()));
            dir
        }
    };
    let dest = root.join("extracted").join(stem);
    match orress_resources::write_all(chosen, &dest) {
        Ok(paths) => {
            requests.push(ViewRequest::Message(format!(
                "Extracted {} file{} to {}",
                paths.len(),
                if paths.len() == 1 { "" } else { "s" },
                dest.display()
            )));
        }
        Err(e) => requests.push(ViewRequest::Message(format!("Extraction failed: {e}"))),
    }
    // The folder tree re-reads on its next frame / Refresh.
    ui.ctx().request_repaint();
}

fn group_title(kind: ResourceKind, n: usize) -> String {
    let name = match kind {
        ResourceKind::Resource => "Native resources",
        ResourceKind::Embedded => "Embedded files",
        ResourceKind::Overlay => "Overlay",
        ResourceKind::Section => "Sections",
    };
    format!("{name} ({n})")
}

fn human_size(bytes: usize) -> String {
    const KB: usize = 1024;
    const MB: usize = KB * 1024;
    if bytes >= MB {
        format!("{:.1} MB", bytes as f64 / MB as f64)
    } else if bytes >= KB {
        format!("{:.1} KB", bytes as f64 / KB as f64)
    } else {
        format!("{bytes} B")
    }
}
```
