`crates/orress-views/src/sandbox.rs`:

```rs
//! The Sandbox view: the safety gate for dynamic analysis. It shows whether ORRESS is running
//! inside a VM, the execution-guard decision, and — only once the guard allows (in a VM, with an
//! explicit confirmation) — lets you run the sample and watch its activity log. Running happens
//! on a background thread so the UI stays responsive.

use std::net::Ipv4Addr;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::str::FromStr;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use egui::{RichText, Ui};
use orress_project::DocStore;
use orress_sandbox::vbox::{self, Vm};
use orress_sandbox::{
    ActivityEvent, Category, Decision, FakeNet, FakeNetConfig, Monitor, NetEvent, NetKind, Policy,
    RunEvent, RunLog, VmEvidence, detect, guard, run,
};
use orress_ui::muted;

/// Persistent UI state for the Sandbox tab.
pub struct SandboxView {
    policy: Policy,
    confirmed: bool,
    exe_path: String,
    args: String,
    timeout_secs: u32,
    vm: Option<VmEvidence>,
    result: Arc<Mutex<Option<RunLog>>>,
    running: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    fakenet: Option<FakeNet>,
    answer_ip: String,
    dns_port: u16,
    http_port: u16,
    // VirtualBox control
    /// Whether VBoxManage exists, checked once (it is a filesystem search).
    vbox_available: Option<bool>,
    vbox_loaded: bool,
    vbox_vms: Vec<Vm>,
    vbox_sel: usize,
    vbox_state: String,
    vbox_snaps: Vec<String>,
    vbox_snap_name: String,
    vbox_status: Arc<Mutex<String>>,
    vbox_busy: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    /// VM list, state and snapshots queried on a worker thread (VBoxManage is slow).
    vbox_info: Arc<Mutex<Option<VboxInfo>>>,
    // ETW activity monitor
    monitor: Option<Monitor>,
    monitor_error: Option<String>,
    monitor_filter_pid: String,
    /// The monitor's events, topped up periodically with only the new ones (copying up to 50k
    /// events every refresh is too slow), with the indices that pass the PID filter.
    etw_snapshot: Vec<ActivityEvent>,
    /// How many of the monitor's events have been read so far (for `events_since`).
    etw_seen: usize,
    etw_shown: Vec<usize>,
    etw_key: Option<(Instant, Option<u32>)>,
    /// The newest fake-network events, topped up periodically with only the new ones.
    net_snapshot: Vec<NetEvent>,
    /// How many fake-network events have been read so far (for `events_since`).
    net_seen: usize,
    net_at: Option<Instant>,
}

/// How often the activity logs are re-read while live.
const LOG_REFRESH: Duration = Duration::from_millis(500);
/// Fake-network log entries shown (the newest).
const MAX_NET_SHOWN: usize = 1_000;
/// Activity-monitor events kept for display (the monitor's own cap); beyond this the oldest fifth
/// is dropped.
const MAX_ETW_KEPT: usize = 50_000;

/// What VBoxManage reported for the VM list and the selected VM.
struct VboxInfo {
    vms: Vec<Vm>,
    selected: usize,
    state: String,
    snaps: Vec<String>,
}

/// Lists the VMs and reads the state and snapshots of `selected` (by name; the first VM if
/// it is gone). Runs VBoxManage several times, so call it off the UI thread.
fn vbox_query(selected: Option<&str>) -> VboxInfo {
    let vms = vbox::list_vms().unwrap_or_default();
    let selected = selected
        .and_then(|n| vms.iter().position(|v| v.name == n))
        .unwrap_or(0);
    let (state, snaps) = match vms.get(selected) {
        Some(vm) => (
            vbox::state(&vm.name).unwrap_or_else(|e| e),
            vbox::snapshots(&vm.name).unwrap_or_default(),
        ),
        None => (String::new(), Vec::new()),
    };
    VboxInfo {
        vms,
        selected,
        state,
        snaps,
    }
}

impl Default for SandboxView {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            policy: Policy::default(),
            confirmed: false,
            exe_path: String::new(),
            args: String::new(),
            timeout_secs: 20,
            vm: None,
            result: Arc::new(Mutex::new(None)),
            running: Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),
            fakenet: None,
            answer_ip: "127.0.0.1".into(),
            dns_port: 53,
            http_port: 80,
            vbox_available: None,
            vbox_loaded: false,
            vbox_vms: Vec::new(),
            vbox_sel: 0,
            vbox_state: String::new(),
            vbox_snaps: Vec::new(),
            vbox_snap_name: "clean".into(),
            vbox_status: Arc::new(Mutex::new(String::new())),
            vbox_busy: Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),
            vbox_info: Arc::new(Mutex::new(None)),
            monitor: None,
            monitor_error: None,
            monitor_filter_pid: String::new(),
            etw_snapshot: Vec::new(),
            etw_seen: 0,
            etw_shown: Vec::new(),
            etw_key: None,
            net_snapshot: Vec::new(),
            net_seen: 0,
            net_at: None,
        }
    }
}

pub fn sandbox_view(ui: &mut Ui, view: &mut SandboxView, docs: &DocStore) {
    orress_ui::spotlight::mark(ui.ctx(), "view.Sandbox", ui.max_rect());
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.label(RichText::new("Sandbox").strong());
        ui.label(muted("safety gate · VM check · guarded run"));
    });
    ui.separator();

    let vm = view.vm.get_or_insert_with(detect);
    let in_vm = vm.looks_like_vm();

    // --- VM status -------------------------------------------------------
    if in_vm {
        let vendor = vm
            .vendor
            .clone()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "guest additions".into());
        ui.colored_label(
            egui::Color32::from_rgb(90, 180, 90),
            format!("✔ Running inside a VM ({vendor})"),
        );
    } else if vm.ambiguous() {
        let vendor = vm.vendor.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".into());
        ui.colored_label(
            ui.visuals().warn_fg_color,
            format!(
                "⚠ Hypervisor present ({vendor}) but this is NOT a confirmed VM — on Windows this \
                 is usually VBS on a physical host. Treating as bare metal."
            ),
        );
    } else {
        ui.colored_label(
            ui.visuals().warn_fg_color,
            "⚠ No VM detected — this looks like a bare-metal host.",
        );
    }
    for hint in &vm.hints {
        ui.label(muted(format!("   • {hint}")));
    }
    ui.add_space(8.0);

    vbox_section(ui, view);
    ui.add_space(8.0);

    fakenet_section(ui, view);
    ui.add_space(8.0);

    monitor_section(ui, view);
    ui.add_space(8.0);

    // --- Policy ----------------------------------------------------------
    ui.heading("Policy");
    ui.checkbox(&mut view.policy.require_vm, "Refuse to run outside a VM");
    ui.checkbox(
        &mut view.confirmed,
        "I understand this runs the sample on this machine",
    );
    ui.add_space(8.0);

    // --- Target ----------------------------------------------------------
    ui.heading("Run");
    ui.label(muted(
        "Runs the sample as a normal process and records its output and exit. Richer monitoring \
         (file/registry/network) comes later. Only do this inside a disposable VM.",
    ));
    egui::Grid::new("sandbox-run")
        .num_columns(2)
        .spacing([10.0, 6.0])
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            ui.label("Executable");
            ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                ui.text_edit_singleline(&mut view.exe_path);
                if ui.small_button("use open file").clicked()
                    && let Some(doc) = docs.active()
                {
                    view.exe_path = doc.path.display().to_string();
                }
                if ui.small_button("browse…").clicked()
                    && let Some(p) = rfd::FileDialog::new().pick_file()
                {
                    view.exe_path = p.display().to_string();
                }
            });
            ui.end_row();
            ui.label("Arguments");
            ui.text_edit_singleline(&mut view.args);
            ui.end_row();
            ui.label("Timeout (s)");
            ui.add(egui::DragValue::new(&mut view.timeout_secs).range(1..=600));
            ui.end_row();
        });

    let decision = guard(&view.policy, in_vm, view.confirmed);
    let running = view.running.load(Ordering::SeqCst);
    let color = match decision {
        Decision::Allowed => ui.visuals().text_color(),
        Decision::NeedsConfirmation => ui.visuals().warn_fg_color,
        Decision::RefusedNotInVm => ui.visuals().error_fg_color,
    };
    ui.colored_label(color, decision.explain());

    let can_run = decision.is_allowed() && !view.exe_path.trim().is_empty() && !running;
    if ui
        .add_enabled(can_run, egui::Button::new("▶ Run in sandbox"))
        .clicked()
    {
        start_run(view, ui.ctx().clone());
    }
    if running {
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            ui.spinner();
            ui.label(muted("running…"));
        });
    }

    // --- Activity log ----------------------------------------------------
    if let Some(log) = lock(&view.result).as_ref() {
        ui.add_space(6.0);
        ui.separator();
        let status = if log.timed_out {
            "timed out".to_string()
        } else {
            log.exit_code
                .map(|c| format!("exited {c}"))
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "finished".into())
        };
        ui.label(
            RichText::new(format!(
                "Activity log — {status} in {:.1}s",
                log.duration.as_secs_f32()
            ))
            .strong(),
        );
        for ev in &log.events {
            let (txt, col) = match ev {
                RunEvent::Started(pid) => {
                    (format!("[start] pid {pid}"), ui.visuals().weak_text_color())
                }
                RunEvent::Stdout(s) => (format!("out: {s}"), ui.visuals().text_color()),
                RunEvent::Stderr(s) => (format!("err: {s}"), ui.visuals().warn_fg_color),
                RunEvent::Exited(c) => (format!("[exit {c}]"), ui.visuals().weak_text_color()),
                RunEvent::Timeout => ("[timeout — killed]".into(), ui.visuals().error_fg_color),
                RunEvent::Error(e) => (format!("[error] {e}"), ui.visuals().error_fg_color),
            };
            ui.label(RichText::new(txt).monospace().color(col));
        }
    }
}

fn vbox_section(ui: &mut Ui, view: &mut SandboxView) {
    ui.heading("VirtualBox control");
    if !*view.vbox_available.get_or_insert_with(vbox::available) {
        ui.label(muted(
            "VirtualBox not found. Install it (see \"Set up an analysis VM\" in the README) to \
             snapshot, revert and start an analysis VM from here.",
        ));
        return;
    }
    ui.label(muted(
        "Orchestrate an analysis VM: revert to a clean snapshot, run the sample inside it, then \
         revert again. Restore and power-off change the VM's state.",
    ));

    if let Some(info) = lock(&view.vbox_info).take() {
        view.vbox_vms = info.vms;
        view.vbox_sel = info.selected;
        view.vbox_state = info.state;
        view.vbox_snaps = info.snaps;
    }
    let busy = view.vbox_busy.load(Ordering::SeqCst);
    if !view.vbox_loaded && !busy {
        view.vbox_loaded = true;
        vbox_refresh(view, ui.ctx().clone(), None);
    }

    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        if ui
            .add_enabled(!busy, egui::Button::new("↻ Refresh"))
            .clicked()
        {
            let selected = view.vbox_vms.get(view.vbox_sel).map(|v| v.name.clone());
            vbox_refresh(view, ui.ctx().clone(), selected);
        }
        let current = view
            .vbox_vms
            .get(view.vbox_sel)
            .map(|v| v.name.clone())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "(no VM)".into());
        let before = view.vbox_sel;
        ui.add_enabled_ui(!busy, |ui| {
            egui::ComboBox::from_id_salt("vbox-vm")
                .selected_text(current)
                .show_ui(ui, |ui| {
                    for (i, vm) in view.vbox_vms.iter().enumerate() {
                        ui.selectable_value(&mut view.vbox_sel, i, &vm.name);
                    }
                });
        });
        if view.vbox_sel != before {
            let selected = view.vbox_vms.get(view.vbox_sel).map(|v| v.name.clone());
            view.vbox_state.clear();
            view.vbox_snaps.clear();
            vbox_refresh(view, ui.ctx().clone(), selected);
        }
        if !view.vbox_state.is_empty() {
            ui.label(muted(format!("state: {}", view.vbox_state)));
        }
    });

    let Some(vm) = view.vbox_vms.get(view.vbox_sel).map(|v| v.name.clone()) else {
        return;
    };

    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        if ui
            .add_enabled(!busy, egui::Button::new("▶ Start (GUI)"))
            .clicked()
        {
            let v = vm.clone();
            vbox_action(view, ui.ctx().clone(), &vm, "start", move || {
                vbox::start(&v, false)
            });
        }
        if ui
            .add_enabled(!busy, egui::Button::new("Start (headless)"))
            .clicked()
        {
            let v = vm.clone();
            vbox_action(view, ui.ctx().clone(), &vm, "start", move || {
                vbox::start(&v, true)
            });
        }
        if ui
            .add_enabled(!busy, egui::Button::new("⏹ Power off"))
            .clicked()
        {
            let v = vm.clone();
            vbox_action(view, ui.ctx().clone(), &vm, "poweroff", move || {
                vbox::poweroff(&v)
            });
        }
    });

    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.label("Snapshot");
        ui.text_edit_singleline(&mut view.vbox_snap_name);
        if ui
            .add_enabled(!busy, egui::Button::new("📷 Take"))
            .clicked()
        {
            let (v, n) = (vm.clone(), view.vbox_snap_name.clone());
            vbox_action(view, ui.ctx().clone(), &vm, "take snapshot", move || {
                vbox::take_snapshot(&v, &n)
            });
        }
        if ui
            .add_enabled(!busy, egui::Button::new("↩ Restore current"))
            .clicked()
        {
            let v = vm.clone();
            vbox_action(view, ui.ctx().clone(), &vm, "restore current", move || {
                vbox::restore_current(&v)
            });
        }
    });

    if !view.vbox_snaps.is_empty() {
        ui.horizontal_wrapped(|ui| {
            ui.label(muted("snapshots:"));
            for snap in view.vbox_snaps.clone() {
                if ui
                    .add_enabled(!busy, egui::Button::new(format!("↩ {snap}")).small())
                    .clicked()
                {
                    let (v, s) = (vm.clone(), snap.clone());
                    vbox_action(view, ui.ctx().clone(), &vm, "restore", move || {
                        vbox::restore_snapshot(&v, &s)
                    });
                }
            }
        });
    }

    if busy {
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            ui.spinner();
            ui.label(muted(lock(&view.vbox_status).clone()));
        });
    } else {
        let status = lock(&view.vbox_status).clone();
        if !status.is_empty() {
            ui.label(muted(status));
        }
    }
}

/// Re-reads the VM list and the state and snapshots of `selected` on a background thread.
fn vbox_refresh(view: &SandboxView, ctx: egui::Context, selected: Option<String>) {
    vbox_job(view, ctx, None, selected, || Ok(()));
}

/// Runs a (possibly slow) VBoxManage action on `vm` on a background thread, recording its
/// result, then re-reads the VM's state and snapshots (a Take adds one; a Restore changes the
/// state).
fn vbox_action(
    view: &SandboxView,
    ctx: egui::Context,
    vm: &str,
    label: &'static str,
    op: impl FnOnce() -> Result<(), String> + Send + 'static,
) {
    vbox_job(view, ctx, Some(label), Some(vm.to_owned()), op);
}

/// `op` then a fresh [`vbox_query`], on a worker thread. A `None` label is a silent refresh.
fn vbox_job(
    view: &SandboxView,
    ctx: egui::Context,
    label: Option<&'static str>,
    selected: Option<String>,
    op: impl FnOnce() -> Result<(), String> + Send + 'static,
) {
    let status = Arc::clone(&view.vbox_status);
    let busy = Arc::clone(&view.vbox_busy);
    let info = Arc::clone(&view.vbox_info);
    *lock(&status) = label.map_or_else(|| "querying VirtualBox…".into(), |l| format!("{l}…"));
    busy.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
    let spawned = std::thread::Builder::new()
        .name("vboxmanage".into())
        .spawn(move || {
            let outcome = op();
            let fresh = vbox_query(selected.as_deref());
            let msg = match (label, outcome) {
                (None, Ok(())) => String::new(),
                (None, Err(e)) => format!("query failed: {e}"),
                (Some(l), Ok(())) => format!("{l}: done"),
                (Some(l), Err(e)) => format!("{l} failed: {e}"),
            };
            *lock(&info) = Some(fresh);
            *lock(&status) = msg;
            busy.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
            ctx.request_repaint();
        });
    if let Err(e) = spawned {
        *lock(&view.vbox_status) = format!("could not start VBoxManage thread: {e}");
        view.vbox_busy.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
    }
}

/// Locks `m`, recovering the data if a worker panicked while holding it.
fn lock<T>(m: &Mutex<T>) -> std::sync::MutexGuard<'_, T> {
    m.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner())
}

fn fakenet_section(ui: &mut Ui, view: &mut SandboxView) {
    ui.heading("Fake network");
    ui.label(muted(
        "Point the VM's DNS and gateway here — every DNS query and HTTP request is answered and \
         logged, so the sample never reaches real infrastructure.",
    ));
    if let Some(net) = &view.fakenet {
        let mut stop = false;
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            if let Some(a) = net.dns_addr {
                ui.label(RichText::new(format!("DNS :{}", a.port())).monospace());
            }
            if let Some(a) = net.http_addr {
                ui.label(RichText::new(format!("HTTP :{}", a.port())).monospace());
            }
            if ui.button("Stop").clicked() {
                stop = true;
            }
        });
        for e in &net.errors {
            ui.colored_label(
                ui.visuals().warn_fg_color,
                format!("bind failed: {e} (ports 53/80 need admin)"),
            );
        }
        if view.net_at.is_none_or(|t| t.elapsed() >= LOG_REFRESH) {
            // Copy only what arrived since the last refresh, and keep just the newest shown.
            let (new, seen) = net.events_since(view.net_seen);
            view.net_seen = seen;
            view.net_snapshot.extend(new);
            let excess = view.net_snapshot.len().saturating_sub(MAX_NET_SHOWN);
            view.net_snapshot.drain(..excess);
            view.net_at = Some(Instant::now());
        }
        let events = &view.net_snapshot;
        if events.is_empty() && net.errors.is_empty() {
            ui.label(muted("Waiting for the sample's network activity…"));
        }
        if view.net_seen > MAX_NET_SHOWN {
            ui.label(muted(format!(
                "{} event(s); showing the newest {MAX_NET_SHOWN}",
                view.net_seen
            )));
        }
        for ev in events {
            let tag = match ev.kind {
                NetKind::Dns => "DNS ",
                NetKind::Http => "HTTP",
            };
            ui.label(RichText::new(format!("{tag}  {}", ev.summary)).monospace());
        }
        // Refresh the log while the responder is live.
        ui.ctx().request_repaint_after(Duration::from_millis(500));
        if stop {
            view.fakenet = None; // Drop stops the listeners
            view.net_snapshot.clear();
            view.net_seen = 0;
            view.net_at = None;
        }
    } else {
        egui::Grid::new("fakenet-cfg")
            .num_columns(2)
            .spacing([10.0, 4.0])
            .show(ui, |ui| {
                ui.label("Answer IP");
                ui.text_edit_singleline(&mut view.answer_ip);
                ui.end_row();
                ui.label("DNS port");
                ui.add(egui::DragValue::new(&mut view.dns_port));
                ui.end_row();
                ui.label("HTTP port");
                ui.add(egui::DragValue::new(&mut view.http_port));
                ui.end_row();
            });
        if ui.button("▶ Start fake network").clicked() {
            let answer_ip =
                Ipv4Addr::from_str(view.answer_ip.trim()).unwrap_or(Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST);
            view.fakenet = Some(FakeNet::start(FakeNetConfig {
                answer_ip,
                dns_port: view.dns_port,
                http_port: view.http_port,
            }));
        }
    }
}

/// A colour for each activity category.
fn category_color(cat: Category) -> egui::Color32 {
    match cat {
        Category::Process => egui::Color32::from_rgb(120, 180, 240),
        Category::File => egui::Color32::from_rgb(130, 200, 140),
        Category::Registry => egui::Color32::from_rgb(220, 180, 100),
        Category::Network => egui::Color32::from_rgb(230, 130, 130),
        Category::Image => egui::Color32::from_rgb(180, 150, 220),
        Category::Other => egui::Color32::GRAY,
    }
}

fn monitor_section(ui: &mut Ui, view: &mut SandboxView) {
    ui.heading("Activity monitor (ETW)");
    ui.label(muted(
        "Kernel tracing of process, file, registry, network and image-load events while a sample \
         runs. Requires running ORRESS as administrator; filter by the sample's PID to cut noise.",
    ));

    if view.monitor.is_some() {
        let mut stop = false;
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            ui.spinner();
            ui.label(muted("tracing system activity…"));
            if ui.button("⏹ Stop").clicked() {
                stop = true;
            }
            ui.label("Filter PID");
            ui.add(egui::TextEdit::singleline(&mut view.monitor_filter_pid).desired_width(70.0))
                .on_hover_text("Show only this PID (blank = all)");
        });

        let filter = view.monitor_filter_pid.trim().parse::<u32>().ok();
        // Re-read the log periodically (or when the filter changes), not every frame.
        let reread = view
            .etw_key
            .is_none_or(|(at, _)| at.elapsed() >= LOG_REFRESH);
        if reread && let Some(monitor) = &view.monitor {
            // Copy only the events recorded since the last refresh.
            let (new, seen) = monitor.events_since(view.etw_seen);
            view.etw_seen = seen;
            view.etw_snapshot.extend(new);
            if view.etw_snapshot.len() > MAX_ETW_KEPT {
                let excess = view.etw_snapshot.len() - MAX_ETW_KEPT + MAX_ETW_KEPT / 5;
                view.etw_snapshot.drain(..excess);
            }
        }
        if reread || view.etw_key.map(|(_, f)| f) != Some(filter) {
            view.etw_shown = view
                .etw_snapshot
                .iter()
                .enumerate()
                .filter(|(_, e)| filter.is_none_or(|p| e.pid == p))
                .map(|(i, _)| i)
                .collect();
            let at = match view.etw_key {
                Some((at, _)) if !reread => at,
                _ => Instant::now(),
            };
            view.etw_key = Some((at, filter));
        }
        let events = &view.etw_snapshot;
        let shown = &view.etw_shown;
        ui.label(muted(format!(
            "{} event(s) captured{}",
            events.len(),
            match filter {
                Some(p) => format!(" · {} shown for PID {p}", shown.len()),
                None => String::new(),
            }
        )));

        let row_height = ui.text_style_height(&egui::TextStyle::Monospace) + 4.0;
        egui::ScrollArea::vertical()
            .max_height(260.0)
            .auto_shrink([false, false])
            .stick_to_bottom(true)
            .id_salt("etw-log")
            .show_rows(ui, row_height, shown.len(), |ui, rows| {
                // Only the visible rows are laid out; oldest-first so the newest stays in view.
                for e in shown[rows].iter().filter_map(|&i| events.get(i)) {
                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                        ui.label(
                            RichText::new(format!("{:>8}", e.category.label()))
                                .monospace()
                                .color(category_color(e.category)),
                        );
                        ui.label(
                            RichText::new(format!("pid {:>6}", e.pid))
                                .monospace()
                                .weak(),
                        );
                        ui.label(RichText::new(&e.op).monospace());
                        if !e.detail.is_empty() {
                            ui.label(RichText::new(&e.detail).monospace().weak());
                        }
                    });
                }
            });

        ui.ctx().request_repaint_after(Duration::from_millis(500));
        if stop {
            view.monitor = None; // Drop stops the trace.
            view.etw_snapshot.clear();
            view.etw_seen = 0;
            view.etw_shown.clear();
            view.etw_key = None;
        }
    } else {
        if ui.button("▶ Start monitoring").clicked() {
            match orress_sandbox::etw::start() {
                Ok(m) => {
                    view.monitor = Some(m);
                    view.monitor_error = None;
                }
                Err(e) => view.monitor_error = Some(e),
            }
        }
        if let Some(e) = &view.monitor_error {
            ui.colored_label(ui.visuals().error_fg_color, e);
        }
    }
}

/// Spawns the run on a background thread so the UI stays responsive.
fn start_run(view: &SandboxView, ctx: egui::Context) {
    let exe = PathBuf::from(view.exe_path.trim());
    let args: Vec<String> = view.args.split_whitespace().map(str::to_string).collect();
    let timeout = Duration::from_secs(u64::from(view.timeout_secs));
    let result = Arc::clone(&view.result);
    let running = Arc::clone(&view.running);
    *lock(&result) = None;
    running.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let log = run(&exe, &args, None, timeout);
        *lock(&result) = Some(log);
        running.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
        ctx.request_repaint();
    });
}

```

`crates/orress-views/src/script.rs`:

```rs
//! The Scripting console: run a Rhai script against the open binary's analysis (functions,
//! strings, bytes, disassembly) and see its output — for automating queries without recompiling.
//! The engine (`orress-script`) is sandboxed and bounded, so a runaway script can't hang the UI.

use egui::{RichText, Ui};
use orress_project::DocStore;
use orress_ui::muted;

const EXAMPLE: &str = r#"// Rhai script — runs against the open binary.
// API: function_count(), functions(), func_name(a), func_blocks(a),
//      name(a), strings(), string_count(), read(addr, len), disasm(addr, n)
print("functions: " + function_count());
print("strings:   " + string_count());
let f = functions();
if f.len() > 0 {
    print("first function " + f[0] + " = " + func_name(f[0]));
    disasm(f[0], 5)
}
"#;

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ScriptView {
    src: String,
    output: Option<Result<String, String>>,
    /// The example is filled in once; after that an empty editor stays empty.
    seeded: bool,
}

pub fn script_view(ui: &mut Ui, view: &mut ScriptView, docs: &DocStore) {
    orress_ui::spotlight::mark(ui.ctx(), "view.Script", ui.max_rect());
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.label(RichText::new("Scripting").strong());
        ui.label(muted("automate analysis with Rhai · sandboxed, pure-Rust"));
    });
    ui.separator();

    if !view.seeded {
        view.seeded = true;
        if view.src.is_empty() {
            view.src = EXAMPLE.to_string();
        }
    }

    let Some(doc) = docs.active() else {
        ui.label(muted("Open a binary to script its analysis."));
        return;
    };
    let (Some(analysis), Some(program)) = (doc.analysis(), doc.program()) else {
        ui.label(muted("Analysis is still running…"));
        return;
    };

    egui::ScrollArea::vertical().show(ui, |ui| {
        ui.add(
            egui::TextEdit::multiline(&mut view.src)
                .font(egui::TextStyle::Monospace)
                .code_editor()
                .desired_rows(12)
                .desired_width(f32::INFINITY),
        );
        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
            if ui.button("▶ Run").clicked() {
                let strings: Vec<&str> = analysis.strings.iter().map(|s| s.text.as_str()).collect();
                view.output = Some(orress_script::run(&view.src, program, &strings));
            }
            if ui.button("Reset example").clicked() {
                view.src = EXAMPLE.to_string();
                view.output = None;
            }
        });

        if let Some(result) = &view.output {
            ui.add_space(6.0);
            match result {
                Ok(out) => {
                    if ui.small_button("copy output").clicked() {
                        ui.ctx().copy_text(out.clone());
                    }
                    ui.label(RichText::new(out).monospace());
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    ui.colored_label(ui.visuals().error_fg_color, RichText::new(e).monospace());
                }
            }
        }
    });
}
```

```rs
//! Section table.

use egui::{RichText, Sense, Ui};
use egui_extras::{Column, TableBuilder};
use orress_project::Document;
use orress_ui::{ExplainExt as _, muted};

use crate::colors::{entropy_color, section_color};
use crate::{DocView, ViewCtx, ViewRequest, fmt_addr};

pub fn sections(ui: &mut Ui, doc: &mut Document, cx: &mut ViewCtx<'_>) {
    let Some(analysis) = doc.analysis().cloned() else {
        return;
    };
    let info = &analysis.info;
    let wide = info.bits == Some(64);
    ui.label(muted(
        "A program is divided into sections. Each has a place in the file (offset, size) and \
         a place in memory (address). Permissions: R = readable, W = writable, X = executable \
         (code). Click a row to see its bytes; hover a name to learn what it usually holds.",
    ));
    ui.add_space(4.0);
    if info.sections.is_empty() {
        ui.label(muted("This file has no section table."));
    }

    let mut clicked = None;
    TableBuilder::new(ui)
        .id_salt("sections")
        .striped(true)
        .resizable(true)
        .sense(Sense::click())
        .cell_layout(egui::Layout::left_to_right(egui::Align::Center))
        .column(Column::auto().at_least(90.0))
        .columns(Column::auto().at_least(80.0), 4)
        .column(Column::auto().at_least(50.0))
        .column(Column::auto().at_least(110.0))
        .column(Column::remainder())
        .header(20.0, |mut h| {
            for (name, explain) in [
                ("Name", "Section name, chosen by the compiler or linker."),
                ("Offset", "Where the section starts in the file."),
                ("Size", "Bytes in the file."),
                ("Address", "Where the section is loaded in memory."),
                ("Mem size", "Bytes in memory. Larger than the file size for zero-filled data like .bss."),
                ("Perms", "R readable, W writable, X executable. Code is R-X; writable code (RWX) is suspicious."),
                ("Entropy", "Randomness of the section's bytes, 0–8. Near 8 means compressed or encrypted."),
                ("Usually contains", "What this section name normally means."),
            ] {
                h.col(|ui| {
                    ui.label(RichText::new(name).strong()).explain(name, explain);
                });
            }
        })
        .body(|body| {
            body.rows(20.0, info.sections.len(), |mut row| {
                let i = row.index();
                let s = &info.sections[i];
                row.set_selected(s.contains_offset(doc.cursor));
                row.col(|ui| {
                    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                        let (r, _) = ui.allocate_exact_size(egui::vec2(4.0, 14.0), Sense::hover());
                        ui.painter().rect_filled(r, 1.0, section_color(i));
                        ui.label(RichText::new(&s.name).monospace());
                    });
                });
                row.col(|ui| {
                    ui.label(RichText::new(format!("0x{:X}", s.offset)).monospace());
                });
                row.col(|ui| {
                    ui.label(RichText::new(format!("0x{:X}", s.file_size)).monospace());
                });
                row.col(|ui| {
                    ui.label(RichText::new(fmt_addr(s.address, wide)).monospace());
                });
                row.col(|ui| {
                    ui.label(RichText::new(format!("0x{:X}", s.virtual_size)).monospace());
                });
                row.col(|ui| {
                    let label = s.perms.label();
                    let rwx = s.perms.write && s.perms.execute;
                    let text = RichText::new(label).monospace();
                    ui.label(if rwx { text.color(ui.visuals().warn_fg_color) } else { text });
                });
                row.col(|ui| match s.entropy {
                    Some(e) => {
                        ui.horizontal(|ui| {
                            let (r, _) = ui.allocate_exact_size(egui::vec2(40.0 * e / 8.0 + 1.0, 10.0), Sense::hover());
                            ui.painter().rect_filled(r, 1.0, entropy_color(e));
                            ui.label(format!("{e:.2}"));
                        });
                    }
                    None => {
                        ui.label(muted("—"));
                    }
                });
                row.col(|ui| {
                    let meaning = orress_loaders::sections::explain(&s.name);
                    ui.label(RichText::new(meaning).small())
                        .on_hover_text(meaning);
                });
                if row.response().clicked() && s.file_size > 0 {
                    clicked = Some(i);
                }
            });
        });

    if let Some(i) = clicked {
        let s = &info.sections[i];
        doc.select(s.offset, s.file_size);
        cx.requests
            .push(ViewRequest::Open(doc.path.clone(), DocView::Hex));
    }

    if !info.segments.is_empty() {
        ui.add_space(8.0);
        ui.collapsing(format!("Segments ({})", info.segments.len()), |ui| {
            ui.label(muted(
                "Segments are what the operating system actually loads. Each covers one or more \
                 sections with the same permissions.",
            ));
            egui::Grid::new("segments")
                .striped(true)
                .num_columns(5)
                .show(ui, |ui| {
                    for h in ["Name", "Offset", "Size", "Address", "Perms"] {
                        ui.label(RichText::new(h).strong());
                    }
                    ui.end_row();
                    for s in &info.segments {
                        ui.label(s.name.as_deref().unwrap_or("—"));
                        ui.monospace(format!("0x{:X}", s.offset));
                        ui.monospace(format!("0x{:X}", s.file_size));
                        ui.monospace(fmt_addr(s.address, wide));
                        ui.monospace(s.perms.label());
                        ui.end_row();
                    }
                });
        });
    }
}
```

`crates/orress-views/src/shellcode.rs`:

```rs
//! The Shellcode workbench: a triage view for a raw code blob an analyst has captured. It
//! decodes the blob (hex / base64 / C array / escaped bytes), lists its disassembly, and runs
//! it in the `orress-emu` sandbox to observe its effects. Read-only inspection of bytes the
//! user supplies; nothing here is executed on the host.

use egui::{RichText, Ui};
use orress_arch::Isa;
use orress_emu::Emulator;
use orress_ui::muted;

/// The address the blob is loaded at for disassembly and emulation.
const BASE: u64 = 0x1_0000;

/// Persistent UI state for the Shellcode tab.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct ShellcodeView {
    input: String,
    decoded: Vec<u8>,
    message: String,
    run: Option<String>,
    hashes: Option<Vec<crate::apihash::HashMatch>>,
}

/// Decodes a pasted blob: a C/escaped array (`0x..`, `\x..`), plain hex, or base64.
///
/// The forms are tried strictly, so one cannot be misread as another: if the text has any
/// `0x`/`\x` tokens, only those tokens count (the rest is C syntax like `unsigned char
/// buf[]`); otherwise the text must be hex digits and separators only; otherwise base64.
pub fn decode_blob(text: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    let t = text.trim();
    if t.is_empty() {
        return Err("Paste a blob of bytes to inspect.".into());
    }
    if let Some(bytes) = prefixed_hex_bytes(t) {
        return Ok(bytes);
    }
    if let Some(bytes) = plain_hex(t) {
        return Ok(bytes);
    }
    base64_decode(t).map_err(|()| "Could not read this as hex, a C array, or base64.".into())
}

/// The bytes of every `0x..` / `\x..` token (one or two hex digits each), or `None` if the
/// text has no such token.
fn prefixed_hex_bytes(text: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    let bytes = text.as_bytes();
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut i = 0;
    while i + 1 < bytes.len() {
        let prefix = matches!(bytes[i], b'0' | b'\\') && (bytes[i + 1] | 0x20) == b'x';
        // `0x` must start a token: the `0` of `10x3` is not a prefix.
        let starts = bytes[i] == b'\\' || i == 0 || !bytes[i - 1].is_ascii_alphanumeric();
        if !(prefix && starts) {
            i += 1;
            continue;
        }
        let digits = bytes[i + 2..]
            .iter()
            .take(2)
            .take_while(|b| b.is_ascii_hexdigit())
            .count();
        if digits > 0 {
            let token = std::str::from_utf8(&bytes[i + 2..i + 2 + digits]).ok()?;
            out.push(u8::from_str_radix(token, 16).ok()?);
        }
        i += 2 + digits;
    }
    (!out.is_empty()).then_some(out)
}

/// Decodes text made only of hex digit pairs and separators (whitespace, `,` and `:`).
fn plain_hex(text: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    let digits: Vec<u8> = text
        .bytes()
        .filter(|b| !b.is_ascii_whitespace() && *b != b',' && *b != b':')
        .collect();
    if digits.is_empty()
        || !digits.len().is_multiple_of(2)
        || !digits.iter().all(u8::is_ascii_hexdigit)
    {
        return None;
    }
    digits
        .chunks(2)
        .map(|p| u8::from_str_radix(std::str::from_utf8(p).ok()?, 16).ok())
        .collect()
}

fn base64_decode(s: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, ()> {
    const TABLE: &[u8; 64] = b"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
    let mut rev = [255u8; 256];
    for (i, &c) in TABLE.iter().enumerate() {
        rev[c as usize] = i as u8;
    }
    let clean: Vec<u8> = s
        .bytes()
        .filter(|&b| b != b'=' && !b.is_ascii_whitespace())
        .collect();
    if clean.len() < 4 {
        return Err(());
    }
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(clean.len() * 3 / 4);
    for chunk in clean.chunks(4) {
        let mut acc = 0u32;
        let mut bits = 0u32;
        for &c in chunk {
            let v = rev[c as usize];
            if v == 255 {
                return Err(());
            }
            acc = (acc << 6) | u32::from(v);
            bits += 6;
        }
        acc <<= 32 - bits;
        for k in 0..(bits / 8) {
            out.push((acc >> (24 - k * 8)) as u8);
        }
    }
    Ok(out)
}

/// A disassembled line of the blob.
struct Line {
    offset: usize,
    bytes: String,
    text: String,
}

/// Disassembles the blob as x86-64 starting at [`BASE`].
fn disassemble(blob: &[u8]) -> Vec<Line> {
    let mut lines = Vec::new();
    let mut off = 0usize;
    while off < blob.len() {
        let addr = BASE + off as u64;
        match orress_arch::decode(Isa::X64, &blob[off..], addr) {
            Some(insn) => {
                let len = insn.len as usize;
                let raw: String = blob[off..(off + len).min(blob.len())]
                    .iter()
                    .map(|b| format!("{b:02x}"))
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .join(" ");
                lines.push(Line {
                    offset: off,
                    bytes: raw,
                    text: insn.text(),
                });
                off += len.max(1);
            }
            None => {
                lines.push(Line {
                    offset: off,
                    bytes: format!("{:02x}", blob[off]),
                    text: "(bad)".into(),
                });
                off += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    lines
}

/// Runs the blob in the emulator sandbox, reporting where it stopped and the register state.
fn emulate(blob: &[u8]) -> String {
    let mut emu = Emulator::new();
    emu.budget = 200_000;
    emu.map(BASE, blob);
    emu.setup_stack();
    emu.cpu.rip = BASE;
    let outcome = match emu.run_until(None) {
        Ok(stop) => format!("{stop:?}"),
        Err(e) => e.to_string(),
    };
    let names = [
        "rax", "rbx", "rcx", "rdx", "rsi", "rdi", "rbp", "rsp", "rip",
    ];
    let vals = [
        emu.cpu.regs[0],
        emu.cpu.regs[3],
        emu.cpu.regs[1],
        emu.cpu.regs[2],
        emu.cpu.regs[6],
        emu.cpu.regs[7],
        emu.cpu.regs[5],
        emu.cpu.regs[4],
        emu.cpu.rip,
    ];
    let regs: Vec<String> = names
        .iter()
        .zip(vals)
        .map(|(n, v)| format!("{n}={v:#018x}"))
        .collect();
    format!(
        "ran {} instructions, stopped: {outcome}\n{}",
        emu.steps,
        regs.join("  ")
    )
}

/// The Shellcode workbench tab.
pub fn shellcode_view(ui: &mut Ui, view: &mut ShellcodeView) {
    orress_ui::spotlight::mark(ui.ctx(), "view.Shellcode", ui.max_rect());
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.label(RichText::new("Shellcode workbench").strong());
        ui.label(muted("decode · disassemble · emulate (sandboxed)"));
    });
    ui.separator();
    ui.label(muted(
        "Paste a captured code blob as hex, a C array, \\x escapes, or base64.",
    ));
    ui.add(
        egui::TextEdit::multiline(&mut view.input)
            .desired_rows(4)
            .desired_width(f32::INFINITY)
            .font(egui::TextStyle::Monospace)
            .hint_text(r#"\x48\x31\xc0...  or  { 0x48, 0x31, 0xc0 }  or  base64"#),
    );
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        if ui.button("Decode").clicked() {
            match decode_blob(&view.input) {
                Ok(b) => {
                    view.message = format!("{} bytes", b.len());
                    view.decoded = b;
                    view.run = None;
                    view.hashes = None;
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    view.message = e;
                    view.decoded.clear();
                }
            }
        }
        if !view.decoded.is_empty() && ui.button("▶ Emulate").clicked() {
            view.run = Some(emulate(&view.decoded));
        }
        if !view.decoded.is_empty()
            && ui
                .button("# API hashes")
                .on_hover_text("Label 32-bit constants that match a known Windows API name hash")
                .clicked()
        {
            view.hashes = Some(crate::apihash::scan(&view.decoded));
        }
        if !view.message.is_empty() {
            ui.label(muted(&view.message));
        }
    });

    if let Some(report) = &view.run {
        ui.add_space(4.0);
        ui.label(RichText::new(report).monospace());
    }

    if let Some(matches) = &view.hashes {
        ui.add_space(4.0);
        if matches.is_empty() {
            ui.label(muted("No API-name-hash constants recognised."));
        } else {
            ui.label(RichText::new("API hashes:").strong());
            for m in matches {
                ui.label(
                    RichText::new(format!(
                        "  +{:#06x}  {:#010x}  {}",
                        m.offset, m.value, m.name
                    ))
                    .monospace(),
                );
            }
        }
    }

    if view.decoded.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    ui.add_space(6.0);
    ui.separator();
    let lines = disassemble(&view.decoded);
    egui::ScrollArea::vertical()
        .auto_shrink([false, false])
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            egui::Grid::new("shellcode-disasm")
                .num_columns(3)
                .striped(true)
                .spacing([16.0, 2.0])
                .show(ui, |ui| {
                    for l in &lines {
                        ui.label(
                            RichText::new(format!("{:#06x}", BASE + l.offset as u64))
                                .monospace()
                                .weak(),
                        );
                        ui.label(RichText::new(&l.bytes).monospace().weak());
                        ui.label(RichText::new(&l.text).monospace());
                        ui.end_row();
                    }
                });
        });
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn decodes_escaped_hex() {
        assert_eq!(
            decode_blob(r"\x48\x31\xc0").unwrap(),
            vec![0x48, 0x31, 0xc0]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn decodes_c_array() {
        assert_eq!(
            decode_blob("{ 0x90, 0x90, 0xc3 }").unwrap(),
            vec![0x90, 0x90, 0xc3]
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn decodes_plain_hex() {
        assert_eq!(decode_blob("90 90 c3").unwrap(), vec![0x90, 0x90, 0xc3]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn decodes_base64() {
        // "kJDD" base64-decodes to 90 90 c3.
        assert_eq!(decode_blob("kJDD").unwrap(), vec![0x90, 0x90, 0xc3]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn c_declaration_is_not_read_as_hex() {
        // "unsigned" and "char" hold hex digits ("ed", "ca"), which must not become bytes.
        assert_eq!(
            decode_blob("unsigned char buf[] = { 0x90 };").unwrap(),
            vec![0x90]
        );
        assert_eq!(
            decode_blob(r#"char sc[] = "\x48\x31\xc0";"#).unwrap(),
            vec![0x48, 0x31, 0xc0]
        );
        assert_eq!(decode_blob("{0x9, 0xa}").unwrap(), vec![0x09, 0x0a]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn base64_with_hex_letters_is_base64() {
        // "SDHA" holds hex-looking pairs but is base64 for 48 31 c0.
        assert_eq!(decode_blob("SDHA").unwrap(), vec![0x48, 0x31, 0xc0]);
        assert_eq!(
            decode_blob("AAEC").unwrap(),
            vec![0xaa, 0xec],
            "pure hex wins"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn separated_hex() {
        assert_eq!(
            decode_blob("48:31:c0, 90").unwrap(),
            vec![0x48, 0x31, 0xc0, 0x90]
        );
        assert!(decode_blob("zz").is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn disassembles_and_emulates_nop_ret() {
        // nop; nop; ret — a clean, inert blob.
        let blob = vec![0x90u8, 0x90, 0xc3];
        let lines = disassemble(&blob);
        assert_eq!(lines.len(), 3);
        assert!(lines[0].text.contains("nop"));
        let report = emulate(&blob);
        assert!(report.contains("ran"));
    }
}
```

`crates/orress-views/src/source_debug.rs`:

```rs
//! Source-level debugging state and panel, built on `orress-dap`. The editor sets source
//! breakpoints (F9) and shows the stopped line; this panel starts a session and shows the
//! call stack, variables, program output and step controls.
//!
//! Needs a working DAP adapter (e.g. codelldb or a functional lldb-dap). When none is
//! available it degrades to a clear message — the debug *client* is still exercised by the
//! `orress-dap` tests.
//!
//! Starting a session (compiling with `rustc -g`, resolving an extension's adapter or locator in
//! WASM, spawning the adapter) runs on a worker thread; [`SourceDebug::poll`] adopts the session
//! when it is ready, so the UI never blocks on a compile.

use std::collections::{BTreeSet, HashMap};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::mpsc::{Receiver, TryRecvError};

use egui::{RichText, Ui};
use orress_dap::{DapSession, DapState, LaunchConfig, Status};
use orress_ui::muted;
use serde_json::{Value, json};

/// What a worker thread hands back: the session, the source file it debugs (if a single file),
/// and a message to show.
type Launched = Result<(DapSession, Option<PathBuf>, Option<String>), String>;

type Notify = Arc<dyn Fn() + Send + Sync>;

/// A debugger command bound to a key (F5, F10, F11, …), for either debugger.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum DebugAction {
    Continue,
    StepOver,
    StepInto,
    StepOut,
    Pause,
    Stop,
}

/// A session being prepared on a worker thread.
struct Starting {
    rx: Receiver<Launched>,
    /// The breakpoints the session was launched with, to send any changes made meanwhile.
    sent: HashMap<PathBuf, Vec<u32>>,
}

/// Source-debug state the app owns.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct SourceDebug {
    /// Breakpoints per file, 1-based line numbers.
    breakpoints: HashMap<PathBuf, BTreeSet<u32>>,
    session: Option<DapSession>,
    /// The program being debugged (its source file).
    debugged: Option<PathBuf>,
    message: Option<String>,
    starting: Option<Starting>,
}

impl SourceDebug {
    /// Toggles a breakpoint; during a live session the file's new set is sent to the adapter.
    pub fn toggle_breakpoint(&mut self, path: &Path, line: u32) {
        let set = self.breakpoints.entry(path.to_path_buf()).or_default();
        if !set.remove(&line) {
            set.insert(line);
        }
        let lines: Vec<u32> = set.iter().copied().collect();
        if let Some(session) = &self.session
            && session.state().is_alive()
        {
            session.set_breakpoints(path, lines);
        }
    }

    pub fn breakpoints(&self, path: &Path) -> Option<&BTreeSet<u32>> {
        self.breakpoints.get(path)
    }

    /// Whether a session is running or being started.
    pub fn is_active(&self) -> bool {
        self.starting.is_some() || self.session.as_ref().is_some_and(|s| s.state().is_alive())
    }

    pub fn state(&self) -> Option<DapState> {
        self.session.as_ref().map(DapSession::state)
    }

    /// Adopts a session the worker thread finished starting. Call once per frame.
    pub fn poll(&mut self) {
        let Some(starting) = &self.starting else {
            return;
        };
        let result = match starting.rx.try_recv() {
            Ok(result) => result,
            Err(TryRecvError::Empty) => return,
            Err(TryRecvError::Disconnected) => Err("the debugger could not be started".into()),
        };
        let sent = self.starting.take().map(|s| s.sent).unwrap_or_default();
        match result {
            Ok((session, debugged, message)) => {
                // Breakpoints toggled while it was starting: send each changed file's new set.
                let files: BTreeSet<&PathBuf> =
                    self.breakpoints.keys().chain(sent.keys()).collect();
                for file in files {
                    let now: Vec<u32> = self
                        .breakpoints
                        .get(file)
                        .map(|s| s.iter().copied().collect())
                        .unwrap_or_default();
                    if sent.get(file).map_or(!now.is_empty(), |was| *was != now) {
                        session.set_breakpoints(file, now);
                    }
                }
                self.session = Some(session);
                self.debugged = debugged;
                self.message = message;
            }
            Err(e) => self.message = Some(e),
        }
    }

    /// The current stopped line in `path`, if the debugger is stopped there.
    pub fn current_line(&self, path: &Path) -> Option<u32> {
        let st = self.state()?;
        if !st.is_stopped() {
            return None;
        }
        st.current
            .and_then(|(p, l)| (norm(&p) == norm(path)).then_some(l))
    }

    fn breakpoint_lists(&self) -> HashMap<PathBuf, Vec<u32>> {
        self.breakpoints
            .iter()
            .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.iter().copied().collect()))
            .collect()
    }

    /// Runs `work` on a worker thread; its result is adopted by [`SourceDebug::poll`].
    fn spawn_start(
        &mut self,
        status: &str,
        notify: Notify,
        work: impl FnOnce(HashMap<PathBuf, Vec<u32>>, Notify) -> Launched + Send + 'static,
    ) {
        let bps = self.breakpoint_lists();
        let (tx, rx) = std::sync::mpsc::channel();
        self.starting = Some(Starting {
            rx,
            sent: bps.clone(),
        });
        self.session = None;
        self.message = Some(status.to_string());
        let spawned = std::thread::Builder::new()
            .name("orress-debug-start".into())
            .spawn(move || {
                let result = work(bps, Arc::clone(&notify));
                let _ = tx.send(result);
                notify();
            });
        if let Err(e) = spawned {
            self.starting = None;
            self.message = Some(format!("could not start the debugger: {e}"));
        }
    }

    /// Starts debugging a Rust source file: compiles it with debug info, finds a DAP
    /// adapter, and launches — on a worker thread. A native adapter (`lldb-dap`) is preferred;
    /// failing that, a debug adapter provided by an installed Zed extension (from `extensions_dir`)
    /// is resolved from its WASM. `settings` are the user's settings, handed to extensions.
    pub fn start(
        &mut self,
        src: &Path,
        extensions_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
        settings: Value,
        notify: Notify,
    ) {
        if self.starting.is_some() {
            return;
        }
        let src = src.to_path_buf();
        self.spawn_start(
            "Compiling with debug info…",
            notify,
            move |bps, notify| {
                let exe = exe_path(&src);
                let cwd = src.parent().map(Path::to_path_buf);
                let native = orress_dap::find_adapter();
                if native.is_none() && extensions_dir.is_none() {
                    return Err(NO_ADAPTER.into());
                }
                compile(&src, &exe)?;
                let config = match native {
                    Some((adapter, args)) => {
                        LaunchConfig::lldb(&adapter, &args, &exe, cwd.as_deref())
                    }
                    None => extensions_dir
                        .and_then(|dir| {
                            extension_launch(&dir, &src, &exe, cwd.as_deref(), &settings)
                        })
                        .ok_or_else(|| NO_ADAPTER.to_string())?,
                };
                DapSession::launch_with(config, bps, notify)
                    .map(|session| (session, Some(src), None))
                    .map_err(|e| format!("could not start the debugger: {e}"))
            },
        );
    }

    /// "Debug this task": turns a build/run `task` into a debug session via an extension-provided
    /// locator + debug adapter (on a worker thread). Finds a locator that handles the task
    /// (producing a scenario, the concrete program, and the adapter to spawn) and launches it.
    /// Degrades to a message when no installed extension can.
    pub fn debug_task(
        &mut self,
        task: &orress_editor::Task,
        extensions_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
        worktree: &Path,
        settings: Value,
        notify: Notify,
    ) {
        if self.starting.is_some() {
            return;
        }
        let Some(step) = task.steps.last() else {
            self.message = Some("This task has no command to debug.".into());
            return;
        };
        let Some(dir) = extensions_dir else {
            self.message =
                Some("No extensions directory — install a debug-adapter/locator extension.".into());
            return;
        };
        let template = orress_ext::DapTaskTemplate {
            label: task.label.clone(),
            command: step.program.clone(),
            args: step.args.clone(),
            env: Vec::new(),
            cwd: Some(step.cwd.display().to_string()),
        };
        let label = task.label.clone();
        let worktree = worktree.to_path_buf();
        self.spawn_start(
            &format!("Locating a debugger for \"{label}\"…"),
            notify,
            move |bps, notify| {
                let located =
                    match orress_ext::locate_debug_target(&dir, &template, &worktree, settings) {
                        Ok(Some(t)) => t,
                        Ok(None) => {
                            return Err(format!(
                                "No installed extension locator can debug \"{label}\"."
                            ));
                        }
                        Err(e) => return Err(format!("locator failed: {e}")),
                    };
                let config = located_launch(&located)?;
                let message = format!(
                    "Debugging \"{label}\" via the {} locator ({} adapter).",
                    located.locator_name, located.scenario.adapter
                );
                DapSession::launch_with(config, bps, notify)
                    .map(|session| (session, None, Some(message)))
                    .map_err(|e| format!("could not start the debugger: {e}"))
            },
        );
    }

    /// Runs a debugger command (from the F5/F10/F11 shortcuts) on the live session. Returns
    /// whether a session took it.
    pub fn command(&mut self, action: DebugAction) -> bool {
        let Some(s) = &self.session else {
            return false;
        };
        let state = s.state();
        if !state.is_alive() {
            return false;
        }
        let stopped = state.is_stopped();
        match action {
            DebugAction::Continue if stopped => s.resume(),
            DebugAction::StepOver if stopped => s.step_over(),
            DebugAction::StepInto if stopped => s.step_in(),
            DebugAction::StepOut if stopped => s.step_out(),
            DebugAction::Pause if state.status == Some(Status::Running) => s.pause(),
            DebugAction::Stop => self.stop(),
            _ => return false,
        }
        true
    }

    pub fn stop(&mut self) {
        if let Some(s) = &self.session {
            s.stop();
        }
        self.session = None;
        // Dropping the receiver abandons a start in progress; its session is dropped (and the
        // adapter killed) when the worker's send fails.
        if self.starting.take().is_some() {
            self.message = Some("Debug start cancelled.".into());
        }
    }
}

const NO_ADAPTER: &str = "No debug adapter found. Install a DAP adapter (e.g. codelldb), or a Zed \
     debug-adapter extension, for source debugging.";

/// Compiles a standalone `.rs` with debug info next to the source.
fn compile(src: &Path, exe: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    let output = std::process::Command::new("rustc")
        .args(["-g", "-C", "opt-level=0", "--edition", "2021"])
        .arg(src)
        .arg("-o")
        .arg(exe)
        .output()
        .map_err(|e| format!("could not run rustc: {e}"))?;
    if output.status.success() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    Err(format!(
        "compile failed:\n{}",
        String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
            .lines()
            .take(3)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("\n")
    ))
}

/// A JSON object from an adapter configuration string (anything else gives an empty object).
fn config_object(config: &str) -> Value {
    match serde_json::from_str::<Value>(config) {
        Ok(v @ Value::Object(_)) => v,
        _ => json!({}),
    }
}

/// Resolves a debug adapter provided by an installed Zed extension into a launch configuration
/// for `program`: the adapter command, arguments, environment and working directory, its id, and
/// the launch arguments built from the configuration it returns. Takes the first
/// extension-provided adapter that yields a stdio command for a launch request.
fn extension_launch(
    extensions_dir: &Path,
    src: &Path,
    program: &Path,
    cwd: Option<&Path>,
    settings: &Value,
) -> Option<LaunchConfig> {
    let worktree = orress_ext::project_root(src);
    let mut wanted = json!({
        "request": "launch",
        "program": program.to_string_lossy(),
        "stopOnEntry": false,
    });
    if let Some(cwd) = cwd {
        wanted["cwd"] = json!(cwd.to_string_lossy());
    }
    for da in orress_ext::zed_debug_adapters(extensions_dir) {
        let def = orress_ext::DapTaskDefinition {
            label: "debug".to_string(),
            adapter: da.adapter_name.clone(),
            config: wanted.to_string(),
        };
        let Ok(bin) = orress_ext::resolve_dap_binary(
            &da.wasm,
            &da.adapter_name,
            &def,
            None,
            &worktree,
            settings.clone(),
        ) else {
            continue;
        };
        let Some(command) = bin.command else {
            continue; // TCP-only adapters are not supported by the launcher
        };
        if bin.request == orress_ext::DapRequestKind::Attach {
            continue;
        }
        // The adapter's own configuration, with our program filled in where it left it out.
        let mut args = config_object(&bin.configuration);
        if let (Some(map), Some(defaults)) = (args.as_object_mut(), wanted.as_object()) {
            for (k, v) in defaults {
                map.entry(k.clone()).or_insert_with(|| v.clone());
            }
        }
        return Some(LaunchConfig {
            adapter: command,
            adapter_args: bin.arguments,
            adapter_env: bin.env,
            adapter_cwd: bin.cwd.map(PathBuf::from),
            adapter_id: da.adapter_name,
            launch_arguments: args,
        });
    }
    None
}

/// The launch configuration for a locator's target: the scenario's JSON config as the base, refined
/// by the adapter's own configuration (its keys win), then the concrete program, working directory,
/// arguments and environment from the locator's request. The adapter process gets the environment
/// and working directory its binary resolution asked for.
fn located_launch(located: &orress_ext::LocatedDebug) -> Result<LaunchConfig, String> {
    let (program, cwd, args, env) = match &located.request {
        orress_ext::DapRequest::Launch {
            program,
            cwd,
            args,
            env,
        } => (program, cwd, args, env),
        orress_ext::DapRequest::Attach { .. } => {
            return Err(
                "The locator produced an attach request, which the debugger does not support yet."
                    .into(),
            );
        }
    };
    let mut launch = config_object(&located.scenario.config);
    if let (Some(map), Value::Object(adapter)) = (
        launch.as_object_mut(),
        config_object(&located.adapter_configuration),
    ) {
        map.extend(adapter);
    }
    launch["request"] = json!("launch");
    launch["program"] = json!(program);
    if let Some(cwd) = cwd {
        launch["cwd"] = json!(cwd);
    }
    if !args.is_empty() {
        launch["args"] = json!(args);
    }
    if !env.is_empty() {
        let env: serde_json::Map<String, Value> =
            env.iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), json!(v))).collect();
        launch["env"] = Value::Object(env);
    }
    Ok(LaunchConfig {
        adapter: located.adapter_command.clone(),
        adapter_args: located.adapter_args.clone(),
        adapter_env: located.adapter_env.clone(),
        adapter_cwd: located.adapter_cwd.as_ref().map(PathBuf::from),
        adapter_id: located.scenario.adapter.clone(),
        launch_arguments: launch,
    })
}

fn exe_path(src: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    let stem = src
        .file_stem()
        .map(|s| s.to_os_string())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let mut p = src.with_file_name(stem);
    if cfg!(windows) {
        p.set_extension("exe");
    }
    p
}

fn norm(p: &Path) -> String {
    let s = p.to_string_lossy();
    if cfg!(windows) {
        s.to_lowercase().replace('\\', "/")
    } else {
        s.into_owned()
    }
}

/// The "Debug" bottom panel: controls, call stack, variables and output.
pub fn source_debug_panel(ui: &mut Ui, dbg: &mut SourceDebug) {
    dbg.poll();
    let state = dbg.state();
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        ui.label(RichText::new("Source debugger").strong());
        match &state {
            Some(s) => {
                let (label, color) = match s.status {
                    Some(Status::Starting) => {
                        ("starting…".to_string(), ui.visuals().weak_text_color())
                    }
                    Some(Status::Running) => ("running…".to_string(), ui.visuals().text_color()),
                    Some(Status::Stopped) => (
                        format!("stopped ({})", s.stop_reason.as_deref().unwrap_or("")),
                        ui.visuals().text_color(),
                    ),
                    Some(Status::Exited) => ("exited".to_string(), ui.visuals().weak_text_color()),
                    Some(Status::Failed) | None => {
                        ("failed".to_string(), ui.visuals().error_fg_color)
                    }
                };
                ui.separator();
                ui.colored_label(color, label);
            }
            None if dbg.starting.is_some() => {
                ui.separator();
                ui.spinner();
                ui.label(muted("starting…"));
                if ui.small_button("Cancel").clicked() {
                    dbg.stop();
                }
            }
            None => {
                ui.separator();
                ui.label(muted(
                    "idle — press Debug in the editor toolbar (needs a DAP adapter)",
                ));
            }
        }
    });
    if let Some(msg) = &dbg.message {
        ui.colored_label(ui.visuals().warn_fg_color, msg);
    }
    if let Some(err) = state.as_ref().and_then(|s| s.last_error.clone()) {
        ui.colored_label(ui.visuals().error_fg_color, err);
    }

    let Some(state) = state else {
        return;
    };

    let mut stop = false;
    ui.horizontal(|ui| {
        let stopped = state.is_stopped();
        let s = dbg.session.as_ref();
        if ui
            .add_enabled(stopped, egui::Button::new("▶ Continue"))
            .on_hover_text("F5")
            .clicked()
            && let Some(s) = s
        {
            s.resume();
        }
        if ui
            .add_enabled(stopped, egui::Button::new("↷ Step over"))
            .on_hover_text("F10")
            .clicked()
            && let Some(s) = s
        {
            s.step_over();
        }
        if ui
            .add_enabled(stopped, egui::Button::new("↓ Step in"))
            .on_hover_text("F11")
            .clicked()
            && let Some(s) = s
        {
            s.step_in();
        }
        if ui
            .add_enabled(stopped, egui::Button::new("↑ Step out"))
            .on_hover_text("Shift+F11")
            .clicked()
            && let Some(s) = s
        {
            s.step_out();
        }
        if ui
            .add_enabled(
                state.status == Some(Status::Running),
                egui::Button::new("⏸ Pause"),
            )
            .on_hover_text("Stop the running program where it is")
            .clicked()
            && let Some(s) = s
        {
            s.pause();
        }
        if ui
            .add_enabled(state.is_alive(), egui::Button::new("⏹ Stop"))
            .on_hover_text("Shift+F5")
            .clicked()
        {
            stop = true;
        }
    });
    if stop {
        dbg.stop();
    }
    ui.separator();

    egui::ScrollArea::vertical()
        .auto_shrink([false, false])
        .show(ui, |ui| {
            egui::CollapsingHeader::new("Variables")
                .default_open(true)
                .show(ui, |ui| {
                    if state.variables.is_empty() {
                        ui.label(muted("(no locals, or not stopped)"));
                    }
                    egui::Grid::new("dap-vars")
                        .num_columns(2)
                        .spacing([14.0, 2.0])
                        .show(ui, |ui| {
                            for v in &state.variables {
                                ui.label(RichText::new(&v.name).monospace());
                                let val = v.ty.as_ref().map_or_else(
                                    || v.value.clone(),
                                    |t| format!("{} : {t}", v.value),
                                );
                                ui.label(RichText::new(val).monospace().weak());
                                ui.end_row();
                            }
                        });
                });
            egui::CollapsingHeader::new("Call stack")
                .default_open(true)
                .show(ui, |ui| {
                    for f in &state.frames {
                        let loc = f
                            .source
                            .as_ref()
                            .and_then(|p| p.file_name())
                            .map(|n| format!(" ({}:{})", n.to_string_lossy(), f.line))
                            .unwrap_or_default();
                        ui.label(RichText::new(format!("{}{loc}", f.name)).monospace());
                    }
                });
            egui::CollapsingHeader::new("Output")
                .default_open(false)
                .show(ui, |ui| {
                    for line in &state.output {
                        ui.label(RichText::new(line.trim_end()).monospace().weak());
                    }
                });
        });
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn located_launch_merges_scenario_config_with_the_request() {
        let located = orress_ext::LocatedDebug {
            adapter_command: "codelldb".into(),
            adapter_args: vec!["--port".into()],
            adapter_env: vec![("CODELLDB_LOG".into(), "info".into())],
            adapter_cwd: Some("/opt/codelldb".into()),
            adapter_configuration: r#"{"stopOnEntry": true, "program": "adapter"}"#.into(),
            request: orress_ext::DapRequest::Launch {
                program: "/p/target/debug/app".into(),
                cwd: Some("/p".into()),
                args: vec!["--fast".into()],
                env: vec![("RUST_LOG".into(), "debug".into())],
            },
            scenario: orress_ext::DapScenario {
                label: "app".into(),
                adapter: "CodeLLDB".into(),
                build: None,
                config: r#"{"sourceLanguages": ["rust"], "program": "placeholder"}"#.into(),
                tcp: None,
            },
            locator_name: "cargo".into(),
        };
        let config = located_launch(&located).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(config.adapter_id, "CodeLLDB");
        let args = &config.launch_arguments;
        assert_eq!(args["sourceLanguages"][0], "rust"); // scenario config kept
        assert_eq!(args["program"], "/p/target/debug/app"); // request wins
        assert_eq!(args["cwd"], "/p");
        assert_eq!(args["args"][0], "--fast");
        assert_eq!(args["env"]["RUST_LOG"], "debug");
        assert_eq!(args["request"], "launch");
        assert_eq!(args["stopOnEntry"], true); // adapter configuration merged in
        assert_eq!(
            config.adapter_env,
            vec![("CODELLDB_LOG".to_string(), "info".to_string())]
        );
        assert_eq!(config.adapter_cwd, Some(PathBuf::from("/opt/codelldb")));
    }
}
```
